izzyondroid:com.androidvip.sysctlgui.name: SysctlGUI
izzyondroid:com.androidvip.sysctlgui.summary: A GUI for Android sysctl. Fine-tune kernel parameters for power users.
izzyondroid:com.androidvip.sysctlgui.description:
SysctlGUI is a Android application designed for power users, developers, and enthusiasts who want to fine-tune their device's performance by directly editing kernel parameters.It provides a user interface for the sysctl command-line utility, making advanced kernel tweaking accessible and manageable.
 Features: 
 Easily browse the filesystem or search a comprehensive list to find kernel parameters, with in-app documentation to help you understand their impact.
 Automatically reapply your chosen settings on every boot.
 Save and load sets of parameters from configuration files, making it simple to switch between different performance profiles or share your setup.
 Mark frequently used parameters for quick and easy access.
 Automate the application of kernel parameters in response to specific events using Tasker .

izzyondroid:com.minimo.launcher.name: Minimo Launcher
izzyondroid:com.minimo.launcher.summary: Minimalist launcher for focus: clean home screen, less clutter, less screen time
izzyondroid:com.minimo.launcher.description: Minimo is a free, open-source minimalist launcher that turns your phone into a calm, distraction-free home screen. Spend less time scrolling, cut down screen time, and open only the apps you actually need. Instead of rows of colorful icons and endless notifications, Minimo gives you a clean, text-based home screen with your favorite apps and a fast app drawer for everything else. It is simple to set up, light on battery, and fully customizable. ★ BUILT FOR FOCUS AND DIGITAL WELLBEING • Keep only a few favorite apps on the home screen, or none at all • Hide distracting apps from the app drawer, with the option to still find them in search • Launch Delay: add a short pause before a distracting app opens, so you can decide if you really need it • Daily screen time widget on the home screen to stay aware of your phone usage • Optional icon-free mode for a quiet, low-stimulation look ★ FAST APP DRAWER AND SEARCH • Instant app search with "contains" or "starts with" matching • Auto-open the app when it is the only search result, or press Done to open the first result • A-Z fast scroller to jump through your apps • Keyboard opens automatically, with an adjustable delay • Move the search bar to the bottom for one-handed use, or hide it completely • Folders to group apps together • Rename apps, reorder favorites, and open app info or uninstall right from the launcher ★ GESTURES AND SHORTCUTS • Swipe left or right on the home screen to open any app you choose • Double tap to lock the screen • Press Back on the home screen to open the app drawer • Long-press empty space to open settings • Tap the clock, date, battery, or screen time widget to open the app of your choice • Pin shortcuts and web shortcuts to the launcher ★ MAKE IT YOURS • Show app names only, or add icons with support for icon packs • Import your own fonts (.ttf) and choose separate fonts for apps and the clock • Adjust text size, icon size, spacing, and horizontal and vertical alignment • Light, dark, pure black (AMOLED), system, and Material You dynamic color themes • Use your wallpaper, dim it for readability, or set it to match your theme • Clock with 12-hour or 24-hour time, custom date format, and battery level • Notification dots on home screen apps • Hide the status bar and navigation bar for a full-screen look • Portrait or landscape layout ★ PRIVATE SPACE SUPPORT Lock, unlock, and open apps from Android Private Space directly in the app drawer. ★ PRIVATE AND OPEN SOURCE • No ads, no tracking, no personal data collection • Works offline • Source code is public, so anyone can review it or contribute Minimo is a great fit if you want a minimal phone, a "dumbphone" style home screen, or simply a cleaner Android launcher that helps you stay productive and present. Install Minimo, set it as your default launcher, and make your phone a tool again, not a distraction. Permissions: The app uses the Accessibility permission for the feature of "Double tap to lock" the screen. It is a completely optional feature. While enabling the accessibility, a system warning regarding the privacy is shown. No personal data is being collected by the app using accessibility. Source Code: https://github.com/VaibhavLakhera/minimo-launcher

fdroid:club.hiraeth.flareenough.name: Flare Enough
fdroid:club.hiraeth.flareenough.summary: Calm, private, offline tracking for medication, symptoms and stillness.
fdroid:club.hiraeth.flareenough.description:
Flare Enough is a calm, private app for living with a chronic illness. It helps you keep track of your medication, log how you are feeling, and take a few quiet minutes for yourself, and it is built to be gentle on a bad day.
Everything stays on your device. The app has no internet permission at all, no ads, no trackers, no accounts, and no sign in. The only way data leaves your phone is when you choose to export or back it up yourself.
What it does:
* Medication reminders that fire on time, including in Doze and after a restart, using exact alarms.
* Simple symptom logging, with a body map, notes, and tags, in plain words, with no guilt and no streaks.
* An optional period tracker you can turn on or off.
* A quiet Stillness section with a timer, gentle breathing, and a soft bell, plus prompts and readings you can add yourself.
* A calm, muted look with a light and a dark theme, large touch targets, full TalkBack support, and support for large system text.
Flare Enough records and reminds only. It does not diagnose, recommend treatments, adjust doses, check interactions, or interpret symptoms. For medical advice, please speak to a healthcare professional.
Free and open source, licensed under the GPL, version 3 or later.

fdroid:com.logseq.app.name: Logseq
fdroid:com.logseq.app.summary: A privacy-first, open-source platform for knowledge management and collaboration
fdroid:com.logseq.app.description:
Logseq is a knowledge management and collaboration platform. It focuses on privacy, longevity, and user control. Logseq offers a range of powerful tools for knowledge management, collaboration, PDF annotation, and task management with support for multiple file formats, including Markdown and Org-mode, and various features for organizing and structuring your notes.
Logseq's Whiteboard feature lets you organize your knowledge and ideas using a spatial canvas with shapes, drawings, website embeds, and connectors. You can visually group and link your notes and external media (such as videos and images), enabling visual thinkers to compose, remix, annotate, and connect content from their knowledge base and emerging thoughts in a new way.
In addition to its core features, Logseq has a growing ecosystem of plugins and themes that enable a wide range of workflows and customization options. Mobile apps are also available, providing access to most of the features of the desktop application. Whether you're a student, a professional, or anyone who values a clear and organized approach to managing your ideas and notes, Logseq is an excellent choice for anyone looking to improve their productivity and streamline their workflow.

fdroid:com.mrmannwood.hexlauncher.name: Hex Launcher
fdroid:com.mrmannwood.hexlauncher.summary: A minimalist launcher that puts your apps under your thumb
fdroid:com.mrmannwood.hexlauncher.description:
Hex Launcher is a minimalist, performant, private, and open-source home screen replacement.
 Minimalist : Hex Launcher is optimized to bring the app you want directly to your thumb. Nothing more, nothing less.
 Performant : Hex Launcher was written from the ground up to be as small and fast as possible. It will not drain your battery, and it will not leave you waiting.
 Private : Hex Launcher does not track you. It contains no ads, and no analytics of any kind. It can't even connect to the internet. If you want privacy, you will find it with Hex Launcher.
 Open Source : Hex Launcher is designed and maintained by one person, with a commitment towards being open and accepting feedback. The source is available on Github at https://github.com/MrMannWood/launcher 
 Make Your Phone Work For You
 Hex Launcher was designed to get you into your apps as quickly as possible, and to prevent you from mindlessly looking for a new way to doom scroll. It provides a search-first UI that puts your results directly under your thumb, and allows you to set up six apps for fast access with gestures.
 Take Back Your Privacy
 Hex Launcher does not contain trackers, analytics, or data gathering mechanisms; it can't even connect to the internet. With Hex Launcher, what happens on your home screen stays on your phone.
If you want to help the developer, you can choose to enable on device logging and provide bug reports via email. These options are off by default . Your phone and your data are yours.

fdroid:com.mubarak.mbcompass.summary: Compass, GPS tracker & offline maps. No ads, no tracking.
fdroid:com.mubarak.mbcompass.description:
MBCompass is a free and open-source compass and navigation app
without ads, in-app purchases, or tracking. Lightweight, focused,
and built for real use.
 Compass 
- Accurate compass with true north and magnetic north
- Sensor fusion (accelerometer, gyroscope, magnetometer) for stable readings
- Real-time magnetic field strength (µT)
- Auto-alert when accuracy drops low enough to matter
 GPS & Maps 
- Live location on OpenStreetMap
- Offline maps via Mapsforge point MBCompass to a folder
 containing any .map file and toggle between online and offline
- Toggle between OSM tiles and offline maps in Settings
 Track Recording 
- Record routes with start, pause, resume, and background support
- Smooth polyline rendering on the map
- Track stats: distance, duration, average speed, elevation gain/loss,
 min/max altitude, elevation profile
- Star and sort saved tracks
- Export as GPX : compatible with OsmAnd, Garmin, and any
 standard mapping tool
 App 
- Light, Dark, and AMOLED themes
- Custom bottom navigation bar
- Landscape orientation supported
- Screen stays on during navigation
- Runs on Android 6.0+
- Under 2 MB including offline map support
 Privacy 
- No analytics, no crash reporter, no ad network
- No Google Play Services dependency
- Location processed on-device only
- Source: https://github.com/CompassMB/MBCompass
 Not just a compass. Not a full navigation app. 
MBCompass sits in between, direction, live map, track recording,
and offline maps without unnecessary complexity.

fdroid:com.zazen.name: Zazen
fdroid:com.zazen.summary: A minimal, offline meditation timer with interval bells.
fdroid:com.zazen.description:
Zazen is a modern, minimal meditation timer for Android. It stays out of the
way so you can sit: no account, no network access, no tracking, no ads.
Features:
* Clean timer — a full-screen countdown with circular progress.
* Open-ended sits — no duration and no countdown: the timer simply counts up,
 and the sit ends when you decide it does, closing bell included.
* Interval bells — schedule bells at specific points within a session, for
 example a bell at 5 minutes for a body scan and a different one at 15
 minutes for breath work.
* Repeating bell — ring every few minutes for the whole sit, in a timed
 session or an open-ended one.
* Silent mode — a vibrate-only option so you can meditate near sleeping kids.
* Session tracking — review your meditation history and total time sat.
* Beautiful sounds — Tibetan bowls, bells and gongs.
* Backup and restore — export your presets, sessions and preferences to a
 file, and import them again on another device.
Privacy:
Zazen requests no internet permission at all, so it is incapable of sending
your data anywhere. Everything stays in local storage on your device.
Zazen is free software released under the MIT licence. The bundled sounds come
from the BodhiTimer project and the nyxkn/meditation collection; individual
attributions are listed in the NOTICES file in the source repository.

fdroid:godau.fynn.moodledirect.name: dawdle
fdroid:godau.fynn.moodledirect.description:
dawdle is a performant and native client for the Moodle e-learning platform. This platform is oftentimes self-hosted by universities, schools and other institutions to provide teaching material to learners.
Connections to arbitrary Moodle instances are supported. You may log in with username and password or, if your instance requests this, you can also sign in through a web browser (for single-sign-on). Course contents are queried from the server and stored for offline usage. Marked-up content and embedded images are usually displayed correctly. An in-app user help menu documents many of the application's features.
At this moment, only some of the basic modules are supported. However, opening an unsupported module will, through magic, automatically sign you in to your browser before opening there – providing a very convenient access to all types of content.
 Note: dawdle can only operate if mobile web services are enabled on your Moodle instance. This is oftentimes the case, as it is also required for using the official Moodle Pty Ltd. app.
Screenshot material from https://school.moodledemo.net by Mary, Chris, and Estelle Cooch licensed CC BY-SA, with adaptions.

fdroid:io.gitlab.cryptographic_id.name: Cryptographic ID
fdroid:io.gitlab.cryptographic_id.summary: Attest the trustworthiness of a device using asymmetric cryptography
fdroid:io.gitlab.cryptographic_id.description:
Use cases:
- Attest the state of a Linux computer
When your computer is in a trustworthy state, you can generate a private key hidden in the TPM2 of your computer. This private key can be sealed with the current state of the computer (PCRs). Then the computer can only sign a message with this key when it is in the correct state according to the PCRs. For example, you can seal the key against the secure boot state (PCR7). If your computer is booting an operating system signed by another vendor, the TPM2 cannot unseal the private key. So if your computer can generate a correct signature, it is in this known state. You can create a sealed private key and create such a signature with cryptographic-id-rs (https://gitlab.com/cryptographic_id/cryptographic-id-rs). This is similar to tpm2-totp (https://github.com/tpm2-software/tpm2-totp) but uses asymmetric cryptography. This means you do not need to keep the verification code secure. You can share it safely with the world.
- Verify the identity of a phone
You can generate a private key when your phone is in a trustworthy state. If your phone can create a correct signature, you know it is the same phone. Since the operating system can access the private key, the security guarantees are much weaker than with a TPM2. So the verification is just as secure as your phone. If you use Graphene OS, also have a look at Auditor (https://attestation.app/tutorial).
- Verify that a person is in possession of a private key
This works as well as the section above but has the same shortcomings. It can be used to verify someone in person when he sends his public key to you in advance over a secure channel.

Multi-language fully supported including all common localised codepages (from US & Westen Europe to Eastern Europe to China and Japan) and also UTF, so you get your contact information exactly how it should be on the phone.

The idea is you leave the app on the phone, it does not run or use any resources when not being used. And use the app again to reimport the CSV when it changes. winget-run-community:NirSoft.VideoCacheV.summary:

If the video file is stored in your browser's cache, this utility can help you to extract the video file from the cache and save it for watching it in the future.
It automatically scans the entire cache of Internet Explorer, Mozilla-based Web browsers (Including Firefox), Opera, and Chrome, and then finds all video files that are currently stored in it.
It allows you to easily copy the cached video files into another folder for playing/watching them in the future.
If you have a movie player that is configured to play flv files, it also allows you to play the video directly from your browser's cache.

 Using sub-sandboxing plus strong KVM isolation boundary
 Powerful, yet Unprivileged:
 Run containers effortlessly within a Bubble
 Bubbles runs as sandboxed, least-privilege Flatpak on any modern Linux (Opinionated distributions
 like Fedora Atomic and NixOS included)
 Immutable, yet Mutable:
 Includes Nix to enable version-controlled, reproducible work environments
 If Nix is too strict, fall back on Debian's apt or install any other package manager

flathub:dev.aunetx.deezer.name: Deezer
flathub:dev.aunetx.deezer.description:
An unofficial linux port of the deezer desktop application.
 Access all of your favorite music, and save them offline for later!

flathub:io.github.MrPiggy92.ScriptedJour.name: Scripted Journeys
flathub:io.github.MrPiggy92.ScriptedJour.description: Scripted Journeys is a text-based adventure game where players can explore various maps, solve puzzles, and embark on exciting quests. The game features rich storytelling and a variety of maps to choose from, offering a unique experience each time you play. Discover hidden secrets and unravel mysteries in this engaging adventure.

flathub:io.github.antimicrox.antimicrox.name: AntiMicroX
flathub:io.github.antimicrox.antimicrox.summary: Graphical program used to map gamepad buttons to keyboard, mouse, scripts and macros
flathub:io.github.antimicrox.antimicrox.description:
AntiMicroX is a graphical program used to map gamepad buttons/joysticks to keyboard, mouse,
 scripts and macros. It can be also used for generating SDL2 configuration (useful for mapping atypical
 gamepads to generic ones like xbox360).
 Features:
 Mapping of gamepads/joystick buttons to: ⌨️keyboard buttons, 🖱️mouse buttons and moves, scripts,
 executables and macros consisting of elements mentioned here.
 Assigning multiple switchable sets of mappings to gamepad.
 Auto profiles - assign profile to active application window.
 AntiMicroX was inspired by QJoyPad.

flathub:io.github.dagargo.Elektroid.name: Elektroid
flathub:io.github.dagargo.Elektroid.description:
Elektroid is a sample and MIDI device manager. It includes the `elektroid` GUI application and the `elektroid-cli` CLI application.
 Elektroid started as a FLOSS Elektron Transfer alternative and it has ended up supporting other devices from different vendors in the same fashion.
 These are the supported devices:
 Arturia MicroBrute
 Arturia MicroFreak
 Casio CZ-101
 Elektron Analog Four MKI, MKII and Keys
 Elektron Analog Heat MKI, MKII and +FX
 Elektron Analog Rytm MKI and MKII
 Elektron Digitakt I and II
 Elektron Digitone I and II and Digitone Keys
 Elektron Model:Cycles
 Elektron Model:Samples
 Elektron Monomachine MKII
 Elektron Syntakt
 Eventide ModFactor, PitchFactor, TimeFactor, Space and H9
 KORG padKONTROL
 KORG prologue, minilogue xd and NTS-1 (units only)
 KORG Volca Sample and Volca Sample 2
 Moog Little Phatty and Slim Phatty
 Novation Summit and Peak
 Samplers implementing MIDI SDS
 Other interesting features are:
 Autosampler with SFZ file generation
 Sample playback, recording and basic edition
 Sample loop points edition with zero crossing detection
 Sample tagging
 Sample zoom
 Search within devices
 SysEx transmission and reception

flathub:io.github.revisto.drum-machine.name: Drum Machine
flathub:io.github.revisto.drum-machine.description:
Drum Machine is a modern and intuitive application for creating, playing, and
 managing drum patterns. Perfect for musicians, producers, and anyone interested
 in rhythm creation, this application provides a simple interface for drum
 pattern programming. Have fun!
 Features:
 Intuitive grid-based pattern editor with infinite pages
 Custom samples: Add your own drum sounds with MIDI note mapping
 Adjustable BPM control
 Volume control for overall mix
 Save and load patterns
 Multiple drum sounds including kick, snare, hi-hat, and more
 Audio and MIDI export with support for WAV, FLAC, Ogg, MP3, and MIDI formats
 Metadata support for embedding artist name, song title, and cover art
 Keyboard shortcuts for quick access to all functions

flathub:io.github.trevorsandy.LPub3D.name: LPub3D
flathub:io.github.trevorsandy.LPub3D.summary: LPub3D - An LDraw Building Instruction Editor
flathub:io.github.trevorsandy.LPub3D.description:
LPub3D is an Open Source WYSIWYG editing application for creating
 LEGO® style digital building instructions. LPub3D is developed and
 maintained by Trevor SANDY. It uses the LDraw™ parts library, the
 most comprehensive library of digital Open Source LEGO® bricks
 available (www.ldraw.org/) and reads the LDraw LDR and MPD model
 file formats. LPub3D is available for free under the GNU Public License v3
 and runs on Windows, Linux and macOS Operating Systems.
 Portions of LPub3D are based on LPUB© 2007-2009 Kevin Clague,
 LeoCAD© 2025 Leonardo Zide and additional third party components.
 LEGO® is a trademark of the LEGO Group of companies which does not
 sponsor, authorize or endorse this application.
 © 2015-2025 Trevor SANDY.

flathub:io.itch.domestique_baston.errore.name: Errore 404: Sprint Non Trovato!
flathub:io.itch.domestique_baston.errore.summary: A glitchy, chaotic survival runner inspired by Tron (1982) and Cube (1997)
flathub:io.itch.domestique_baston.errore.description:
Four racers. One constantly shifting arena. No stopping, no turning back! Everything moves and
 changes. Nothing stays the same for long so hold on tight and keep running, jumping and sliding,
 because the MCP won't go easy on you!
 Survive long enough to reach the exit door (if you make it that far)!
 D.B.
 P.S.: By the way, the game is in Italian, but you don't really need to understand the language!

flathub:io.itch.tx00100xt.SeriousSamClas.name: SeriousSamClassic-VK
flathub:io.itch.tx00100xt.SeriousSamClas.description:
SeriousSamClassic-VK is open source game engine version developed by Croteam for Serious Sam Classic with Vulkan support, but it should work on (or be easily portable to) any system that supports Vulkan and SDL2.
 Note that while the Serious-Engine source code has been released under GPL, you still need to legally own the game and provide Serious Sam Classic The First Encounter and Serious Sam Classic The Second Encounter the game data to play. See the how to install section for more information.

flathub:io.kinvolk.Headlamp.name: Headlamp
flathub:io.kinvolk.Headlamp.summary: An easy-to-use and extensible web UI for Kubernetes
flathub:io.kinvolk.Headlamp.description:
Headlamp is an easy-to-use and extensible Kubernetes web UI.
 It was created to be a Kubernetes web UI that has the traditional
 functionality of other web UIs/dashboards available (i.e. to list and view
 resources) and extra functionality provided by plugins.

flathub:org.blue_nebula.BlueNebula.name: Blue Nebula
flathub:org.blue_nebula.BlueNebula.description:
Blue Nebula is a fun-filled new take on the first person arena shooter, built as a total conversion
 of Cube Engine 2, which lends itself toward a balanced gameplay, with a general theme of agility
 in a variety of environments. It features a unique parkour movement system.
 Cross-platform multiplayer
 Features parkour, impulse boosts, dashing, and other tricks
 Favourite gamemodes with an array of mutators and variables
 Built-in editor lets you create your own maps cooperatively online

fedora-packages:Judy/Judy.name: Judy
fedora-packages:Judy/Judy.description: Judy is a C library that provides a state-of-the-art core technology that implements a sparse dynamic array. Judy arrays are declared simply with a null pointer. A Judy array consumes memory only when it is populated, yet can grow to take advantage of all available memory if desired. Judy's key benefits are scalability, high performance, and memory efficiency. A Judy array is extensible and can scale up to a very large number of elements, bounded only by machine memory. Since Judy is designed as an unbounded array, the size of a Judy array is not pre-allocated but grows and shrinks dynamically with the array population.

firefox-addons:3003815.name: Stigma Privacy
firefox-addons:3003815.summary: See every tracker on every site in plain language. Block what you don't want. 100% local, open source.
firefox-addons:3003815.description:
See what's tracking you.
Stigma is a privacy extension that makes tracking visible, in plain language, and lets you do something about it. Open source, 100% local, honest about what it does and doesn't do.
WHAT STIGMA DOES
• Lists every tracker active on the page you are currently viewing
• Labels each one by company, product, category, and the specific types of data it collects
• Lets you block individual trackers or whole categories across every site
• Sends Global Privacy Control opt-out signals to sites that honor them
• Clears cookies and site data in one click
• Runs entirely in your browser. No accounts, no servers, no telemetry
WHY IT'S DIFFERENT
Most privacy tools pick a lane: block everything quietly, or explain everything at length. Stigma does neither. It shows you exactly what's happening, in language you can read, and lets you decide.
• Blocks tracking, not ads. When you block advertising trackers, some ads may fail to load as a side effect, but Stigma doesn't hide empty slots. For a full ad-free experience, pair it with a dedicated ad blocker.
• Plain language, not jargon. No "fingerprinting vectors" or "cross-domain request surfaces." Stigma describes what companies are doing in words you don't have to translate.
• Honest about limits. No tool can delete data companies already have or claw back profiles that brokers have already sold. What Stigma does is make today's tracking visible and stop new collection from piling on.
PRIVACY
Stigma collects no user data. No accounts, no servers, no telemetry. The extension runs entirely in your browser, ships with its tracker database built in, and does not communicate with any external service during normal operation. The full source code is public on GitHub, and you are welcome to audit it.
Full privacy policy: https://stigma.usual.systems/privacy
OPEN SOURCE
Stigma is licensed under GPL v3. The code is public at github.com/cpugs/stigma . Read it, audit it, or build your own copy.
BUILT BY USUAL SYSTEMS
Stigma is made by Usual Systems, an independent studio building transparent, useful tools. Learn more at usual.systems.

firefox-addons:3047214.name: WindowShoppings: Wishlist & Price Drop Alerts
firefox-addons:3047214.summary: A wishlist for window shopping online. Save products from almost any retailer, track price and availability changes, and organize with collections, tags, and target prices. Optional private sync lets you see your finds on any device.
firefox-addons:3047214.description:
The wishlist made for window shopping, with price drop alerts built in.
WindowShoppings keeps everything you find while window shopping online in one place. Save products from almost any online store with one click, sort them into wishlists, share them with friends and family, and let WindowShoppings watch the prices so you buy at the right time.
What it does
🛍 One wishlist for almost any store: one click saves a product's name, price, image, size, and color from almost any retailer.
🗂 Organize your way: sort saves into collections (birthday, home, gift ideas) and add notes and tags.
🎁 Share a wishlist: send a private link to a wishlist or selected items. Recipients see only the items you share; your notes, alerts, and account stay private, and you can revoke a link anytime. (Requires a free account.)
🔔 Price drop alerts: get notified when a saved item's price falls, or when it reaches a target price you set.
📉 Price tracker with history: prices are checked for you regularly, with a history chart for every product so you can see the trend before you buy.
📦 Restock alerts: save sold-out items and get notified when they're back in stock.
🔍 Search and compare: search across everything you've saved to compare options fast.
☁ Optional private sync: create a free account to back up your wishlist and view it on any device at windowshoppings.com . Fully opt-in; skip it and everything stays on your device.
📤 Import and export: your data is yours, exportable as JSON or CSV anytime.
⭐ Optional Premium: everything above is free. WindowShoppings Premium is an optional paid subscription, bought on windowshoppings.com , that raises the limits for collaborative collections you share with other signed-in users: up to 50 collections, each with up to 1,000 items and 26 members (5, 100 and 4 on the free plan).
Some retailers block automatic checks or hide prices, so those items stay saved but may not get automatic alerts. Checks run while your browser is open.
Private by design
No ads. No selling your data. Cloud sync is off until you choose to sign in, and your saved products go only to your own private account. Optional anonymous usage counts are off by default and contain no product details or URLs.
How it works
1. Install WindowShoppings.
2. Go window shopping on your favorite store and click save when something catches your eye.
3. Add it to a wishlist, set a target price if you like, and share it when you're ready.
4. We'll alert you when the price drops or the item restocks.
Start your wishlist today and let the deals come to you.

bluejetty:00160228:ios.description:
Learn and Sing Carnatic Songs with Instant/Tutor Feedback, Karaoke and Shruthi. Carnatic Singer helps you learn and sing Carnatic Music at your own pace, place and time! 
Carnatic Singer is for YOU, if you are:
Wanting to Learn Carnatic Music, but cannot commit to regular classes due to time constraints
Looking to Learn Carnatic music at your own pace
Learning Carnatic Music and looking for Practice Tools and Resources
Interested in learning specific Carnatic Songs to perform on Social or Religious occasions
A Carnatic Singer looking to Record with Karaoke and Share your singing
If you want to learn Carnatic music, with Carnatic Singer you can:
Learn and Practice Carnatic songs (Beginner, Intermediate and Advanced) using a Structured and Guided step-by-step approach
Understand the basic Concepts of Carnatic music which can help improve your Singing
Practice and Perfect your singing with Instant feedback on your Shruthi, Swarasthana and Thalam
Track your Learning Progress and Share your scores with your Tutor, family or friends
If you like singing Carnatic songs, Carnatic Singer helps you to:
Practice singing with Shruthi box that offers various Pitch options
Sing your favorite Songs in Karaoke style along with Tambura and Lyrics in multiple languages
Record and Share your Singing on Social Media
Carnatic Singer offers:
 Growing collection of Carnatic renditions in multiple languages (Tamil, Telugu, Kannada and Sanskrit)
 Concept Explanations using Interactive Multimedia Lessons, colourful graphics, kid-friendly Narrations and Quizzes
 Shruthi box with various Pitch options for Practice
 Comprehensive catalogue of Ragams, Thalams and Lessons (Sarali sequences, Alankaaram etc.) with tools for practice
 Interactive and Engaging Learning Experience with Instant Feedback, Notations and Scores
 One of its kind, Carnatic Karaoke feature for singing or playing your instrument with hints and accompaniments
Detailed Features:
 Easy and Familiar Interface to Browse/Search the Library of Songs by Level, Language, Ragam, Thalam, Composer etc.
 View Lyrics for Songs in both English and the original language along with Notations
 Listen to Aarohanam/Avarohanam of 180+ Ragams
 View and Practice the hand gestures for 40+ Thalams
 Learn any Song/Lesson using a step-by-step Guided approach that helps you sing at the right pitch and rhythm
 Personalized Voice Guide that matches your pitch to help you learn effectively
 Get Instant and Detailed feedback as you sing, with Scores to know how you are improving
 Sing in Karaoke style with Lyrics, Shruthi and Beats, Record your Singing and Share with friends and family
 Practice with Tambura Shruthi
 Bookmark your Favorite Songs for easier access

bluejetty:00174338:ios.description:
No subscriptions - Buy once, keep forever on all devices
Elevate your productivity and organization with Solid Calendar – the all-in-one solution for managing your time, tasks, and events seamlessly. Whether you're a busy professional, a student juggling classes, or anyone looking to make the most of every day, this app offers the perfect blend of a calendar planner, rotating schedule manager, digital organizer and reminders manager.
Are you ready to reclaim your time and enjoy a more organized lifestyle? Download this calendar app now and manage your schedule, tasks, and events with ease.
Key Features of Solid Calendar:
- Add events with natural language
Isn't it so much easier when our devices understand us? You can say things like:
"Pick up the kids tomorrow at 18:00"
"Lunch this Saturday between 12:00 and 14:00"
"Meet with Bill in 2 hours"
- Calendar planner
Stay on top of your schedule effortlessly with this intuitive calendar interface. Plan events, set reminders, and never miss appointments again. With a user-friendly design, adding and managing events is a breeze, ensuring you're always in control of your time with this natural language calendar. For those with complex rotating schedules, this app is also a great fit. Whether you are in healthcare, public safety, or any other profession with rotating shifts, this app adapts to your unique needs. See your rotation patterns and stay informed about your upcoming schedule with Solid Calendar.
- Digital planner
Say goodbye to traditional paper planners! This digital planner allows you to create, organize, and track tasks. Prioritize tasks, set due dates, and get a clear overview of your to-do list. With synchronization across devices, this planner is accessible anytime, anywhere.
- 6 different layouts
With Solid Calendar you can find the layout that suits your needs best on each device
- Quick Join for video calls
You will find options to jump straight into events that have video calls both from the app itself and from notifications
- Reminders
Your Reminders can live alongside your events in all layouts. You can also create and edit reminders.
- Use the calendars on your device
Solid Calendar works with the calendars you already have on your device. No data about your calendars leaves your device, so you can have peace of mind about your privacy
- Light and Dark mode
Enjoy well designed themes for both light and dark mode and pick the one you like best to accommodate your style.
- Seamless integration
This app easily syncs with all your device's calendars, ensuring that your events and appointments will be scheduled into a routine calendar. You'll never have to stress about missing an essential occasion. All your data remains up-to-date.
- Smart reminders
Stay on track with smart notifications and reminders. Customize when you will be notified about upcoming events, tasks, or shifts. So, you will be prepared for what's next.
- Data security
Your privacy is the top priority. This app is designed with advanced security measures to protect your sensitive information. Enjoy the convenience of a digital planner without compromising your data. Your events and reminders remain on your device, they are never uploaded to any third party servers.
Cross-device sync
Access your schedule and tasks from any iOS device. Whether using your iPhone or iPad, you'll always have your planner at your fingertips.
Are you ready to get on top of your schedule? Solid Calendar is a universal app available on iOS, iPadOS, and macOS
You can choose to unlock just this app or all 5 Solid Apps with one purchase
Terms of service: http://solidapps.co/terms.html
Privacy policy: http://solidapps.co/privacy.html

bluejetty:00178614:ios.description:
Try the Alphabet game for little kids to turn learning ABC into a fun and rewarding process!
ABC for kids is an educational game with “trace a letter” mechanics - learn the letters one by one and enjoy a fabulous story!
A wonderful alternative activity for learning letters for toddlers. Preparing for school hasn’t been so easy with digital playing:)
You are going on an exciting journey! Oh, look, the wind is so strong - it has blown the letters away from the book! Investigate where the Alphabet ABCs got and find them all! You will have to save the letters and return to their places. They can be found in the lake, in the house and even in the galaxy!
The toddler alphabet game easily encourages your baby to learn and differentiate letters, as well as develop memory and fine motor skills as it has very beautiful and fascinating tasks for tapping and tracing. Indeed, study can bring joy and our ABC will help in pronouncing and memorizing letters! 
Classic features:
- Trace the letters with fingers while soaping and washing them - remember the lines - learn easily with educational games!
- Train logic and attention with kindergarten learning games. Find the letters in unexpected places. Visit volcanoes and dive into waters, enter a witch’s house and climb into the bird’s nest - these are the places where you need to find the characters.
- Go through an exciting tutorial with wonderful tasks in the learning games for kids. Flashcards and entertaining exercises are at their duty to make the kids giggle and be absorbed into the learning process!
- Enjoy bright and saturated colors of all characters and be pleasantly captivated with the kindergarten learning games - you know all the letters in the blink of an eye!

bluejetty:00027250:ios.name: Philips Air+
bluejetty:00027250:ios.summary:
Together with your connected Philips Air device, Air+ provides a smart experience that ensures you breathe clean and healthy air.
The app keeps track of all indoor and outdoor pollutants and automatically adjust your device’s performance,
bluejetty:00027250:ios.description:
Together with your connected Philips Air device, Air+ provides a smart experience that ensures you breathe clean and healthy air.
The app keeps track of all indoor and outdoor pollutants and automatically adjust your device’s performance, so you don’t have to. Air+ keeps you in control, at home or away, with a device remote and notifications about all your air concerns including pollutants, allergies and gas. And by staying in the know with insights into your air quality data from past to present, you are in full control of breathing the clean, healthy air you deserve.
Auto Plus mode - the smartest way to clean air
Once you activate Auto Plus mode in the Air+ app, your indoor air will automatically be cleaned to 
keep pollutants at bay. This Self-adaptive Technology, powered by Artificial Intelligence, considers 
the readings of the smart sensors, room size, outdoor data and behavioral patterns to maximize 
performance. 
Disclaimer: Auto Plus mode will be released in winter 2022 for most Philips Air devices.
Get to the core of air quality
Thanks to the smart device sensors, Air+ provides you with real-time, indoor air quality data. Ranging from high-level snapshots to detailed views, all data is available to you up until a year ago. More information about each pollutant and their causes are included so you can make well informed decisions about your indoor air.
In full control of your air, at home or away
Air+ features a built-in remote so you are in full control of your device’s performance. Seamlessly 
switch between different modes, fan speeds and other features to tailor the device settings to your 
needs. Great for turning your device off when you’re away or on when you’re heading home, or to
make changes without being near your Air device.
Easy upkeep for maximized output
Air+ tracks when it’s time to clean or replace certain parts of you Air device to make sure it runs at 
peak performance. Messaging and notifications alert you when the low-effort maintenance should 
be taken care of, and Air+ has step-by-step instructions handy if you need them. Plus, in most cases, 
you can buy new filters straight from the app.
A holistic air quality experience with outdoor data
As outdoor air quality can have a big impact on the indoor levels, Air+ includes a comprehensive 
overview of real-time outdoor readings. Additionally, Air+ provides a quick snapshot of the current 
weather at each location. You can add up to five cities to keep you in the know about the air quality 
conditions near and far.
Air+ also supports a smarter experience with Philips Robot Vacuum Cleaners.

bluejetty:00150792:ios.description:
Pernia's Pop-Up Shop, one of India's leading multi-designer platforms, houses top industry names & budding labels all under one roof. It's a one-stop-shop for all your luxury fashion & lifestyle needs & aims at bringing premium designer wear from across the country to the audience with ease. The website & offline stores are curated to give customers a shopping experience that is hassle-free & fits every taste. 
Purple Style Labs is the luxury fashion house that comprises Pernia's Pop-Up Shop, a premium platform for multiple design labels. The idea is to sell not just a product but also an experience that the shopper will remember, thus giving its audience top-notch clothing, accessories and decor that will uniquely transform their wardrobe & home. One can find their favourite luxury brands as well as discover niche labels to love through the platform. 
The Pernia's Pop-Up Shop app is here to add a golden touch to your mobile phone! Discover exclusive deals, designer collections, and much more right from your 5-inch screen. Stay updated with the latest in fashion with the Pernia's Pop-Up Blog, now only a click away.
Wedding-goers or to-be-married couples can shop premium men's & women's clothing according to occasions, style, or budget on Wedding Studio. Easily access engagement, cocktail, wedding & reception looks from labels like 
Manish Malhotra
Tarun Tahiliani, 
Anita Dongre, 
Gaurav Gupta
Anamika Khanna
Jayanti Reddy, 
RI Ritu Kumar, 
Payal Singhal and MANY more. 
Spruce up your living space with premium home decor items. From exquisite urlis, compliment-worthy dinner sets, soothing scented candles to stylish rugs that liven up your space; there's a lot more to pick. Top designer labels like Karo, Artychoke, Veda Homes, Jaipur Rugs, Assemblage, Shaze among others are the ones that will add a unique touch to your home. 
Get your hands on jewellery that will elevate your look. Shop Necklaces, Earrings, Bracelets, Rings, etc. from designer labels like Vastraa Jewellery, Zariin, Tsara, Outhouse, Aster & more. These collections are absolute favourites for weddings, festivities, pre-wedding celebrations and parties too. If you need outfit inspiration, simply search under the 'Shop By Look' option.
You're sure to find the perfect accessories to add to your outfit! Shop designer bags from Ritu Kumar, AMPM, etc. or blingy clutches from Rocky Star & Lovetobag. Get your hands on scarves/shawls, footwear and much more when you explore the Accessories tab on the app. 
Enjoy instant shopping for your little ones too with the newly launched kids' clothing from sought-after designer labels like Free Sparrow, Pink Cow, Little Secrets and more. 
Find something to flaunt at parties, at work or for casual outings. Pernia's Pop-Up Shop houses the best designer wear from Indian labels like Manish Arora, Masaba, Rishi & Vibhuti, Urvashi Kaur, Ka-Sha, & many more. Explore contemporary pieces made to stun! 
Explore designer collections across several categories like:
Clothing: Styles for men, women & kids including wedding & festive wear. 
Accessories: Stunning footwear, bags, belts, hair accessories, etc. from top designers.
Jewellery: Fine jewellery, festive pieces and contemporary designs to flaunt. 
Home Decor: Rugs, paintings, cushion sets, dinner sets & much more. 
Safety Essentials: Designer masks and other wellness products to pick from.
An easy & luxe online shopping experience. 
-600+ Indian designers.
-One app, several choices across womenswear, menswear, kidswear, jewellery, accessories & home decor. 
-Price Match Promise, so you get the best deals only!
-Safe & secure payment methods for effortless checkout. 
-24x7 customer support tending to every query!
-Personal styling suggestions for an enhanced experience.
-Shop what you loved from our Instagram feed on our mobile app.
-Shop by occasion or look. 
Checkout with 100% secure payment modes. Go ahead and buy all you can, with amazing offers and stellar discounts!

bluejetty:00023716:ios.name: دليل الهاتف السعودي
bluejetty:00023716:ios.summary:
دليل الهاتف السعودي — كاشف الأرقام وكشف المكالمات المزعجة
اعرف من المتصل قبل أن ترد! «دليل الهاتف السعودي» هو تطبيقك الذكي للتعرّف على المتصلين، كشف الأرقام المزعجة والاحتيالية، والبحث عن أي رقم هاتف خلال ثوانٍ — بواجهة عربية سهلة وسريعة.
bluejetty:00023716:ios.description:
دليل الهاتف السعودي — كاشف الأرقام وكشف المكالمات المزعجة
اعرف من المتصل قبل أن ترد! «دليل الهاتف السعودي» هو تطبيقك الذكي للتعرّف على المتصلين، كشف الأرقام المزعجة والاحتيالية، والبحث عن أي رقم هاتف خلال ثوانٍ — بواجهة عربية سهلة وسريعة.
 كشف الأرقام والتعرّف على المتصل
ابحث عن أي رقم هاتف واحصل فوراً على تقرير كامل: هوية المتصل، شركة الاتصال، نوع الخط (جوّال أو أرضي)، الدولة والمنطقة والمدينة، والمزيد.
 كشف المكالمات المزعجة والاحتيال (سبام)
لكل رقم درجة خطورة دقيقة تكشف المكالمات المزعجة والمحتالة قبل أن ترد — احمِ نفسك وعائلتك من أرقام النصب والإزعاج.
 التعرّف على المتصل وحظر المزعجين
فعّل خدمة التعرّف على المتصل من إعدادات الهاتف ليظهر تنبيه «مكالمة مزعجة» عند اتصال الأرقام المشبوهة، مع إمكانية حظر الأرقام المزعجة — كل ذلك يعمل بخصوصية تامة دون الوصول إلى مكالماتك.
 الأماكن القريبة منك
اكتشف المطاعم والكافيهات والحدائق والكثير من الأماكن من حولك، واعرف ساعات العمل ورقم الهاتف والموقع على الخريطة.
 اشتراك VIP
• بحث غير محدود للأرقام
• تجربة بدون إعلانات
• مزايا حصرية وأولوية في الدعم
لماذا «دليل الهاتف السعودي»؟
- نتائج سريعة ودقيقة
- قاعدة بيانات محدثة باستمرار
- واجهة عربية بسيطة
- يحترم خصوصيتك بالكامل
كاشف الأرقام، معرفة المتصل، اسم المتصل، من المتصل، كشف المزعجين، حظر المكالمات المزعجة، أرقام النصب والاحتيال، البحث عن رقم، دليل أرقام، سبام، Caller ID.
—
الاشتراك (VIP):
تتوفر خطط اشتراك شهرية، وكل 3 أشهر، وكل 6 أشهر، وسنوية. يتم تحصيل قيمة الاشتراك عبر حساب App Store، ويتجدد تلقائياً ما لم يتم إيقاف التجديد قبل 24 ساعة على الأقل من نهاية الفترة الحالية. يمكنك إدارة اشتراكك أو إلغاؤه من إعدادات حسابك في App Store بعد الشراء.
روابط قانونية:
• سياسة الخصوصية: https://mohaisentech.com/privacy-policy-ar.html
• شروط الاستخدام (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00066478:ios.description:
New to crypto? Start here - with the steps you already take.
Sweat Wallet is the crypto wallet built for beginners: free to start, nothing to buy. Every verified step turns into $SWEAT, a real cryptocurrency you own and can trade or cash out. No NFTs, no jargon, no experience needed - just walk, earn and build a portfolio across 5 blockchains.
Real crypto for real steps - not a mining game, not a faucet. Steps are verified through our partner app Sweatcoin, so the $SWEAT you earn is real, tradable crypto. Join 20M+ $SWEAT token holders worldwide.
THE EASY WAY INTO CRYPTO
- Start in one tap with your Apple account - no seed phrase, no deposit, no catch
- Steps are counted by Sweatcoin, the free step-counter app - connect it once and every step earns automatically
- Learn crypto as you earn and use it - short lessons, with rewards when you finish
- Questions? Ask Mia, the AI guide inside the app - plain answers, any time
YOUR STEPS EARN YOU $SWEAT
- Get paid to walk with every real step - the more you walk, the more you earn
- Go further with Sweat Max: earn from far more of your daily steps, 2x rewards and no ads
YOUR JARS KEEP EARNING WHILE YOU REST
- Grow Jars (our staking product): put your $SWEAT to work for daily rewards - up to 10% on your daily steps, up to 20% with Sweat Max. Rates vary and are never guaranteed
- Keep a daily streak for bonus rewards, so your balance grows even on quiet days
FREE FLIP & SPIN. NOTHING TO BUY.
- Top up your daily earnings with quests, quizzes and games
- Invite a friend to get rewarded for walking - you both earn $SWEAT
WANT BITCOIN? YOU CAN AFFORD IT NOW.
- Your $SWEAT is the engine: use it to add Bitcoin, Ethereum, stablecoins and thousands of other tokens to your portfolio - or buy directly in the app, at your own pace
ONE WALLET, ONE KEY, 5 BLOCKCHAINS
- A multichain, non-custodial wallet for NEAR, Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum and BNB Chain (BSC)
- Send, receive, buy, trade and bridge tokens - hold BTC, ETH, BNB and more, WalletConnect-ready
- The network fee? Your steps covered it: pay fees with $SWEAT, watch an ad, or pay nothing on NEAR
CASH OUT WHEN YOU WANT
- Turn your $SWEAT into stablecoins, BTC, ETH and more, then move it to an exchange to cash out to your local currency
ALREADY ON SWEATCOIN?
Sweat Wallet is the home for your Sweatcoin steps - connect Sweatcoin in one tap and start earning $SWEAT.
HOW IT WORKS
1. Download Sweat Wallet (free) and start walking
2. Connect the free Sweatcoin app - verified steps turn into $SWEAT automatically
3. Learn crypto basics with quests and quizzes while you earn
4. Grow your balance in Grow Jars, or trade across 5 chains
5. Add Bitcoin or any token when you are ready, and cash out any time
FAQ
Is Sweat Wallet good for beginners? Yes - it is built to be your first crypto wallet. You earn your first tokens by walking instead of buying them, so you learn how crypto works with nothing at stake.
Is it really free? Yes - you can start with no money. Sweat Max is an optional subscription that boosts earnings and removes ads, never a requirement.
Do I need another app? Yes, one: steps are counted by Sweatcoin, the free step-counter. Connect it once - after that, earning is automatic.
How much will I earn? It depends on how much you walk and on $SWEAT's market price - it is a real token, so its value moves up and down. Treat it as a growing stake in crypto, not a salary.
Is my crypto safe? You start protected by your Apple account; add a secret recovery phrase for full self-custody when you are ready.
What's the catch? None - and we never sell your data. Sweat Wallet earns through partnerships, ads and an optional subscription.
$SWEAT is listed on Kraken, Bitget, Bitvavo, Uniswap, Near.com, Rhea Finance and more.
Start walking. Start earning. Take your first step into crypto - download Sweat Wallet today. Learn more at https://swe.at
EULA: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00131913:ios.description:
Turn you iPhone or iPod touch into a full featured Car DVR recorder at a fraction of the cost of the standalone device. Whenever you commute to work, go on a road trip or race on a race track, car camera is your ideal companion. Record HD definition videos while driving with embedded data about time, location** and speed**.
Car camera is the only app in App Store that is capable of recording high quality HD driving videos with data overlay.
Features:
Record videos with resolutions 640х480, 1280х720, 1920х1080, 4K* and up to 60 FPSl
Embed data overlay into videos: current time, speed, coordinates, heading
Record audio
Metric and English units
Continuous loop recording. Older videos are overridden by newer ones to preserve space on the device
Store recorded videos within the application
Video Playback within the application or with AirPlay enabled devices
Car Camera DVR is a freemium Ad Supported app. With a freemium version only 2 video segments can be recorded in a loop and recorded videos can only be played back within the app. 
SUBSCRIPTION INFORMATION
Car Camera DVR offers a subscription plan that lets you record unlimited number video segments, turn off in-app advertisements and export and share recorded videos outside the app.
• Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase
• Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period
• Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal
• Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase
• Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable
Privacy Policy: http://appannex.com/privacy-policy/
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
*4K video is available for iPhone 7 and later models
**GPS capability required to record Speed, Heading and Location data

bluejetty:00185069:ios.description:
Get ready for March Madness Live on the Official App of the NCAA Division I Men's Basketball Tournament. 
Watch NCAA Men’s live college basketball games, highlights, in-depth analyses, classic games and more on demand with NCAA March Madness Live. You'll get access to exclusive NCAA March Madness content as you prepare for the Selection Show on March 15 at 6PM ET on CBS. 
Keep up with every NCAA March Madness game. College basketball games are just a tap away – watch NCAA Men's basketball games live on your Apple device starting March 17. Enjoy games on TBS, TNT, truTV, and CBS! 
Compete in the Capital One NCAA March Madness Men’s and Women's Bracket Challenge – use the bracket creator and lock in your brackets to play. 
After Selection Sunday, tune in and stream your picks’ games as they happen; keep up with live college basketball scores and watch highlights at any time. Get personalized bracket alerts and daily results, stream NCAA Men’s basketball games and find out how you rank. 
With NCAA March Madness Live, you’ll never miss a game-changing moment. Follow all the latest in NCAA Men's basketball scores and updates. 
Download NCAA March Madness Live today! 
= NCAA March Madness Live Features = 
Stream Live Men’s NCAA Basketball Games: 
• Watch DI Men's Basketball Championship live and catch all 67 games across TBS, TNT, truTV and CBS starting March 17 on your Apple devices 
• Watch 2, 3 or 4x the madness with the all-new Multi-Game; stream two games simultaneously on your iPhone device, or up to four on your iPad or Mac device!
• AirPlay live basketball games and VOD to your TV 
• Live games and video are only available in the US, its Territories and Bermuda 
Watch March Madness Fast Break: 
• Catch all the biggest basketball moments from the first and second rounds 
• Watch live college basketball games with all-around coverage 
• Get exclusive live look-ins at the biggest basketball games 
• Watch March Madness highlights instantly 
• Live college basketball game commentary & analysis throughout March Madness 
Never Miss a Moment: 
• Listen to live radio broadcasts of all 67 games on Apple CarPlay using the all-new Sports Mode
• Watch March Madness Live exclusive VOD content - classic games, in-depth analysis, highlights, and behind-the-scenes features 
• Get March Madness Live basketball game notifications for upsets, overtime games, close games, and your favorite college basketball teams 
• Scores tab gives you conference and NCAA tournament scores, stats, and the Official Bracket 
• Follow current scores right from your lock screen using Live Scoreboard 
Play the Capital One NCAA March Madness Men’s and Women's Bracket Challenge: 
• Fill out your brackets by March 19 (Men's) & March 20 (Women's) to play with millions of other fans like you 
• Challenge your friends & family in public and private groups 
• Use Matchup Analysis to get an edge when filling out your bracket 
• Compete against celebrities to see who has the best bracket 
• Get personalized bracket alerts 
• View your picks right from the Home page 
• Follow your bracket standings right from your lock screen using all-new Live Activities
Watch on Apple TV: 
• Live stream games on Apple TV after games start on March 17 
• Use your device to stream up to four games at once with Multi-Game 
• Register your college basketball tournament bracket on mobile and watch your picks play on TV 
• Watch DI Men's Basketball Championship games & on-demand content any time 
*Use the mobile tournament bracket maker, enter the Capital One NCAA March Madness Men’s and Women's Bracket Challenge, watch live games and follow every development in the tournament – download NCAA March Madness Live to experience all things March Madness!

Ask anything and get real answers. Turn photos into highlight reels, posters, and cards in a tap. Summarize a long PDF or pull the key details out of a screenshot. Search, create, and get things done — all in one place, without leaving the app.
[NEW] AI Study: Turn Files into Notes & Quizzes

Drop in a file and get clear structured notes in seconds — or record a lecture or meeting live and let AI listen and take the notes for you. Then quiz yourself, review with flashcards, and see how the ideas connect on a mind map. Less time organizing, more time understanding.

Automatically back up your photos, videos, documents and even folders to TeraBox cloud storage. Keep everything synchronized and accessible from any mobile device or computer — wherever you are.
Ultra-Large File Transfer
Upload, store, and share big files up to 128 GB seamlessly. Whether you need to send big video files, massive document archives, or high-res media, TeraBox supports big file sharing quickly with a secure link. No size limits holding you back.
AI-Powered Search
Built-in AI browser lets you search smarter instantly. Quickly find what you need, watch trending videos, discover the latest movies, or follow hot topics—all within TeraBox. Search, browse, and watch, all in one place.
AI Image Creation & Editing
Transform your photos into AI art with just one tap. Try creative AI styles like Snoopy, Miyazaki, or Cyberpunk, or enhance your portraits with built-in beauty effects.
AI Video Generation
Turn your ideas or photos into creative videos in seconds. Choose from a variety of dynamic effects to quickly generate viral videos for social media, promos, or personal projects.
AI Transcription
Convert voice to text. Record live and see the transcript appear as you speak, or upload any audio or video file. Get accurate, readable transcripts with key points summarized automatically — saving you hours of manual note-taking.
HD Video Player + AI Subtitles
Enjoy smooth, high-definition video playback within TeraBox. Our AI automatically generates accurate subtitles for lectures, foreign films, or personal videos, making it easier to follow and understand every word.
AI Scanning & PDF Document Management
Quickly scan multiple documents and edit your PDFs easily. TeraBox automatically recognizes text, helping you organize and clean up digital files.
Other Advanced AI Tools
Explore more built-in AI features such as AI Sketch, handwriting removal, translation, and image compression. TeraBox is your ultimate AI toolbox for every daily need.
HIGHLIGHTS
- 1024GB Free Storage: Safely back up millions of photos, videos, and documents.
- Large File Uploads & Sharing: Easily send big files to anyone via secure links.
- Privacy Protection: Advanced encryption keeps all your files safe.
- Multi-Device Sync: Access and sync all your files from any computer, tablet, or mobile phone.
- Intelligent Albums: Auto-categorize your photos for quick and easy browsing.
Sign up for TeraBox now to get 1TB of free cloud storage and enjoy a powerful portable AI assistant!

bluejetty:00030602:ios.description:
Christmas is the perfect time for engaging activities like coloring. With the advent of digital technology, Christmas coloring books have evolved into interactive pages and apps that bring fun and joy to people of all ages. Tap games and coloring apps like Colorfy provide an entertaining and educational experience for kids, toddlers, and adults alike. These apps offer a wide array of digital art tools and color-by-number features, promoting not just fun but also artistic expression and color therapy.
Happy Color is one such app that has gained popularity, allowing users to create digital artworks and even compile them into a personalized book. With features like rewards, it encourages children to learn and explore their artistic abilities. ASMR games integrated into these apps help users relax, providing an avenue for stress relief and a calming atmosphere.
The Christmas season sees a surge in demand for these coloring apps as people seek creative ways to celebrate. They not only make for excellent Christmas gifts but also serve as a delightful addition to the Christmas wishlist, often adorned with Christmas-themed wallpapers, from Santa to Christmas puzzles and intricate color matching challenges.
The holiday spirit extends to encompass various cultural aspects, with Christmas-themed bells, pango trains, dollhouses, and playhouses adding to the festive atmosphere. Decorations like Christmas trees and ornaments become subjects for digital art, allowing users to create their own personalized renditions.
Moreover, these apps serve as a medium for learning, with art books and coloring books teaching children about different cultures and traditions. The color-matching exercises and coloring activities foster cognitive development, making the learning process enjoyable and interactive.
• Weekly ($2.99), Monthly ($5.99), and Yearly ($39.99) duration

• Current subscription may not be cancelled during the active subscription period; however, you can manage your subscription and/or turn off auto-renewal by visiting your iTunes Account Settings after purchase• Privacy policy and terms of use visit our website :In essence, the evolution of Christmas coloring books into digital apps has not only transformed the way people engage with art but has also revolutionized the gifting culture during the festive season. It provides a platform for both entertainment and education, enabling individuals to tap into their creativity and immerse themselves in the Christmas spirit.

"Bobby’s Burgers is the ultimate burger experience co-founded by renowned chef Bobby Flay. As a reflection of his successful 40-plus year career in the restaurant industry, Flay has handcrafted every single ingredient and menu item to create both a craveable and approachable “Flay For All” experience.
Uncompromising with our ingredients, Chef’s recipes are built upon fresh, never-frozen 100% Certified Angus Beef, hand-battered to order fresh chicken breast, and our Beat Bobby Flay® winning veggie burger. Complemented by our one-of-a-kind premium milkshakes, buttermilk onion rings, crisp French fries, and mouth-watering sauces made from the culinary genius of Bobby Flay. Our exclusive burger recipes include the Crunchburger®, Bacon Crunchburger®, Nacho Burger, Brunch Burger and more.
Bobby’s Burgers differentiates itself in the competitive burger, QSR, and fast causal categories with a proof of concept that leans into offering our guests a consistently elevated burger quality and restaurant experience.
Bobby craves just one thing when he’s done working in the kitchen of his many fine dining restaurants. And it’s not what you might expect. It's a burger."

Over 3 million downloads worldwide!
Over 1000 quests and over 30 stages for you to enjoy!
Come and experience the very best in Mushroom Gardening!

---------------------------------------
What is “Mushroom Garden”?
Featuring the lovable Funghi character from Japan, the “Mushroom Garden” series has received over 50 million downloads worldwide.
From the cute Funghi covering your screen to the satisfaction of harvesting dozens of Funghi with one swipe, our apps are fun and enjoyable for all ages.
---------------------------------------
-Over 1000 quests to challenge!
The most content yet in the “Mushroom Garden” series!
With over 1000 quests (In-game name: Order/Order+) covering every stage and Funghi, you can enjoy mushroom gardening any way you want.
By clearing quests, you unlock even more stages to explore, more Funghi to harvest, and more quests to challenge!
With special holiday and season-themed events, you can enjoy “NEO Mushroom Garden” for every occasion!
-Over 30 unique and colorful stages!
Starting from the classic Mushroom Garden stage, expand your garden to a wide variety of locations, such as your school, hot spring, or even above the clouds!
Not only does the scenery change, the Funghi you can find changes too!
New stages (In-game name: Themes) are constantly being added, so you’ll never know what kinds of Funghi you’ll discover next!
-New Skill: Grow Funghi instantly!
Mushroom gardening can take time, but with this new secret medicine you can grow Funghi instantly!
Take advantage of this new skill and harvest Funghi more efficiently than ever!
-Simple to use, difficult to master? New “Funghi Food”!
With a tap of a button, feed your Funghi and watch them grow!
By upgrading your food machine and using different parts, you can create different kinds of food with various effects.
Some Funghi only grow when given the correct kind of food, so try different combinations and find the perfect recipe for you!

FOX Weather is ready for whatever the
bluejetty:00073543:ios.description:
Download FOX Weather to get the updates you need, straight from America’s Weather team. Forecast ten days or ten months in advance, customize your locations, and chase the storm with 3D radar tracking.
FOX Weather is ready for whatever the weather brings—rain or shine. Live stream news, get severe weather alerts or track local conditions, including UV index, sunset/sunrise times, and feels-like temp. How?
3D Radar
• Go inside the eye of the storm with our exclusive 3D mobile radar, including both national and local high-resolution views.
• Zoom, tilt, or swipe to look at the storm from any angle you choose and switch between 3D and 2D maps.
Forecasts
• Check the forecast for today or 14 days from now.
• Hour-by-hour breakdown for the next 48 hours.
• Schedule your wedding, vacation, or family reunion with long-range forecasting, with alerts about changes in the forecast as they happen.
Location Customization
• Rename locations that matter to you—customize with names including “Stephanie’s house” or favorite vacation spots, like “Ski Heaven.”
Alerts
• Push notifications give you the updates you need—when you need them. Plus, toggle between Fahrenheit and Celsius for international weather.
• Subscribe to severe weather alerts and get notified about extreme or dangerous conditions.
• Choose between hourly, daily, and historical views for any location worldwide.
• Use widgets for an at-a-glance way to check the weather, with colors and icons that change depending on what’s going on outside.
Live Streaming News
• Tap into live streaming, on-demand forecasts, severe weather video clips, and more.
• Delve into every angle of the story with over 100 meteorologists and firsthand FOX professionals.
• Follow the storm, hurricane, tornado, or cyclone as it drifts across local, national, and international maps.
• Stay safe with real-time updates about cold weather including rain, wind, and snow.
• Be prepared for anything from heat waves to blizzards.
• Get more than just a barometer read with reports on the humidity, UV index, and reports about thunder and lightning during storm surges.
• Explore editor’s picks, lifestyle stories, videos of the earth and space, and discover new facts from the Learn section of the News tab.
Feels-Like Temperature
• Do you need a jacket today? Choose between actual temperatures and feels-like temperatures to find out.
Weather Articles
• Read about the top weather stories worldwide from our team of Digital Meteorologists, reporting on the biggest weather news around the clock from the FOX Forecast Center.
Sunrise and Sunset Times
• Use the dusk and dawn predictors for that perfect sunrise hike or romantic sunset dinner.
Wind speed and gusts
• Don’t let gusts blow you off your feet, with details including the wind speed and wind advisories.
UV Index
• Find out what days you need an extra layer of sunscreen.
America’s Weather Team
• Meet the meteorologists who bring you the research, personality, and education that makes them our top field and studio correspondents.
• Dive into analysis and coverage that break down even the most complicated weather patterns.
Cloud Cover
• Don’t let clouds get in your way. Get details about how hazy the day will be.
Air Quality Data
• Breathe easy with reports about how clean the air is today.
Weather apps can be a whirlwind. Get the FOX Weather App for 24/7 forecasts, news, and storm watches. FOX Weather—weathering it together.
Visit https://www.foxweather.com/terms-of-use for more information.

bluejetty:00154312:ios.description:
Discover tranquility with Zen Tiles: Mahjong Triple Match, where peaceful tile matching meets strategic puzzle mastery in a beautifully crafted experience designed for iOS.
MINDFUL BRAIN TRAINING
Exercise your cognitive skills while enjoying a calming atmosphere. Our unique triple-matching puzzles are designed to improve memory, focus, and strategic thinking with every satisfying match you make.
ELEGANT DESIGN FOR iOS
Experience stunning visuals optimized for your iPhone and iPad. The intuitive touch controls and fluid animations make every interaction feel natural and responsive, leveraging the power of iOS to create a seamless gameplay experience.
THOUSANDS OF PUZZLES
Journey through 10,000+ meticulously designed mahjong puzzles with increasing complexity. Each board features unique patterns that test your matching skills in new ways.
TRIPLE MATCH MECHANICS
Master the art of connecting three identical mahjong tiles to clear the board. Our refined triple match system delivers a satisfying and strategic experience that's easy to learn but challenging to master.
CREATE YOUR ZEN SANCTUARY
Watch your personal meditation island grow and evolve as you complete puzzles. Each level adds new elements to your serene retreat, creating a visual representation of your progress.
STRATEGIC POWER-UPS
Overcome challenging situations with thoughtfully designed boosters that enhance your abilities. Use these special tools wisely to conquer even the most complex configurations.
OPTIMIZED FOR YOUR LIFESTYLE
- Play offline – no internet connection required
- Designed for quick sessions or extended gameplay
- Haptic feedback provides a tactile experience
- Optimized for all screen sizes from iPhone to iPad Pro
FOR PLAYERS OF ALL LEVELS
Whether you're new to mahjong or a seasoned expert, our carefully crafted difficulty curve ensures continuous challenge and engagement.
REGULAR CONTENT UPDATES
Discover new puzzle boards, tile designs, and seasonal themes with our monthly updates. Your mahjong journey never ends!
Immerse yourself in a meditative retreat with each puzzle you solve. The soothing color palette, gentle animations, and peaceful soundtrack transform each session into a moment of mindfulness.
Download Zen Tiles: Mahjong Triple Match today and find your center through the art of the triple tile match!

bluejetty:00014252:ios.description:
Greetly is the only fully customizable and touchless visitor management system serving enterprise and SMB clients across the globe. Greetly's digital receptionist app manages visiting customers, vendors, interview candidates, deliveries, facility tours, scheduled entries and exits and more. This modernization to office reception capabilities results in significant time and money savings for Greetly clients. The technology - which provides instant visitor notifications, collects e-signatures, and prints visitor badges – can be branded and customized to the unique needs of each work environment. Greetly’s solutions are used by several brands including DHL, the Dallas Cowboys, Office Evolution, Randstad, and the United States Air Force.
NO-TOUCH
Greetly’s “no-touch” visitor sign-in keeps your workplace healthy and productive. Visitors can check into your office, shared workspace, production facility and more without touching a shared kiosk.
FULLY LOADED
From instant visitor notifications via voice call, text messages, emails, Microsoft Team, Google Hangouts and Slack, to collecting eSignatures, to printing visitor badges, Greetly can be customized to the branding and unique receptionist needs of every work environment. Greetly’s solutions are used by several brands including DHL, Office Evolution, the United States Air Force, the Dallas Cowboys and Randstad. 
Greetly was named “Best ROI” by G2 and a Key Company within the visitor management space by QY Research. 
EASY PEASY
You go to work to solve interesting problems. To make peoples’ lives better. Not to get bogged down receiving Bob from accounting’s lunch order. Let Greetly do it. With Greetly, the visitor registration process is quick and easy. And dare we say… FUN!
YOUR DIGITAL RECEPTIONIST
Greetly is a 100% white-labeled visitor sign-in app. Guests see only your logo and brand colors. Imagine your visitors will saying: “Wow, your company is so high tech, your virtual receptionist app is so impressive!” Launch Greetly today and make every day Happy Administrative Professionals Day.
INCREDIBLY CUSTOMIZABLE
Require visitors to sign an NDA? Greetly’s check-in app has got ya’ covered - it doubles as an eSignature app. Need event registration software? Voilà, you know who is in da’house. Lots of package deliveries? Done. Secure facility? Greetly can take a photo of every visitor and print visitor badges so visitors are recognized at a glance. Want to change the verbiage to reflect your brand? It's a matter of seconds.
TONS OF INTEGRATIONS
Make managing your host list super easy with our Microsoft Active Directory and cloud-based Azure AD integrations. 
UNLIMITED HOSTS, VISITORS AND RECEPTION NOTIFICATIONS
The Greetly iPad sign in app proudly provides digital visitor management to organizations ranging from tech startups to non-profits to global corporations. No matter how big or small your employee base, Greetly's i Receptionist offers unlimited visitor registrations and instant check-in notifications. No worry about usage fees or add-ons for too many SMS notifications – it’s all included.
INSTANT NOTIFICATIONS
Greetly sends instant reception notifications to employees via voice call, text message, email, Microsoft Teams, Google Hangouts and Slack. Each employees gets to choose which types of eReceptionist notifications they want to receive. Whatever they prefer, Greetly works fast… And there it went.
HABLA ESPANOL. ET FRANÇAIS. と日本語.
Make your lobby experience comfortable for guests. Allow visitors to check in with the language of their choice. Greetly’s front desk sign in app can be customized to display in whatever languages you choose.
DIGITAL VISITOR LOG
Want to contact visitors to thank them for coming? Did something go missing? Need to know who was onsite during an evacuation or drill? Greetly’s visitor check in app includes a secure cloud-based visitor log. Access, view and download your visitor list anytime, anywhere.
Keep your workplace safe and productive.

bluejetty:00069544:ios.description:
With over 35 million downloads, Jorte is one of the most popular calendar & organizer applications.
In addition to the calendar function for entering daily schedules, it is packed with digital functions such as a diary where you can add photos, ToDo lists, event calendars, and design themes. Everyone has a different way of managing their schedules. You can fully personalize your schedule with Jorte.
▶ Features ◀
• Sync with iOS & Google Calendars
• Manage ToDos, sync with Google Tasks, display according to priority
• Jorte Calendar Sync & backup with Jorte Cloud
• Apple Watch support
• iOS Widget support
• Monthly, Weekly, Daily, Vertical views
• Event Calendars to check public holidays, sports events, and weather forecast
• Adjust the starting day of the week; it doesn't always have to be Sunday!
• Customizable font style & colors
• Icons, Themes, and Wallpapers allow you to further customize your calendar the way you like.
• Set Repeat events Weekly, Bi-Weekly, yearly, even 1st Tuesday of each Month, in any repeating format
• Adjustable Font Size
• Calendar Tabs
• Shared Calendars
• Set Notifications, Countdown events 
▶ Jorte Cloud ◀
Free backup
• Back up your calendar activities, diary, and ToDos from your smartphone to your computer
• Keep important information safe on the Cloud
• Share calendars on your smartphone with calendars on your computer
• Easy migration of calendar data when changing devices 
The first step is to get a Jorte ID and sign in to Jorte Cloud.
Apply for Jorte ID here (free) > https://jorte.net/certify/account/tempCreate/
*You can register with Facebook ID (Users who already have Jorte ID cannot use Facebook ID to log in)
▶ Premium Feature ◀
Services for premium members
• Turn ads off
• Add up to 100 calendars and 10 task lists
• Large-capacity image storage for diary photos on the Cloud (up to 50 GB)
• Toolbar Advanced Customization
• Unlimited use of icons, themes, backgrounds
• Sync with Evernote
• Menstrual Calendar
• Passcode Lock/Secret Calendars
The following Subscription tiers for Jorte are available: 
• Jorte Premium: Monthly $2.99 / Annually $29.99
• Jorte Plus: Annually $3.99
• Prices may vary based on the currency and exchange rate you set. Apple's charge amount is the correct amount. Subscriptions will be charged to your credit card through your iTunes account.
• Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period, at a cost of $2.99 (Monthly) / $29.99 (Annually) for Jorte Premium, $3.99 (Annually) for Jorte Plus
• Subscriptions may be turned off by going to your Account Settings after purchase
• Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable
▷ Help: support@jorte.com
▷ Terms of Use
https://www.jorte.com/etc/kiyaku/?select=en
▷ Privacy Policy
https://www.jorte.com/etc/privacy/?select=en

Just get in & drive! Define your own shortcuts, and the app activates & deactivates automatically.

Everything at a glance on your car display! And audio directly through the car speakers.

Decide for yourself which hazards you want to be alerted of.

Navigate with swarm intelligence and reach your destination faster.

* Live updates on fixed and mobile hazards
