bluejetty:00147503:ios.description:
Fewer reminders. More independence.
Habit Owl helps families turn everyday chores into clear routines children can understand and own.
Parents create age-appropriate chores, choose meaningful rewards, and follow each child’s progress. Kids use a focused Kid View to complete today’s chores, earn points, and work toward a reward they care about.
A CLEAR PLAN FOR EVERY CHILD
• Create your own chores or choose from ready-to-use ideas 
• Get chore suggestions based on your child’s age 
• Choose daily, weekly, or monthly schedules 
• Add optional reminders for individual chores 
• Manage multiple children from one family board
A ROUTINE THEY CAN OWN
Hand over Kid View and let your child see exactly what needs to be done today. Chores are presented in a simple, friendly format that helps children complete tasks with less prompting.
REWARDS WORTH WORKING TOWARD
Completed chores earn points. Choose a suggested reward or create your own, set a reachable goal, and let your child follow their progress until the reward is ready to redeem.
WATCH CONSISTENCY GROW
See completed chores, points earned, completion rates, and progress over time. Follow the whole family or see how each child is doing individually.
LOCAL-FIRST BY DESIGN
Your family board works from data stored on your device. Habit Owl is designed to keep everyday chore management simple and focused on your family.
FREE AND HABIT OWL PLUS
Start free with up to six chores per child. Habit Owl Plus lets you add more. Subscription options and any available introductory offers are shown before purchase and can be managed through your App Store account.

bluejetty:00119891:ios.name: Army NCO Tools & Guide
bluejetty:00119891:ios.summary: Born in the field, battle-tested for over a decade, and continuously refined through 50+ updates. No accounts, no ads, no data collection, no fluff, just straight gas for the NCO tool kit. This ain't your daddy's blue book - it's a full-blo
bluejetty:00119891:ios.description:
Born in the field, battle-tested for over a decade, and continuously refined through 50+ updates. No accounts, no ads, no data collection, no fluff, just straight gas for the NCO tool kit. This ain't your daddy's blue book - it's a full-blown command and control suite. Whether you're garrison or deployed, this toolset crushes your daily duties. Simply said we have a ton of tools ~ you do the NCO Business, track it all on the app, share by text and email. 
CORE NCO TOOLS:
Alpha Roster Management - Full personnel tracking system at your fingertips. Build, modify, and maintain multiple rosters. Perfect for managing PT groups, duty rosters, or training teams. Duplicate rosters for recurring events or special details.
Blue Force Taskr - Track your team's mission-essential tasks with military precision. Create, assign, and monitor tasks with clear suspense dates. No more lost sticky notes or forgotten details.
Time Hackr - Create time hacks and backwards plan. Share your plan by text and email. 
Troop to Task Matrix - A 2D grid to assign troops to tasks. It's a sync matrix in your pocket. Create tasks (or use previously created tasks), add soldiers. Tap Tap and share with others. Too easy.
Troop Leading Procedures - 8 Step TLPs for small unit and team management. Detailed reference, notes and check list for each step. Create your TLP project and share plans with your team.
After Action Review (AAR) Tool - Because if we ain't learning, we ain't leading. Capture lessons learned while they're fresh. Document what was supposed to happen, what actually happened, and crucial sustains/improves.
Safety Briefs - Create, store and share safety briefs with risks, mitigations and advisory statements.
Tool Maker - We can't think of every tool you need so we made a tool maker. Make a tool, use the tool, share outputs from your tool. 
GARRISON TOOLS
Barracks Inspections - track inspections by room, by common area, record faults and schedule follow up inspections. Good for busting slobs and showing Top trends over time with that pesky black mold.
FIELD TOOLS
Packing List - Create and distribute packing lists, use inspection mode to turn the packing list into a check list.
PCC/PCI Inspection Tool - Digital checklists for PCC/PCIs. Create templates, track deficiencies, and maintain readiness standards. 
Sensitive Items - Create an inventory, add soldiers, add items, check them off then text full reports to your higher.
Slant Report - Track your unit's equipment status in the field with a classic Slant Report, add/modify/delete equipment status. 
SPOT Reports - When stuff hits the fan, you need quick, accurate reporting. Document incidents in real-time using the standard SALUTE format. Ideal for recording disciplinary issues, safety concerns, or equipment failures. Share reports with your chain of command.
Range Finder - Key lesson learned from Afghan, troops didn't know what 500 meters meant in real life. Our range finder is both a tool and a training device so you can hone your skill on common range estimates.
Julian Date - Convert calendar dates to Julian format (YDDD). Perfect for supply, logistics, and administrative tasks that require Julian date calculations.
READINESS & RECORDS:
VA Disability Tracker - track and record your career injuries for easier VA claims when you get out. Export your records by PDF. Guides and tips on how to improve your VA disability rating.
Important Links - APD, ATN, HRC, IgnitED, ACT, ATRRS, OneSource, Tricare, MyPay, Army Times, Army.mil News
FEATURES THAT MATTER:
- Works offline - because the field rarely has Wi-Fi
- Zero cloud dependency - your data stays on your device
- No account required - download and drive on
- Built-in sharing for all reports and assessments
FOR THE BACKBONE OF THE ARMY: Get back to leading troops instead of wrestling with notebooks and spreadsheets. Download NCO Tools and take command of your daily mission.
Mission First, People Always - Now with better tools for both.

Alpha Roster Management - Full personnel tracking system at your fingertips. Build, modify, and maintain multiple rosters. Perfect for managing PT groups, duty rosters, or training teams. Duplicate rosters for recurring events or special details.

Blue Force Taskr - Track your team's mission-essential tasks with military precision. Create, assign, and monitor tasks with clear suspense dates. No more lost sticky notes or forgotten details.

Time Hackr - Create time hacks and backwards plan. Share your plan by text and email. 

Troop to Task Matrix - A 2D grid to assign troops to tasks. It's a sync matrix in your pocket. Create tasks (or use previously created tasks), add soldiers. Tap Tap and share with others. Too easy.

Troop Leading Procedures - 8 Step TLPs for small unit and team management. Detailed reference, notes and check list for each step. Create your TLP project and share plans with your team.

After Action Review (AAR) Tool - Because if we ain't learning, we ain't leading. Capture lessons learned while they're fresh. Document what was supposed to happen, what actually happened, and crucial sustains/improves.

Safety Briefs - Create, store and share safety briefs with risks, mitigations and advisory statements.

Tool Maker - We can't think of every tool you need so we made a tool maker. Make a tool, use the tool, share outputs from your tool. 

GARRISON TOOLS
Barracks Inspections - track inspections by room, by common area, record faults and schedule follow up inspections. Good for busting slobs and showing Top trends over time with that pesky black mold.

FIELD TOOLS
Packing List - Create and distribute packing lists, use inspection mode to turn the packing list into a check list.

PCC/PCI Inspection Tool - Digital checklists for PCC/PCIs. Create templates, track deficiencies, and maintain readiness standards. 

Sensitive Items - Create an inventory, add soldiers, add items, check them off then text full reports to your higher.

Slant Report - Track your unit's equipment status in the field with a classic Slant Report, add/modify/delete equipment status. 

SPOT Reports - When stuff hits the fan, you need quick, accurate reporting. Document incidents in real-time using the standard SALUTE format. Ideal for recording disciplinary issues, safety concerns, or equipment failures. Share reports with your chain of command.

Range Finder - Key lesson learned from Afghan, troops didn't know what 500 meters meant in real life. Our range finder is both a tool and a training device so you can hone your skill on common range estimates.

Julian Date - Convert calendar dates to Julian format (YDDD). Perfect for supply, logistics, and administrative tasks that require Julian date calculations.

READINESS & RECORDS:
VA Disability Tracker - track and record your career injuries for easier VA claims when you get out. Export your records by PDF. Guides and tips on how to improve your VA disability rating.

Important Links - APD, ATN, HRC, IgnitED, ACT, ATRRS, OneSource, Tricare, MyPay, Army Times, Army.mil News

FEATURES THAT MATTER:
- Works offline - because the field rarely has Wi-Fi
- Zero cloud dependency - your data stays on your device
- No account required - download and drive on
- Built-in sharing for all reports and assessments

FOR THE BACKBONE OF THE ARMY: Get back to leading troops instead of wrestling with notebooks and spreadsheets. Download NCO Tools and take command of your daily mission.

Mission First, People Always - Now with better tools for both.

bluejetty:00164854:ios.description:
Lite Maps lets you explore the world in seconds — no sign-up, no clutter.
Tap “Explore a place” to jump to a famous landmark anywhere on Earth, then look around at street level as if you were standing there. Save the places you love, browse curated collections, and test yourself with a geography game built on real street imagery.
WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Explore a place — one tap takes you to a world landmark you haven't seen yet
• Street-level views — walk the streets of New York, London, Paris, Tokyo and more
• 3D City & satellite — see skylines, mountains and coastlines in 3D, with day-to-night lighting
• Guess the Place — a geography quiz: where in the world are you? Keep your streak alive
• Landmark of the day — an optional evening notification with a new place to visit
• Collections — Wonders of the World, Arab World, Europe & Türkiye, Americas, Asia & Oceania, Africa
• Saved and recent places — jump back to your favorite spots anytime
• Search any place or address, get a route, and share a spot with friends
LIGHT BY DESIGN
Lite Maps opens fast, stays simple and focuses on one thing: seeing the world.
60+ LANDMARKS ON EVERY CONTINENT
From the Pyramids of Giza to the Golden Gate Bridge, from Hagia Sophia to Mount Fuji.
Available in English, Arabic and Turkish. Street-level imagery is shown where coverage exists. Location access is optional and only used to show where you are on the map.
Questions or ideas? We'd love to hear from you: info@mapasview.app
Privacy Policy: https://lite.mapasview.app/privacy.html

bluejetty:00131206:ios.description:

Say hello to ReelShort, a next-gen HD streaming short movie platform offering exclusive vertical TV mini series. Choose from our TV mini series library packed with endless addictive movie shorts added daily, from romantic encounters with billionaires and heart-wrenching tragedies to epic comeback stories and more—you won't ever be short on short movie entertainment!
Featured Shows:
[Don't Miss Me When I'm Gone] After losing my parents, I move in with my godmother, Aunt Sandra. I live under her roof with her two sons-the Miller brothers-surrounded by love and care. I think I’ll end up with one of them. But everything changes when the maid’s daughter, Lola, moves in. The Miller brother I love most breaks my heart into pieces. After I leave, they lose their minds trying to find me.
[Move Aside! I'm the Final Boss] Kingsley is the secret King of King's Corps and the richest man on Earth, but when he returns from the battlefield, his childhood sweetheart brutally dumps him, thinking he's a clown. How will the King of all men make her regret it?
Here's why you'll love ReelShort:
Bite-sized original movie shorts designed for on-the-go viewing
•Exclusive short movies with juicy vertical content that will keep you hooked
•New TV mini series added daily, with hundreds of new episodes each month
•Hollywood-quality entertainment, crafted for the big screen delivered to your small screen
•The first ever interactive live action short movies, where you decide what happens next
Experience the future of short movie entertainment, one minute at a time — download ReelShort now!

bluejetty:00152864:android.description:
Are you struggling and short on cash? DrutoCash can help! Get your loan quickly, at low interest rates, without the hassle of waiting. Apply online and get funds instantly! We'll recommend a suitable loan option based on your information and credit profile. We offer personal loans. Loan amounts and repayment periods may vary depending on individual credit situations. Thank you for your understanding and support.
🎯Application Requirements:
📄Bangladesh citizens aged 18 or above.
🌟Good credit history with no significant overdue payments, outstanding balances, or other negative credit history.
📱Application Process:
📥Download the app
📝 Fill in your information
📤 Submit your application
⏳ Wait for review
💸 Funds will be disbursed to your account
Product Information:
Online loan range: 5,000 Bangladeshi Taka - 350,000 Bangladeshi Taka
- Loan term: Minimum 91 days, maximum 180 days
- Annual loan interest rate: Maximum 14%
- Daily loan interest rate: 14% ÷ 365 = 0.0383%;
- Fees: Service fee is 0.
91-day loan calculation example:
Loan amount: 350,000 Bangladeshi taka, annual interest rate: 14%, loan term: 91 days. Total repayment: 362,198 Bangladeshi taka, including principal: 350,000 Bangladeshi taka + interest: (350,000 Bangladeshi taka × 0.0383% × 91) = 362,198 Bangladeshi taka
180-day loan calculation example:
Loan amount: 350,000 Bangladeshi taka, annual interest rate: 14%, loan term: 180 days. Total repayment: 374,129 Bangladeshi taka, including principal: 350,000 Bangladeshi taka + interest: (350,000 Bangladeshi taka × 0.0383% × 180) = 374,129 Bangladeshi taka
💪Our Advantages:
🚀 Quick and convenient: The entire application process is completed online. You can apply for a loan anytime, anywhere, using your mobile phone.
💰 Low interest rates: We offer competitive interest rates.
⚡ Efficient approval process: Fast approval process, quick access to funds.
🤝 Flexible repayment options: We offer a variety of repayment options to suit your needs.
Customer Service:
Monday to Friday, 8:30 AM to 5:30 PM
DrutoCash offers online customer service to answer any loan-related questions. We offer services like loan repayment reminders and bill inquiries, ensuring a worry-free loan experience.
Email: DrutoCash@outlook.com
Phone: +8801973625432
You can also visit https://api.drutocash.store/p

bluejetty:00045235:ios.name: Cottage Health MyChart
bluejetty:00045235:ios.summary: The Cottage Health app helps you easily manage health information and care for yourself and your family. You can find a physician and locate healthcare services near you, and 24/7 Virtual Care and Urgent Care appointments are just a click a
bluejetty:00045235:ios.description:
The Cottage Health app helps you easily manage health information and care for yourself and your family. You can find a physician and locate healthcare services near you, and 24/7 Virtual Care and Urgent Care appointments are just a click away.
Cottage Health provides advanced medical care for patients throughout California. Nationally recognized for quality care and patient satisfaction, the team at Cottage Health puts patients first with excellence, integrity and compassion. Services include the Cottage Heart & Vascular Center, Cottage Center for Orthopedics, Cottage Children’s Medical Center and Santa Barbara Neuroscience Institute and more.
With Cottage MyChart you can:
• Communicate directly with your care team
• Review test results, medications, immunization history, and other health information
• Connect your account to other apps, like Apple Health, to transfer health-related data from your personal devices into Cottage MyChart. 
• View your After Visit Summary® for past visits and hospital stays, along with your provider’s clinical notes 
• View upcoming and past appointments
• Get price estimates for the cost of care
• View and pay your medical bills
• Securely share your medical record with others you designate
• Connect your accounts from other healthcare organizations so all your health information is in one place
• Opt in to notifications when new information is available in Cottage MyChart 
• Pre-register for appointments and update insurance information to streamline your check-in
• Expectant parents can register for Your Delivery options to streamline hospital admission, including providing delivery preferences
• Submit requests for financial assistance
• Quickly display your COVID-19 immunization and testing status for admission to events, travel, etc.
• Request medication refills
• Designate health care agents and submit Advance Care Plans

bluejetty:00164061:ios.name: idealo flights: cheap tickets
bluejetty:00164061:ios.summary: Compare budget flights on your phone and save money. Download the free idealo flight app and find cheap fares from airlines and travel shops within seconds. The flight comparison app finds and lists offers of numerous airlines and countless
bluejetty:00164061:ios.description:
Compare budget flights on your phone and save money. Download the free idealo flight app and find cheap fares from airlines and travel shops within seconds. The flight comparison app finds and lists offers of numerous airlines and countless routes worldwide. Filter results to see our best offers quickly and then book tickets online on your phone directly with the airline or travel shop. Even before the search begins, the app will show an approximate price for flights based on former searches. Besides sorting results by cost and flight length, flights leaving or arriving at the same time can also be grouped together and sorted using a number of filters. 
THE IDEALO FLIGHT APP FEATURES:
▶ For more flexibility during the pandemic: search filter for airlines with flexible rebooking options
▶ Radius search: find the nearest airports to your current location
▶ Airport suggest: the app will suggest and auto-fill possible departure and destination airports as you type based on popular routes and former searches
▶ Find the best date: even before the search begins the app will display approximate prices based on past searches
▶ Save search queries: save your favorite routes and display our current prices 
▶ Filter options: filter offers by price, arrival and departure times, stopovers, airline, payment method, shop or CO₂ emissions 
▶ Baggage info: see whether the price includes checked baggage in the search results or opt to search for offers that do.
▶ Share function: send your favorite offers to friends and family per email, WhatsApp, Telegram, skype and SMS
▶ Book online: book your flight directly with the travel shop or airline
▶ The piggy bank above the search results contains plenty of tips to save money on the chosen route and practical information about the destination.
▶ Smart calendar search: See when direct flights are available as soon as you choose your travel dates. These days are now marked with a green dot in the calendar. 
MORE APP HIGHLIGHTS:
▶ Saved flights and flight searches: the menu with saved flight searches, prices and routes is also available without an internet connection e.g. on the plane
▶ Easy to use search form: departure and destination airports can be chosen in only one search mask and from relevant suggestions 
▶ Useful calendar feature: to find the cheapest flights in the app, swipe through the calendar to show current flight prices as compared to other days
▶ Group flights: besides sorting flights by price and flight duration you can also sort flights with identical departure times to find the best option more quickly
▶ Dark mode: set app preferences, and compare flight prices in light or dark mode.
GREAT PRICE COMPARISON:
▶ Find cheap flights online on our flight comparison website flights.idealo.com
▶ Book great deals to countless destinations worldwide whether low-cost carrier, top airline or cheap charter flight
▶ Book last-minute flights or plan in advance and book early. We will help you find low cost tickets for your holiday
▶ Not only cheap tickets – search for flights and compare all booking classes: first class, business class, economy class and premium economy
▶ We constantly monitor all our flight shops and travel agent partners so that you can count on accurate prices and a reliable service 
▶ No hidden extra costs – all our prices are final 
▶ Suitable airports and recommended travel dates for your journey are shown in the calendar view 
Sustainability: we are proud to be a certified climate neutral business
FEEDBACK & SUPPORT:
Do you like our app? Please rate us in the app store. Your
suggestions and questions are always welcome. Send your feedback to
travel@idealo.com

bluejetty:00035330:ios.name: Train of Hope: Survival Game
bluejetty:00035330:ios.summary: Embark on Train of Hope, an immersive strategy and survival game filled with adventures in a lush post-apocalyptic world. Command a train across a modern America engulfed by a dense, toxic jungle. The train is your lifeline—your only hope a
bluejetty:00035330:ios.description:
Embark on Train of Hope, an immersive strategy and survival game filled with adventures in a lush post-apocalyptic world. Command a train across a modern America engulfed by a dense, toxic jungle. The train is your lifeline—your only hope against nature's relentless growth. Navigate the dangers of this overgrown new world alongside companions like Auntie, Jack, and Liam, each with unique abilities.
Key features:
[Strategic train upgrades]
Transform your humble locomotive into a survival powerhouse. Every upgrade is crucial as you brave the nature apocalypse.
[Wilderness survival exploration]
Venture beyond your base to gather essential resources, build shelters, fight plant-infected creatures and zombies, and rescue the last remaining survivors. Collect resources wisely to not just survive but thrive in the jungle.
[Resource and base management]
Manage resources efficiently and maintain your train to keep your crew healthy, fed, and rested as the wilderness encroaches. A smart strategy is key to survival amid the ever-present danger.
[Engaging quests]
Set out on diverse adventures across dangerous overgrown landscapes. Each location offers unique challenges and hidden secrets.
[Immersive narrative]
Shape the storyline through your choices. Your decisions impact the survival journey, creating a unique experience with each playthrough.
[Stunning jungle world]
Explore breathtaking environments, from lush forests to ruined urban jungles, capturing the haunting beauty of an America reclaimed by nature.
Download Train of Hope and take on the challenge of surviving and exploring a world transformed by a relentless green apocalypse. Are you ready to guide your crew through the verdant wilderness?

Service and Safety 
• Receive recall notifications 
• Receive maintenance alerts 
• Schedule service appointments

bluejetty:00187515:ios.description:
League is your one place for everything you need to take charge of your health and benefits to live happier and healthier every day.
Digital Wallet: Easily check out your coverage, health spending accounts and submit claims with just a tap, right from your phone.

Health Journey: Start a personalized, day-by-day journey filled with activities, content, and support specially focused on your individual needs. All in one place, on your own time, and at no cost to you.
Connect Devices: Hook up Apple Health and your connected wearables so that you can automatically track your progress, sync health info, and get extra motivation to hit your goals.

Create your very own pocket Tuber and follow in the footsteps of internet sensation PewDiePie!
Get creative and make viral videos, design trendy rooms, unlock cool items, and participate in fun community events! You can even create hilarious memes in the Meme Maker and share them with all your friends! Do you have what it takes to go viral and dethrone PewDiePie? Make videos to gain subscribers and views, climb the Tuber rankings, and become the top YouTuber! Collect brains to unlock special perks and master trending topics to boost your channel.
◈ COMPLETE QUESTS
Complete epic quests to earn currency quickly and efficiently!

bluejetty:00061677:ios.name: Site Report Pro- Punchlist App
bluejetty:00061677:ios.summary: Site Report Pro is the #1 mobile app for generating a field inspection report or professional punch list report as a PDF or XLS file (Excel document). Fast and easy to use, with powerful features not found in other punch list and site inspe
bluejetty:00061677:ios.description:
Site Report Pro is the #1 mobile app for generating a field inspection report or professional punch list report as a PDF or XLS file (Excel document). Fast and easy to use, with powerful features not found in other punch list and site inspection report apps, we are confident it will revolutionize the way you manage projects, highlight deficiencies, perform risk assessments and generate your inspection or field report.
Whether you are an individual or a team, you can benefit from tools to mark up and blur photos, simple issue assignment, powerful filter & sort capability, and generation of PDF inspection reports in a choice of 40 premium themes that will amaze clients and colleagues.
Customizable for a specific trade or industry, Site Report Pro is used worldwide for site walks, reporting punch list items, producing a custom site inspection report, performing risk assessments, tracking construction projects and much more.
The Site Report Pro App makes it easy to create and share a site inspection report, field report, or punch list report, as an XLSX file (Excel document) or as a professional PDF report, all while on the job site using only your iPhone or iPad.
Benefit from the following features that are generally not found in other site inspection report, punch list, and field inspection apps:
- Add up to 8 photos per issue to ensure all observations are captured in the report. Add multiple photos at once or instantly create issues from your selected images.
- Mark up and blur each photo to highlight issues using powerful annotation tools — don't worry if you make a mistake, annotations can be moved and resized.
- Add professional sign-off signatures to your reports — generate from your name, draw your own, or import an existing signature.
- Produce and share professional punch list PDFs & site inspection reports via e-mail or third-party tools such as Dropbox.
- Choose from 40 available report themes.
- Configure each Excel document (XLS, XLSX) or PDF inspection report using powerful customization, sorting and filtering tools — e.g. generate and send each trade or contractor a report of outstanding issues.
- Powerful ordering, sorting, searching and filtering of projects, issues & punch lists.
- Use the flexible tagging capability to categorize the inspection report or punch list any way you want.
- Assign and send issues to your team members, colleagues and contractors.
- Import and export project backups to keep your data safe and transfer between devices.
- Maintain a chronological history of work with automatically time-stamped comments.
- High quality software and first class customer support — access support chat directly from the app.
Site Report Pro does not require an online service or sign-up.

bluejetty:00149697:ios.name: TN DMV Driver's License Test
bluejetty:00149697:ios.summary: Are you looking for a practice material to prepare for the learner’s license test or driver’s license knowledge test for the Tennessee state? Use our Tennessee DMV Permit Practice Test app to prepare for the Driver’s License test and get yo
bluejetty:00149697:ios.description:
Are you looking for a practice material to prepare for the learner’s license test or driver’s license knowledge test for the Tennessee state? Use our Tennessee DMV Permit Practice Test app to prepare for the Driver’s License test and get your driver’s permit with ease.
Our app provides questions based on the official manual from the Department of Motor Vehicle (DMV) of the Tennessee state. The app includes driver’s permit module for the car, motorcycle and Commercial Driving License CDL. The app is a ready to use study guide material for those who want to prepare for their driver’s license test. 
Followings are the unique features of the app.
QUESTIONS FROM OFFICIAL REFERENCE MATERIAL 
The Tennessee DMV Driver’s Handbook served as the inspiration for all of the content and questions that have been included in the app. Prepare yourself for the questions that will be on the test by going over them in advance. 
PRACTICE CATEGORY WISE QUESTIONS
The app includes a practice module that allows to get familiar with questions that fall under different categories like Traffic Rules, Road Signs and Rules of Safe driving. It also keeps track of the progress you have made in each category. It contains questions from following categories:
* Traffic Laws
* Road Signs
* Rules of Safe Driving
* CDL endorsements : Hazardous Materials, Schools Bus, Passenger Vehicle, Combination Vehicle, Tankers, Double/Triples
* Pre-trip Inspections
* Air Brakes
MOCK TEST (TEST SIMULATOR)
The application also includes a module that gives you the opportunity to take a test consisting of questions drawn at random from different categories. This section will give you an idea of what to expect from the actual exam that you will be taking.
TEST RESULT
You will get the test result based on the official criteria to pass the Driver’s License Test. You will also be able to find out what questions you've done wrong after taking the test.
TEST HISTORY
The application keeps history of how you have performed in the previous mock tests so that you get an idea of your progress.
CUSTOM TEST CREATER
You can generate speedy, short quizzes with the help of this application by picking questions from a list of unpracticed questions or by selecting questions that you have previously gotten wrong. You also have the option to choose the total number of questions on the practice test.
QUESTION CHALLENGE
This is a unique feature of our application. It allows you learn while playing a challenge game. Your score will go up by one point each time you correctly answer a question up until the point where you get it wrong. It keeps record of your high score. 
WHY Tennessee DMV Permit Practice Test app?
- Over thousands questions designed from the official DMV manual.
- Practice questions category wise and keep track of how you are progressing.
- Go through the questions you answered wrong.
- Real time test simulator.
- Bookmark questions that you think you want to refer them later on.
- Question Challenge - Learn by playing game.
*Disclaimer:
We are not associated with any government state agency. This app is not intended to be relied upon in any dispute, claim, action, proceeding or for legal advice. For official law descriptions and administrative centres, please consult the respective state body. It is also highly recommended that new drivers take an approved driver education course to learn the rules and laws of the road, and to develop responsible driving habits. We have developed this app to help you to pass the DMV permit test with ease. The questions are designed based on the latest official Driver's handbook. But we do not claim the accuracy of information and this information can not be used in any legal case.

bluejetty:00157207:ios.summary:
An Airport See Something Say Something tool for smartphones 
See Say Airport offers airport employees and the public a quick and discreet way to report suspicious activity, safety & security concerns, human trafficking and other issues dir
bluejetty:00157207:ios.description:
An Airport See Something Say Something tool for smartphones 
See Say Airport offers airport employees and the public a quick and discreet way to report suspicious activity, safety & security concerns, human trafficking and other issues directly to Airport dispatchers. See Say Airport helps keep both public and sterile areas of an airport safer by providing crowd-sourced situation awareness to police. Internal and external threats may be reported. The app can send photos, video, a description of the problem, and the incident location. From the home screen, users have two easy options for contacting Airport police: 
* The Report a Problem button allows users to send incident reports directly to Airport Police. To ensure discretion, the camera flash is automatically disabled when photos are taken through the app. When reporting an issue, users can select airport locations and report categories to assist Police in responding. App users may also send reports anonymously if they chose. 
* The Call Police button will connect app users directly to Airport Police. 
This application is designed for airports. If you send an incident report from an area without cellular or wifi connectivity, it will be stored and sent when connectivity returns. 
Additional Features 
BOLO (Be On the Look Out) Alerts. BOLO Alerts on the See Say Airport app may display alerts from Airport Police about specific persons of interest. For example, See Say Airport may display information about a missing person or criminal suspect, such as where they were last seen.

bluejetty:00179123:ios.description:
Listen to your iPod collections at 0.5X - 2.5X speed. Supports multitasking, remote controller. Study mode(A/B repeat, quick rewind/forward), sleep timer.
* Save time listening to podcasts and audiobooks. Play at any speed using a slider!
* Study mode helps you learn more effectively.
* Sleep timer can save your battery while you sleep.
SpeedUp Player features:
- Variable speed playback: 0.5X(half speed) - 2.5X (0.1X interval)
- Preserve pitch(tone) while changing playback speed.
- Play directly from your iPod collection.
- Play from app's Documents folder. (Wi-Fi file transfer is possible)
- Customizable gestures to access most features.
- Configurable quick rewind/forward buttons. 4 buttons can be set individually.
- Full multitasking support.
- Remote controller support.
- Sleep timer (pause after 10/20/30/60/120 minutes)
- A/B repeat : repeat interval using simple button press
- bookmark: save bookmarks with comments. A/B repeat section can be bookmarked.
- reads chapter information.
- Extremely fast iPod library browsing (disk+memory based cache)
- Browse by album/artist/songs/playlists/podcasts
- Simple playlist
- Pause/resume on phone call(audio interruption).
- Pause when headphone is unplugged.
- Music tracks can be set to be played at 1X.
- UI supports light/dark theme.
- supports CarPlay.
- supports lyrics (ID3 USLT/SYLT and lrc)
Limitations:
- video tracks are not supported.
- does not support DRM protected files.

bluejetty:00182761:ios.description:
Amazing puzzle about cute monsters in cool math games world!
Help Junior to wake up Senior in this free physics-based logical game for kids and adults. Click away as few mean monster blocks as possible to reunite a playful son and his tired dad for high scores and star ratings. 
FEATURES:
- tone of interesting logical puzzles with problem-solving levels
- logical thinking - eliminate unfriendly monsters blocks in a specific order
- cause and effect - explore how the monsters' world works
- play and learn - solve challenging puzzles, enjoy merry melodies & stunning graphics.
STORY:
Junior is the incredibly energetic child. This little red monster block wants to run, jump & rollick. But his father Senior has got so tired and doesn't want to play with the son.
Maybe you can change that in this eye-infested tumble-drop physics game Monsterland: Junior vs Senior. 
LOCALIZATIONS:
You can now play Monsterland. Junior vs Senior fun puzzle game in 11 different languages: English, French, German, Italian, Chinese (China), Japanese, Korean, Portuguese (Brasil), Portuguese (Portugal), Russian, Spanish.
Monsterland habitats are so cute, there are Yellow, Pink, Violet, Blue block-monsters, wise Cyclope, slippy Fly and flexible Jumper among them. Explore these adorable creatures and objects so Junior can land on Senior and wake him up!
Interesting puzzles, adorable music, colourful design, cartoon monsters' land and a kid's merry laugh will bring so much pleasure and fun, guaranteed!
Monsterland. Junior vs Senior is awesome free brain game for mobile phones and tablets. It's fun for players of all ages (from kids to adults) and abilities. What remains to wait? Download the best logic puzzle and play with your friend and family right now!

Visit our site http://alma-games.com/
Write us on e-mail contact@alma-games.com
Want to go further?
If you like cool math games as Monsterland. Junior vs Senior and want to play more levels, please enjoy the 2-nd part of this story - Monsterland: Fairy Tails. More interesting puzzles, new characters and so much fun!
Also, you can try other cool math games by ALMA Games: Snoring. Elephant game, Alarmy & Monster Family, Hungry Cat around the world.

Easy Weaving with Little Looms is a perennial favorite. By popular demand, it will now be available by subscription. 
Each issue will have the mix of 18–22 projects, techniques, and features you love, expanding the focus on fundamental weaving skills, creative inspiration, and innovative applications. bluejetty:00018870:ios.description:
Play online in real-time with other players, either in teams of two or by yourself against another player. 
The goal of this card game is to form groups of 3 or more cards of the same value. A combination of seven or more cards is called a Canasta. Draw cards from the deck or the discard pile and meld all your cards as soon as possible to finish the game before the others, and achieve the highest score.
The value of the cards is 5 points for the 3, 4, 5, 6, 7; 10 points for the 8, 9, 10, J, Q, K; 20 points for Aces; 20 points for the 2 (wild card), and 50 points for the Jokers (wild card).
Clean canastas are worth more than the dirty ones (with wild cards)! Block the discard pile to prevent your opponents from picking it up!
Enjoy this game on your device!
Visit our Facebook page: https://www.facebook.com/americancanasta
Terms and conditions of use: https://conectagames.com/terms_policies/

bluejetty:00038949:ios.description:
지금 나 자신이 아래와 같은 상태에 있다면,
- 사소한 일에도 쉽게 예민해지고 있다면
- 생각이 꼬리에 꼬리를 물고 이어진다면
- 잘못 선택한 게 있었던 날에는 밤에 잠을 제대로 못잔다면
- 타인의 감정에 영향을 받는다면
- 자신의 가치, 자격, 존재에 대해 끊임없이 생각하고 고민한다면
- 활동하지 않을 때 불안함을 느낀다면
- 작은 결정을 내릴 때도 시간이 많이 걸리는 편이라면
- 생각/감정 등으로 인해 잠을 현재 한숨도 못자고 있다면
- 불면증으로 수면제, 바이노럴비트/모노럴 비트 청취 등 다양한 시도를 해보지만 근본적인 해결이 안되고 있다면,
다른 것 보다 우선 내 마음부터 근본적으로 살피고 돌봐야하는 신호입니다.
당신의 몸과 마음을 잘 살피고 다독여서 마음이 편안해질 수 있도록 코끼리 수면명상앱에서는 전문가의 명상과 심리, 특화된 수면 콘텐츠, ASMR, 동화 음원을 제공합니다.
오직 내 마음을 돌보는 것 1가지에만 초점을 맞춘 앱입니다.
- 특화된 명상 알람기능으로 원하는 요일/시각에 마음챙기는 습관을 가져봐요
- 감정 기록을 통해 5가지 기분을 표현해보고, 기록해 나의 내면을 관리해보세요
- 매일마다 1편씩 신규 업데이트되는 오늘의 명상, 오늘의 숙면, 오늘의 확언으로 바로 오늘, 마음챙김해보세요
- 편안한 나만의 수면 시간을 가져 보세요
- 다양한 음악, 소설, 동화, ASMR가 사용하기 편하게 한 곳에 정리되어 있어요
- 실생활 속 고민을 해결해주는 전문 고민상담, 심리이해 수업 콘텐츠가 있어요
- 국내외 수면-명상-심리 전문가들과 함께 만들고 있어요
스트레스로, 생각이 많아서 나도 모르는 불안이 찾아올 때, 알 수 없는 무기력함에 빠져서 다음날을 맞이하는 게 싫어지는 등 삶에서 다양한 이유로 잠을 거의 못 잘때가 찾아옵니다.
편안한 잠이 들려면, 당신의 마음이 가장 중요합니다.
코끼리 명상앱 하나로 언제 어디서나 필요할 때 바로 꺼내서 수면-명상 콘텐츠를 듣고 마음 편안한 잠의 세계로 빠져보세요.
■ 이럴 때 활용할 수 있어요
- 잠들기 어려울 때
- 일상에 긴장이 항상 많을 때
- 생각에 에너지를 항상 많이 쓰고 있을 때
- 스트레스가 심할 때
- 불안하거나 무기력할 때
- 번아웃, 자존감 하락으로 힘들 때
- 마음의 치유와 안정이 필요할 때
- 화가 쉽게 분출되고, 쉽게 상처받는 때
- 빠르고 짧은 콘텐츠에 중독된 것으로부터 벗어나고 싶을 때
■ 명상, 수면에 도움이 되나요?
- 명상은 마음의 안정과 건강을 위해 누구나 쉽게 따라 할 수 있는 과학적 실천 방법입니다.
- 국내외 연구 결과 명상은 불면증이나 스트레스를 감소시키고 집중력과 회복탄력성을 높이는 데 매우 효과적인 것으로 보고되고 있습니다.
- 코끼리에서 당신의 필요와 상황에 맞는 명상을 골라 하나씩 따라해 보세요.

listings.description:
지금 나 자신이 아래와 같은 상태에 있다면,
- 사소한 일에도 쉽게 예민해지고 있다면
- 생각이 꼬리에 꼬리를 물고 이어진다면
- 잘못 선택한 게 있었던 날에는 밤에 잠을 제대로 못잔다면
- 타인의 감정에 영향을 받는다면
- 자신의 가치, 자격, 존재에 대해 끊임없이 생각하고 고민한다면
- 활동하지 않을 때 불안함을 느낀다면
- 작은 결정을 내릴 때도 시간이 많이 걸리는 편이라면
- 생각/감정 등으로 인해 잠을 현재 한숨도 못자고 있다면
- 불면증으로 수면제, 바이노럴비트/모노럴 비트 청취 등 다양한 시도를 해보지만 근본적인 해결이 안되고 있다면,
다른 것 보다 우선 내 마음부터 근본적으로 살피고 돌봐야하는 신호입니다.

당신의 몸과 마음을 잘 살피고 다독여서 마음이 편안해질 수 있도록 코끼리 수면명상앱에서는 전문가의 명상과 심리, 특화된 수면 콘텐츠, ASMR, 동화 음원을 제공합니다.
오직 내 마음을 돌보는 것 1가지에만 초점을 맞춘 앱입니다.

- 특화된 명상 알람기능으로 원하는 요일/시각에 마음챙기는 습관을 가져봐요
- 감정 기록을 통해 5가지 기분을 표현해보고, 기록해 나의 내면을 관리해보세요
- 매일마다 1편씩 신규 업데이트되는 오늘의 명상, 오늘의 숙면, 오늘의 확언으로 바로 오늘, 마음챙김해보세요
- 편안한 나만의 수면 시간을 가져 보세요
- 다양한 음악, 소설, 동화, ASMR가 사용하기 편하게 한 곳에 정리되어 있어요
- 실생활 속 고민을 해결해주는 전문 고민상담, 심리이해 수업 콘텐츠가 있어요
- 국내외 수면-명상-심리 전문가들과 함께 만들고 있어요

스트레스로, 생각이 많아서 나도 모르는 불안이 찾아올 때, 알 수 없는 무기력함에 빠져서 다음날을 맞이하는 게 싫어지는 등 삶에서 다양한 이유로 잠을 거의 못 잘때가 찾아옵니다.
편안한 잠이 들려면, 당신의 마음이 가장 중요합니다.
코끼리 명상앱 하나로 언제 어디서나 필요할 때 바로 꺼내서 수면-명상 콘텐츠를 듣고 마음 편안한 잠의 세계로 빠져보세요.

■ 이럴 때 활용할 수 있어요
- 잠들기 어려울 때
- 일상에 긴장이 항상 많을 때
- 생각에 에너지를 항상 많이 쓰고 있을 때
- 스트레스가 심할 때
- 불안하거나 무기력할 때
- 번아웃, 자존감 하락으로 힘들 때
- 마음의 치유와 안정이 필요할 때
- 화가 쉽게 분출되고, 쉽게 상처받는 때
- 빠르고 짧은 콘텐츠에 중독된 것으로부터 벗어나고 싶을 때

■ 명상, 수면에 도움이 되나요?
- 명상은 마음의 안정과 건강을 위해 누구나 쉽게 따라 할 수 있는 과학적 실천 방법입니다.
- 국내외 연구 결과 명상은 불면증이나 스트레스를 감소시키고 집중력과 회복탄력성을 높이는 데 매우 효과적인 것으로 보고되고 있습니다.
- 코끼리에서 당신의 필요와 상황에 맞는 명상을 골라 하나씩 따라해 보세요.

bluejetty:00041943:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00041943:ios.description:
Bringing Neuroscience to Your Health
Oneleaf is the all-in one app that empowers you to take control of your life and health using neuroscience. It offers personalized experiences carefully crafted by our Scientific Board from NYU and Stanford.
Achieve your health and wellness goals and feel better every day with audio programs designed in collaboration with therapists and researchers from top universities. Our guided audio sessions bring you into a state of deep relaxation, making your mind more receptive to positive suggestions. This neuroscience-based approach enhances the mind-body connection, helping you manage both physical and emotional challenges. 
Our programs can help you achieve your goals and feel better every day, whether you want to:
- Lose weight
- Reduce stress or anxiety relief
- Manage endometriosis
- Quit smoking
- Improve focus
- Sleep better
- Manage pain
- Build confidence
- Improve relationships
Explore a range of hypnotherapy sessions waiting for you! Start your path toward a better you with Oneleaf today.
How does it work?
It's about guiding your brain into a state of focused relaxation, where real, positive change can begin. During your 15-20 minutes daily session - whether it's for losing weight or boosting your confidence, you learn coping skills and receive suggestions for improving your health and enjoy the benefits of this neuroscientific method, including reduced stress, improved sleep, increased confidence, and more.
Listen to our empowering audio programs anytime and anywhere, whether you're at home, at work, or on the go:
1/ Find a quiet and comfortable place to lay down
2/ Put on your headphones and select the program you want to listen to
3/ Follow the prompts and visualizations guiding you into a relaxed and focused state
At Oneleaf, we believe that everyone deserves to live a happier, healthier life. That's why we've created an app that combines the latest research in hypnotherapy with a user-friendly interface and a beautiful design.
Download Oneleaf today and join our mission to empower a billion people to feel better every day.
“This is the best health app on the market, stylish, very user friendly and best of all it actually works to change your mindset.” - App Store user
“I used this to quit smoking. I actually just listened to it every night before bed and totally fell asleep. It still worked! I didn’t have a craving anymore whatsoever and haven’t smoked since then. Incredible! It’s so easy to use and you can’t do anything wrong. Just listen to it once a day and that’s all.” - App Store user
Read the terms and conditions here:
https://www.oneleafhealth.com/terms-and-conditions
Read the privacy policy here:
https://www.oneleafhealth.com/privacy

bluejetty:00022566:ios.summary: iWare Designs brings you My Bowling 3D+, probably the most realistic and playable Ten Pin Bowling game available on mobile devices. Boasting fully textured game environments and full 3D rigid body physics, this game is the complete package
bluejetty:00022566:ios.description:
iWare Designs brings you My Bowling 3D+, probably the most realistic and playable Ten Pin Bowling game available on mobile devices. Boasting fully textured game environments and full 3D rigid body physics, this game is the complete package for both casual and serious gamers. 
Create any kind of shot you like by adjusting your stance, direction and ball spin. The shot types are only limited by your imagination. The simple drag and swipe interface allows you to pick up and play the game quickly, or alternatively for the more serious bowlers we have included additional features to allow the ball to be positioned and the shot shaped as required.
So whether you want a simple easy and fun bowling game or a full on simulation, this game is for you.
Download My Bowling 3D+ now, you will not be disappointed.
System Requirements:
∙ Compatible with iPhone, iPad and iPod touch.
∙ Utilizes Retina displays on compatible devices.
∙ Game Center compatible.
Game Features:
∙ Localized to English, French, German, Spanish, Italian, Dutch, Portuguese, Russian, Turkish, Canadian French and Mexican Spanish.
∙ Full High Def 3D textured environments. 
∙ Full 3D physics at 60 FPS.
∙ Practice: Fine tune your game by playing on your own with no rules. 
∙ Quick Play: Play a custom match against other friends, family members or computer opponents. 
∙ League: Participate in league events with 3, 5, 7 or 9 rounds where the highest points total wins.
∙ Tournament: Test your nerves in a 4 round knockout tournament event. 
∙ Multi player hot seat up to 4 players.
∙ Fully adjustable address including position and direction.
∙ Full spin control and shot shape setup.
∙ Configure up to 4 player profiles to keep track of all your statistics. 
∙ Each profile contains comprehensive statistics and progression history. 
∙ Progress through the ranks from Rookie to Legend. Beware you can go down the ranks as well as up. 
∙ Over 20 bowling balls to choose from.
∙ Ball weight customization.
∙ 10 bowling alleys to choose from.
∙ 12 pin styles to choose from.
∙ 28 computer opponents with customizable names. Play against the pros!
∙ Play against 25 different computer opponents spread over 5 difficulty levels. 
∙ Fully working lane mechanics including gutter bumpers (If needed!).
∙ Save your favorite shots and watch them with complete video playback.
∙ Over 20 achievements to collect locally or via Game Center. 
∙ Track your game progress and achievement progress locally in the new 3D Trophy Room.
∙ Leader boards and exclusive membership to The 300 Club (If you are good enough).
∙ Take action photos and share them via Email or save them to your device.
∙ Multiplayer game modes including ‘Online Play’, ‘Local Network’ and 'Pass and Play'.

bluejetty:00029276:ios.summary:
CamPlan gives you a fast, modern way to create 2D and 3D floor plans, room layouts, and interior design concepts with LiDAR scanning, AI design tools, detailed exports, and real-time collaboration.
Floor Plan Scanner & Creator
• LiDAR-base
bluejetty:00029276:ios.description:
CamPlan gives you a fast, modern way to create 2D and 3D floor plans, room layouts, and interior design concepts with LiDAR scanning, AI design tools, detailed exports, and real-time collaboration.
Floor Plan Scanner & Creator
• LiDAR-based capture: Use your iPhone or iPad to scan a room. Walls, windows, doors, and measurements are detected automatically.
• 2D and 3D editing: Adjust layouts in a flat view or explore a rendered 3D model.
• AR preview: Place the virtual plan back into the real space to check scale and positioning.
• Detailed export options: Export floor plans as images, PDFs, 3D files, and professional formats including USDZ, OBJ, DXF, CAD, DAE, and more.
• Symbols & text: Add notes, labels, annotations, electrical symbols, and other plan details.
• Real-time collaboration: Share projects and work together with others on the same plan.
• Estimates: turn scanned floor plans into professional quotes with automatically measured quantities, reusable price lists, and AI-assisted line items. Review pricing, add taxes and markups, export branded PDFs, create invoices, and track payments.
AI Interior & Home Designer
• Photo-driven redesign: Snap a picture of any room and describe changes like “paint walls blue,” “add a reading nook,” or “switch to Scandinavian style.”
• Style guidance: Get ideas for colors, furniture, lighting, materials, and layouts that suit your space.
• Real-time updates: See design adjustments applied instantly.
Available on iOS, iPadOS, and macOS, CamPlan offers an optimized interface with platform-specific gestures for a seamless experience. Enjoy accessibility support, including light and dark modes.
CamPlan is ideal for homeowners, real estate agents, electricians, renovators, interior designers, contractors, and architects.
CamPlan Plus, Pro and Business are available as auto-renewing subscriptions. Payment will be charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. Your subscription renews automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscription in your Apple Account settings. You will continue to receive full functionality until the end of your current subscription period, but unused portions cannot be refunded.
Terms of Use and Privacy Policy: https://camplan.ai/terms

bluejetty:00180866:ios.description:
Sign any document with your real handwritten signature. Secure, professional, and fast.
Signature Scan is the signature app built for professionals who need to sign contracts, official documents, or any file quickly, without losing the personal touch of a real signature.
Sign With Your Real Signature, Not a Scribble
Forget digital scribbles or generic fonts. Write your signature on paper, scan signature with your phone camera, and let the app clean the background automatically.
In seconds, you’ll have a transparent, professional-looking real signature ready to use in PDFs, forms, or business agreements.
Whether you’re a freelancer, small business owner, or employer, this signature maker keeps your signature authentic and consistent across every document.
How to sign contracts & documents online?
Open any file. PDF, image, or scanned document and sign PDF free right from your phone.
Use it to sign contracts, invoices, NDAs, and client agreements without printing or scanning again.
Signature Scan works as your all-in-one document signature app, giving you a simple way to sign and share files from anywhere.
Professional Look, Real Authenticity
Your handwritten signature shouldn’t look artificial.
Our AI engine refines every detail. Removing shadows and paper lines while keeping the natural flow of your handwriting.
The result is a clean, credible, digital signature app output that looks like you just signed in ink.
Safe, Private, and Reliable
This signature app free keeps your signatures stored securely on your device. Nothing is uploaded or shared, only you can access and apply your free signature.
No ads, no cloud storage, no data tracking. Just a fast, professional tool that respects your privacy and time.
Why Professionals Choose Signature Scan
• Perfect for signing contracts, NDAs, and business agreements
• Fast, accurate, and easy to use; great for freelancers and small teams
• Capture and clean your handwritten signature automatically
• Scan signature from paper with one tap - no tracing or stylus needed
• Works as both signature maker and document signature app
• Use your signature app to sign PDF free and send instantly
Built for Professionals
Signature Scan delivers a real, secure, and professional signing experience; from official documents to work contracts and everything in between.
Create and use your real signature anywhere; without scanners, printers, or wasted time.
Signature Scan is your trusted signature app. The easiest way to scan signature, sign PDF free, and create your signature maker designs for any professional document.
Download now and experience the difference of signing with your own handwriting.

■ 자주 묻는 질문
● 유전자 검사 결과는 어떻게 관리 되나요?

bluejetty:00037701:ios.summary:

H
bluejetty:00037701:ios.description:
Feature Introduction:
BoardNotes is a versatile handwriting note-taking app that integrates five major functions—whiteboard, notebook, PDF, mind map, and flashcards—covering most note-taking scenarios. It serves as your All-In-One App. 
Handwriting Pen：
1. BoardNotes utilizes Apple's native pen technology and has developed additional pens tailored for Chinese writing, including a fountain pen, a laser pointer for presentations, and a tape pen for masking notes. 
2. Choose from a variety of brushes (laser pen, tape pen, ballpoint pen, straight-line pen, wavy-line pen, custom fountain pen, quill pen, pencil, marker, watercolor pen, fill pen, single-line pen, crayon, freehand pen) to unleash your creativity. 
3. Lasso tool (extremely powerful). 
4. Eraser (pixel eraser and object eraser). 
Whiteboard：
1. The whiteboard is ideal for organizing fragmented knowledge, brainstorming, and boosting creativity. 
2. Write and draw freely without worrying about boundaries. 
3. Customize background colors and grid templates. 
4. Add various card types (text, image, video, audio, webpage, file, handwriting). 
5. Multiple auxiliary tools: background board, pins, link navigation (supports bidirectional links), connectors, timer (countdown supported), calculator. 
6. Quickly locate notes using the search function. 
Notebook & PDF：
1. Create notebooks and PDFs with multiple paper templates and cover options. Import images from Photos or PDFs from the Files app as pages or covers. 
2. Add text, images, stickers, videos, webpage snapshots, audio recordings, links (bidirectional links supported), timers, calculators, and floating PDF windows. 
3. Layer functionality—show or hide layers as needed. 
4. Insert new pages via blank sheets, images, scanned documents, or files. 
5. Cut, copy, and paste pages into other notebooks or PDFs. 
6. Duplicate, rotate, or delete pages. 
7. Reorder pages via long-press and drag in thumbnail view. 
8. Create outlines and add bookmarks. 
9. Search (text, handwritten notes, etc.). 
10. Import e-books (epub, mobi, azw, etc.). 
Mind Map：
1. Mind mapping is a key feature within the whiteboard. 
2. Nodes support multiple formats (text, image, handwriting, video, audio, webpage snapshot, file). 
3. Offers 3 structures and 18 color schemes. 
4. Add summaries (brackets). 
5. Handwritten mind maps (using handwritten cards). 
6. Long-press and drag selected cards into the mind map. 
7. Reorder nodes or adjust hierarchy via long-press and drag. 
Flashcard：
1. Flashcards use the SuperMemo algorithm to automatically schedule optimal review intervals, reminding you before forgetting to maximize memory efficiency. 
2. Flashcards support text, images, and handwriting. 
3. Quickly create cards from notes in whiteboards, notebooks, or PDFs using the rectangular lasso tool. 
Download BoardNotes for free on iPad, iPhone, and Mac. 
For suggestions, please contact us via the in-app feedback feature.

My Cat Town is a fun cat game that everybody will love. It has cute cats & kittens which everyone will adore. Pretend to be a caretaker and take care of cats & kittens, play with cats all day long. There is no limit to having fun with this awesome pet game. This pet game is for girls & boys. Amazing, isn't it?

My cat town has so many surprises for you! Enter this new pretend play pet world and discover amazing surprises when you touch on the screen. Play with different cats, cat toys & kittens in this cat game. This cat pet world is perfect for kids 1, 2, 3, 4. 5. 6, 7, 8 year olds.

What you can do in this Pet Games for Girls & Boys?
- Play with the cute cats in the house!
Be a part of a cat's life. Pet your purring cats in the house. Play with cats along with cat playhouse, cat tree house, and such many more things that cats love!
- Play with the cute cats in the garden!
Play with a treehouse, bushes in the garden. Do outdoor activities with your cats in the garden area.
- Play with different cats!
You don't have to pet just one cat! There are so many different cute cats!
- Enjoy playing with them in my cat games.

Features of the new pet world of cats:
- Tap, drag, and interact with every object you see to discover hidden surprises.
- Ideal for little explorers of age 1, 2, 3, 4. 5. 6, 7, 8 year olds.
- 5 locations to play with cute cats.

If you are a true animal lover or cat lover or pet lover you will definitely download this My Cat Town. You will never find an amazing pet game like this anywhere so, what are you waiting for? Download this My Cat Town - Pet Games for Girls & Boys NOW & let the fun begin! Enjoy 3 scenes and Character Creator absolutely free. Remaining scenes can be unlocked for a tiny fee.

My Cat Town - Pet Games for Girls & Boys is one of the best games from our My Animal Town series of games. You can also check out My Squirrel Home, My Monster Town, My Animal Town games. You'll definitely love these games!

bluejetty:00166350:ios.description:
Love reading manga, manhwa, or webtoons? Open Manga Reader Infinity – the perfect manga reading app for manga lovers, completely free.
All manga can be read online for free and downloaded for offline reading.
Dive into a vast world of manga, spanning all your favorite genres: romance, fantasy, action, adventure, horror, drama, school life, manhwa, webtoon, and more!
Read manga quickly and experience an endless library with these amazing features:
Key Features
• Latest Manga Updates Hourly
With Manga Reader Infinity, you’ll always get access to the latest manga chapters, updated continuously throughout the day. Never miss a release waiting for you to explore.
• Advanced Manga Search
Find any genre you can imagine, from action to romance, or dramatic tales to unique manhwa and manhua. Whatever your interest, it’s here!
• Multiple Reading Modes
Choose the mode that suits your style: horizontal for a traditional manga experience, vertical for easy scrolling, and auto mode for ultimate convenience.
• Smart Page Display
Enjoy seamless reading with smart page display, allowing you to easily pick up where you left off without any hassle.
• Personalized Manga Recommendations
Get manga suggestions tailored to your interests and discover new and exciting series.
• Your Personal Library
Store your favorite manga in a personal library for easy management and quick access anytime.
• New Chapter Notifications
Never miss an update! Get instant notifications when new chapters are released for the manga in your personal library. Stay up to date with your favorite series effortlessly.
• Share Manga Content
Share manga story images effortlessly with a single tap!
• High-Quality Artwork
Immerse yourself in stunning, high-resolution artwork that enhances your reading experience.
• Multi-Language Support
No worries about language barriers—Manga Reader: Infinity supports multiple languages, letting you read manga in your preferred language.
Why Choose Manga Reader: Infinity?
• Free manga downloads
• Updated daily with trending manga
• Supports all popular genres
• Accessible offline anytime
Terms of Use: https://sevenseasapps.com/terms-and-conditions/
Privacy Policy: https://sevenseasapps.com/privacy-policy/
ALWAYS LISTENING:
Manga Infinity eagerly welcomes your feedback and suggestions!
Disclaimer
Manga Reader Infinity is intended to help users access images from third-party websites solely for reading purposes. We do not host or store any content on our servers. All materials available through Manga Reader Infinity are sourced from external sites. We are committed to respecting copyright laws and will restrict access to content if legally required.

bluejetty:00063372:ios.description:
A lot of incidents happened in Fixies Town! The town needs its heroes!
Restore order and save the town with little funny creatures The Fixies. Nolik, SImka, Fire, Verda, Toola, Digit, Papus, Masiya and Grandpus are waiting for all kids!
Complete missions: 
"Catching Spiders"
Fill the jar with spiders! Catch them until they hide!
"Hide and seek"
The Fixies got lost in the dark room. Find them all!
"Catch the dog"
The dog is in the kitchen! Catch it until it eats all food!
"Entraining"
Put goods into the train and send it to town. Drag items to correct places on the train.
"Right places"
What a mess in the room! Find right places for all things!
"Electricity leakage"
Seems there is an electricity leakage! Catch sparks to repair it!
"The railway"
The railway is broken! Fix the rails to let the train pass!
"Clean up"
What a mess in the room! Everything is broken! Use tools to clean it up!
"Vitamins"
Catch vitamins and feed The Fixies!
"Chocolate"
Find right places for chocolates in a box!
"Electricity"
Complete the maze and light all bulbs!
"Submarine"
Fix the tube for the Submarine to deliver goods to town!
"Bee flight"
Help Papus reach his destination by ruling the bee and avoiding snakes on the way! 
Complete all missions and restore order in Fixies Town! The game that all kids are in love with!

bluejetty:00143626:ios.description:
Kombo, France's leading ticket website for all forms of transport: train, bus and plane. 
Kombo is new: book all your tickets on a single App!
All companies in one place! Book tickets for companies like SNCF, Trenitalia and Renfe directly on Kombo.
Download our app because we've done everything to make it easy to use! 
Want to pay less: you'll find offers from Flixbus, Blablacar Bus, carpooling and even flights. 
And sometimes car hire is cheaper too. 
WHY KOMBO?
• Journeys up to 50% cheaper by comparing train, bus and plane.
• 400 train, bus, plane and car-sharing companies.
• Customer service available 7 days a week.
• Your tickets directly on your smartphone.
• Over 100,000 possible journeys.
• 1 million visitors per month.
• 4.7/5 on truspilot (2500 reviews)
HOW TO PAY
• Paypal, Apple Pay, Google Pay
• Mastercard and Visa
WHICH COMPANIES IN FRANCE?
• By train: SNCF, TGV Inoui, Ouigo, Trenitalia, Eurostar, TER, Thalys, Frecciarossa...
• By bus: Flixbus, Blablabus, Alsa, Altibus, National Express...
• By carpool: Blablacar.
WHICH COMPANIES IN ITALY?
• By train: Trenitalia, Italo, Frecciarossa...
• By bus: Flixbus, Marino Bus, Marozzi, Itabus...
• By carpool: Blablacar.
WHICH COMPANIES IN SPAIN?
• By train: Ouigo España, Iryo, and soon Renfe
• By bus: Alsa, Socibus, Movelia, Damas, Cambus, Interbus, Linecar, Aisa etc.
• By carpool: Blablacar.
WHICH OTHER TRAIN COMPANIES?
• In Belgium: SNCB, European Sleeper
• In the Netherlands: NS
• In Switzerland: SBB, CFF, FFS
WHICH AIRLINES?
• Air France, Easyjet, Transavia, Royal Air Maroc, Air Algérie, Ryanair, Volotea, Vueling, Ita Airways, Iberia...
WHICH CAR RENTALS? 
• Avis, Hertz, Sixt, Europcar, Budget, Enterprise, Ada, Alamo...
WHAT'S THE DIFFERENCE?
• Compared with Comparabus, Kelbillet, Busradar or Checkmybus, you can buy tickets right on the app, at the best price.
• Compared to Omio, Busbud, SNCF Connect, Trainline, we have more routes because we combine bus, train and plane tickets.
WHAT ARE THE ADVANTAGES?
• Automatic reimbursement in the event of train delays.
• Offset your CO2 emissions by planting trees.
• Invoice available in 1 click.
If you have any questions, contact our customer service department, and we'll get back to you within 4 hours.

bluejetty:00159696:ios.summary:
Send personalized mass texts to hundreds of contacts at once — every recipient gets a private message that feels like you wrote it just for them. Or switch to group chat mode when you need everyone in one conversation.
Trusted by realtors,
bluejetty:00159696:ios.description:
Send personalized mass texts to hundreds of contacts at once — every recipient gets a private message that feels like you wrote it just for them. Or switch to group chat mode when you need everyone in one conversation.
Trusted by realtors, coaches, churches, event planners, restaurants, and small business owners across the United States.
WHY MASSTEXTER?
• Personalized 1-on-1 Bulk SMS
Send mass messages that land as individual private texts. Each contact sees only their own message, and every reply comes back to you only.
• Group Chat Mode When You Need It
Switch to group sending when you want everyone to see the conversation — perfect for coordinating events, family chats, or team updates.
• Smart Personalization
Use placeholders like [firstname], [lastname], and custom fields. "Hey [firstname]" becomes "Hey Sarah" automatically. Every contact feels personally addressed.
• Send From Your Own Phone Number
Use your own iPhone number and your regular unlimited texting plan. No business registration required, no separate texting service to sign up for, no per-message charges.
• Pacing Between Messages for Larger Lists
Built-in delays between sends help you space out messages naturally when reaching out to many contacts at once.
• CSV Import & Contact Groups
Import contacts from a CSV file or your iCloud address book. Organize them into reusable groups and update them anytime.
• Templates That Save Hours
Save your most frequently sent messages as templates. Pick one, personalize, send in seconds.
• Image Attachments
Attach photos to your messages — perfect for property listings, event flyers, menus, and product launches.
BUILT FOR YOUR PROFESSION
- Realtors & Real Estate Agents — Follow up with leads, announce open houses, share new listings with interested buyers
- Coaches, Trainers & Studios — Send class schedules, workout reminders, and check-ins
- Event Planners — Coordinate guests, share venue updates, send save-the-dates and last-minute changes
- Churches & Nonprofits — Send daily devotions, announce events, run prayer chains and outreach campaigns
- Restaurants & Salons — Announce specials, send booking reminders, recover no-shows with friendly follow-ups
- Sales Teams — Warm, personal follow-ups at scale that don't sound automated
- Service Pros (Plumbers, Electricians, Cleaners, Landscapers) — Booking confirmations, ETA updates, payment reminders, thank-you messages
- Teachers & Sports Coaches — Class updates, parent notifications, practice and game reminders
- Property Managers — Maintenance notices, rent reminders, community announcements
- Small Business Owners — Customer outreach, promotions, holiday greetings, loyalty messages
HOW IT WORKS
1. Import your contacts from your phone, iCloud, or a CSV file
2. Choose your sending mode — personalized 1-on-1 or group chat
3. Write your message using personalization tags or pick from your templates
4. Tap send — and you're done
COMMON USE CASES
→ Send daily devotions to your church or prayer group
→ Announce new property listings to all interested buyers
→ Send class reminders to parents the night before
→ Coordinate a birthday party or wedding in one group chat
→ Send personalized holiday greetings to every client on your list
SUBSCRIPTION DETAILS
Start free to explore the app. Upgrade to Pro to unlock unlimited messaging, larger group sizes, and advanced features.
Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage and cancel your subscription anytime in your Apple ID account settings on the App Store.
SUPPORT
Need help? Email us at ivkalapps@gmail.com — we typically reply within 24 hours.
Privacy Policy: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1rKJfgpC98Odno_iLiGD16OWgwFsvSGirkyOkD8JSFdk
Terms of Use: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1UWX5jFP3IfYSITHUa3Ielg04CSlr4FrtHZWf_ZTKoYM

bluejetty:00076345:ios.description:
Welcome to "Escape Room: Grim of Legacy" by HFG ENTERTAINMENTS! Get ready to embark on an exciting adventure filled with mystery and challenges in this point-and-click escape game.
GAME STORY 1:
The archaeologist brings the box home and carefully examines it, unaware of its true nature. Meanwhile, his young daughter, full of curiosity and innocence, unknowingly takes the box, mistaking it for a toy or a simple trinket. As she opens the box, a radiant portal materializes before her, beckoning her to step inside.
With a childlike sense of wonder, the archaeologist's daughter hesitantly steps through the portal, finding herself transported to an entirely different world. The Hebrew Bible Offline lets you access the Holy Scriptures without an internet connection, making it easy to read anytime and anywhere. It includes the sacred writings of ancient Israel, grouped into the Torah, Nevi’im, and Ketuvim, sharing the history, beliefs, and relationship between God and His people.

Features:
Daily Verse: Set reminders for daily Bible verse notifications.
MY LIBRARY: Access your highlights, notes, and bookmarked verses.
Old & New Testaments: Read both Testaments in one app.
Verse Editor: Create beautiful verse posts with backgrounds and share them.
Nearby Churches: Find churches near your location.
Books: Explore a collection of Christian eBooks.
Wallpapers: Browse beautiful and inspiring wallpapers.
Videos: Watch videos on Jesus, Hope, Wisdom, Motivation, Gratitude, Healing, and more.
Festive Calendar: Explore Christian festivals and feast days.
Popular Verse: Discover verses by topics like love, fear, and peace.
Customise Your Bible: Adjust fonts and text colors for comfortable reading.
1000 Praises: Explore a devotional collection honoring God’s names and attributes.
Bible Quotes: Share Bible quotes in image and text formats.
Bible Quiz: Test your Bible knowledge with engaging quizzes.
Bible Stories: Read timeless and inspiring Bible stories for all ages.
Bible FAQ: Find quick answers to common Bible and Christian life questions.
Verse Comments: Share thoughts and engage in community discussions.
Help Desk: Submit support requests with photo attachments.
Dictionary: Access a Bible-based dictionary with easy search.
Dream Meanings: Explore Biblical and Christian perspectives on dreams.
Word Highlights: Highlight words or letters for deeper reflection.
App Activity: Track reading streaks, time spent, refreshes, and app usage.
Search: Quickly find verses, chapters, and topics.
Products: Explore Bible-related products within the app.
VerseBot: Get AI-powered verse explanations with easy copy and sharing.
Notification History: Access your past notifications in one place.
Did You Know?: Discover daily facts about the Bible and Christian faith.
Bible Verse Clips: Enjoy short, inspirational Bible clips from the community.
Prayer Request: Submit prayer requests and receive community support.
Nearby Events: Discover Christian events and gatherings near you.
Chapter-Wise Video Learning: Watch videos for deeper chapter understanding.
Interactive Bible Games: Enjoy scripture-based games like SlideScript and VerseHunt.
Bible Clips: Watch short, inspiring Biblical clips from the faith community.
Bible Streaks: Maintain your daily Bible reading streak.
Background Music: Enjoy calming music while reading the Bible.
Mark as Read – Quiz: Take quizzes based on the verses you’ve read.

Alarm: Set timely alarms and reminders for scheduled activities.
Worship Songs: Praise and connect with God through uplifting songs and lyrics.

bluejetty:00086249:ios.description:

How It
bluejetty:00100484:ios.description:
Ready for a unique brain challenge?
 Word Match: Card Solitaire cleverly combines word association with the satisfying pleasure of card sorting. Keep your mind active while enjoying a relaxing experience.
A simple and addictive game
How It Works
- Core Gameplay: Draw cards and drag them into the correct category based on word meaning or visual image clues.
- Dual Matching System: Solve puzzles using either word logic or visual intuition from the card images.
- Magic Booster: Stuck? Use the magic wand to instantly match a pair and move forward.
- Global Competition: Challenge yourself to finish faster and compete with players worldwide on global leaderboards.
Features
- Relaxing and Fun: Simple drag-and-drop controls, perfect for a calm yet engaging mental break.
- Clean Visual Design: A clear, elegant interface that enhances immersion and the satisfaction of sorting.
- Smart Hints: An intelligent hint system provides help exactly when you need it.
- Fully Offline: No internet connection required. Play anytime, anywhere.
Word Match: Card Solitaire is a refined puzzle game that keeps your brain active while helping you unwind.
Download now and begin your journey of organized thinking and enjoyable challenges!

bluejetty:00174891:ios.name: Classic Camera by Hipstamatic
bluejetty:00174891:ios.summary:
Hipstamatic is a world-class photography app and Apple’s original App of the Year!
Shoot beautiful authentic photography and become part of the world’s most creative community, exclusively on iPhone.
• Apple’s very first App of the Year
•
bluejetty:00174891:ios.description:
Hipstamatic is a world-class photography app and Apple’s original App of the Year!
Shoot beautiful authentic photography and become part of the world’s most creative community, exclusively on iPhone.
• Apple’s very first App of the Year
• The original photo filter app
• The inventor of square filtered mobile photos
• Plus, all of the features below :-)
—
CLASSIC CAMERA
Digital photography has never looked so analog. Shooting Classic provides beautifully rendered skeuomorphic cameras that transform your experience as you swipe through lenses, flashes, and films. 
■ Use Multiple Exposure to shoot multiple images in one shot and get amazing artistic results ■
—
PRO CAMERA
For the mobile photographer looking for a minimal capture interface with maximum control, shooting Pro gives you ultimate creative control.
■ Manually control focus, white balance, exposure, shutter speed, ISO, and aspect ratio ■
—
DARKROOM EDITING SUITE
A full editing suite including over 20 professional adjustment tools and 12 signature presets.
• Classic Lens, Film, and Flash
• Crop
• Straighten & Rotate
• Skew
• Exposure
• Clarity
• Definition
• Exposure
• Clarity
• Definition
• Highlights
• Shadows
• Vibrancy
• Fade
• Curves (RGB + Red + Green + Blue)
• Temperature
• Tint
• Depth of field
• Texture
• Grain
• Vignette
• Before & After view by holding down image in edit view
• Undo & Redo by swiping left and right
■ Choose the overall mood of your image with Hipstamatic's signature Lenses, Films, and Flashes, then fine tune with extensive editing tools ■
—
FAVORITE PRESETS
Create your own Favorite Presets and even share your signature look with others. If you are looking for inspiration hit the shuffle button and explore a world of serendipitous beauty.
• 12 World-class presets
• Customize and edit presets
• Save new presets
• Presets are synchronized across your devices with iCloud
• Share any favorite preset with other photographers
■ Define your signature looks, then quickly apply them to your photos with Copy/Paste support ■
— 
NATIVE WORKFLOW
Hipstamatic is fully synchronized with your photo library. Tap on any photo to instantly edit it, and see and organize your photos in either Hipstamatic or Apple Photos. 
• Runs natively on iPhone and iPad
• No need to import, just tap and edit
• Quickly Favorite or Delete photos
• Always full resolution
• Save as Separate Files (default) and keep your originals untouched
• Save as non-destructive Versions and streamline your photos with the original safely embedded within the Hipstamatic version (works best with iCloud Photo Library)
• Browse folders created in the Photos app
• Fully synchronized with Photos app and iCloud Photo Library
• View detailed metadata
• View shared image details across social networks (likes, comments, etc.)
• Capture and edit in RAW format
■ Shoot on iPhone and edit on iPad with fully native support and synchronized Favorite Presets via iCloud ■
— 
HipstaMart™ Shop
Browse amazing filter packs available for purchase via the In-App store created by the world’s most talented photo makers. Collaborations from top fashion and street photographers to famous artists like Salvador Dali with new packs available monthly.
PrintLab™
Get real physical prints delivered straight to your door. We built this service in 2010 because no service would print square photos, and today PrintLab is still the best square format printing service in the world. Shipping to over 200 countries!
• Print Prints (4”, 7”, 10”)
• 30” Gallery Prints
• Aluminum Prints (10” or 20”)
• Birch Wood Prints (10” or 20”)
— 
LET'S MAKE BEAUTIFUL PHOTOS TOGETHER
Help us make Hipstamatic the best app ever. Send your thoughts & comments to feedback@hipstamatic.com or message us anywhere @Hipstamatic
Thanks and welcome to the HipstaFamily!

bluejetty:00150875:ios.description:
F&M Mobile+ is built for your banking needs. It’s fast, secure, and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.
Here’s what you can do with F&M Mobile+:
· View account balances
· View recent activity
· Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
· Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
· Transfer money between accounts
· Deposit checks
· Turn your card on or off if you misplaced it
· View and save your monthly statements
· View our nearest location and ATMs near you
· Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode or biometric on supported devices
F&M Mobile+ is available to all F&M online banking customers. Accessing F&M Mobile+ is easy, simply use the same user ID and password you have established for online banking. Once you’re signed in, set up a passcode for faster access! If you are not already enrolled, you must first register for online banking at www.fmbankandtrust.com.
F&M Bank and Trust does not charge a fee for online banking or mobile banking, but mobile service provider data fees may apply.

bluejetty:00185724:ios.description:

Because it’s virtual, you won’t receive any real plush toys. But on the upside, you can easily get them as much as you want for free!

The 5th of the series which has been loved by more than 7 million players total.
