Life is fragmented. Sortifyd is the place where your life comes together.
Your secure, all-in-one life and family organizer helps you manage everyday plans and keep important information close at hand, from schedules and groceries to documents, spending, and live location sharing.
Use it on your own or coordinate with a partner, kids, roommates, or caregivers. Decide what each person can see.
Less juggling. More room for life.
Explore what you can do with Sortifyd:
CALENDAR & SCHEDULING
• Connect Google, Outlook, and iCloud calendars in one view
• Subscribe to school, sports, holiday, and other calendars
• Track appointments, meals, and tasks in one place
• Choose from list, day, week, or month views with color-coded events
TASKS & LISTS
• Create reusable lists for groceries, packing, chores, and to-dos, with attachments
• Assign tasks, set reminders and due dates, and manage recurring routines
• Automatically sort groceries by aisle, with store preferences and quantities
• Order groceries via Instacart in supported regions

bluejetty:00069744:ios.description:
Crews Bank is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.
Here’s what else you can do with Crews Bank:
Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
Transfer money between your accounts
Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you’ve misplaced it
View and save your monthly statements
Find branches and ATMs near you
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 
To use the Crews Bank app, you must be enrolled as an Crews State Bank & Trust digital banking user. If you currently use our Online Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Online Banking credentials.

Letter Rooms is wonderfully simple word game. Each puzzle shows you a hint and a set of letters to create the desired answer. Initially you have to rearrange the letters, but later you'll have to maste
bluejetty:00022065:ios.description:
+ Apple Design Award Finalist 2022! +
Letter Rooms is wonderfully simple word game. Each puzzle shows you a hint and a set of letters to create the desired answer. Initially you have to rearrange the letters, but later you'll have to master on-off and mutli-letters to succeed. The over 390 different puzzles will challenge your knowledge of things like animals, pop culture, sports or food! But don't despair if you don't know the answer - you can skip any level without consequences.
Features:
- Solve over 390 puzzles from 12 different topics, like animals, pop culture, sports, or culinary
- Kids mode with 180 puzzles made for kids from age 9-11
- Collaborative Multiplayer via SharePlay
- Accessibility features like the dyslexic font and support for VoiceOver and VoiceControl.
- Plus: Widget, GameCenter, ...
What reviewers said about Letter Rooms:
CultOfMac: "Letter Rooms is a canstfiat jumbled-word game for iOS"
148Apps: "Letter Rooms is a tight and clever puzzle game that understands that less is more."
MacStories Newsletter: "A simple anagram puzzle game with an elegant, playful design."
Metro GameCentral: "Each level’s brevity makes it a pleasant diversion when you’ve got a few minutes to spare, which is just what you need from mobile entertainment"
Hope you have fun with the game! If you have any suggestions or feedback, please reach out to me:
- Twitter: https://twitter.com/klemensstrasser
- Mail: support@strasser.app

bluejetty:00135969:ios.name: 갓피플성경
bluejetty:00135969:ios.summary:

- 92가지 맞춤설정으로 나에게 편한 성경을 만들고, 말씀을 읽고 듣고 묵상해 보세요. 혼자서도, 교회·소그룹과 함께 통독하며 말씀의 은혜를 나눌 수 있어요.
- 설치는 무료예요. 개역한글·KJV는 기본으로 들어 있고, 모든 역본·음원을 30일 동안 무료로 써 볼 수 있어요(자동결제 없음).
- 새로 나온 말씀카드 만들기로, 마음에 남은 말씀을 사진과 영상으로 만들어 가족·친구·소그룹과
bluejetty:00135969:ios.description:
갓피플성경으로 말씀을 더 가까이하세요.
- 92가지 맞춤설정으로 나에게 편한 성경을 만들고, 말씀을 읽고 듣고 묵상해 보세요. 혼자서도, 교회·소그룹과 함께 통독하며 말씀의 은혜를 나눌 수 있어요.
- 설치는 무료예요. 개역한글·KJV는 기본으로 들어 있고, 모든 역본·음원을 30일 동안 무료로 써 볼 수 있어요(자동결제 없음).
- 새로 나온 말씀카드 만들기로, 마음에 남은 말씀을 사진과 영상으로 만들어 가족·친구·소그룹과 나눠 보세요.
■ 1. 92가지 맞춤설정, 나에게 편한 성경
- 글자 크기와 굵기, 줄 간격, 배경색, 예수님 말씀 별색(예수님 말씀을 다른 색으로), 새롭게 다듬은 어두운 테마(블랙·야간)까지 내 눈에 편하게 바꿀 수 있어요.
- 본문 글꼴은 한글과 영어를 따로 고를 수 있어요. 한글은 명조·고딕은 물론 수트, 리디바탕, 온글잎 등 13종, 영어는 Georgia·Helvetica Neue 등 4종이에요.
- 설정 이름을 몰라도 «글자 크기»처럼 검색하면 바로 찾아 주고, 샘플 본문으로 바뀐 모습을 미리 볼 수 있어요.
- 성경 검색, 관주(연관 구절), 북클립, 북마크, 히스토리(아까 본 구절 다시 찾기)도 쓸 수 있어요.
■ 2. 눈으로 읽고, 오디오 성경으로 듣고
- 이동 중이거나 눈으로 읽기 어려운 시간에는 오디오 성경으로 말씀을 들어 보세요.
- 음성에 맞춰 읽는 구절이 강조되어, 들으면서 본문을 따라 읽을 수 있어요. (30일 체험 후 구매)
■ 3. 혼자서도, 함께해도 좋은 성경통독
- 통독은 성경을 처음부터 끝까지 읽어 가는 일이에요. 맥체인 성경읽기표, 하루 15분 성경 1독 같은 통독계획표를 골라 시작해 보세요.
- 읽은 분량과 진행 상황은 그래프로 확인하고, 날짜를 건너뛰어도 이어서 읽을 수 있어요.
- 교회·청년부·소그룹은 모임을 만들어 함께 통독하고, 서로의 읽기 현황과 감사를 나눌 수 있어요.
■ 4. 말씀의 은혜를 기록하는 마이노트
- 마음에 남은 구절과 묵상을 기록하고, #태그와 형광펜으로 정리해 보세요.
- @를 쓰면 성경 구절을 바로 넣을 수 있고, 쓴 노트는 성경 본문 아래에서 함께 볼 수 있어요.
- 굵게·제목·목록 같은 마크다운 서식으로 노트를 꾸밀 수 있어요. 노트마다 켜고 끌 수 있어요.
- 로그인하면 기록과 구매한 역본이 iPhone과 iPad에서 동기화되고, 마이노트는 TXT 파일로 백업할 수 있어요.
■ 5. 감사와 말씀으로 채우는 하루
- 한줄감사에 오늘의 감사를 메시지처럼 짧게 남기고, 감사챌린지로 꾸준히 이어 가 보세요. 공개한 감사는 모임원들과 나눌 수 있어요.
- 말씀 알림을 누르면 사진 위에 말씀이 카드로 펼쳐져요.
■ 6. 좋아하는 말씀을 이미지와 영상으로 나누기
- 기억하고 싶은 구절을 말씀카드로 만들어 보세요.
- 배경 사진과 글꼴을 골라 이미지로 저장하거나, 글자가 떠오르는 영상으로 만들어 가족·친구·소그룹과 나눌 수 있어요. 내 사진을 배경으로 쓸 수도 있어요.
■ 7. 다양한 역본과 깊이 있는 성경 공부
- 개역한글과 KJV는 기본으로 들어 있고, 개역개정·쉬운성경·새번역·우리말성경·NIV·ESV·NLT·NASB는 앱 안에서 구매해 쓸 수 있어요.
- 역본비교, 한영대조, 성경관주, 히브리어·헬라어 원어사전으로 말씀을 더 깊이 살펴보세요.
- 역본·음원·자료는 소중한 분께 선물할 수도 있어요.
■ 이런 분께 추천해요
- 성경을 처음부터 끝까지 읽어 보고 싶은 분
- 큐티(매일 말씀 묵상)와 설교 노트를 한곳에 쓰고 싶은 분
- 밤이나 새벽에 눈이 편한 화면으로 읽고 싶은 분
- 교회·소그룹과 함께 성경을 읽고 싶은 분
■ 처음이라면 이렇게 시작해 보세요
1. 설치하고 로그인해요. 기록과 구매한 역본이 동기화·백업돼요.
2. 전체설정에서 글자 크기와 글꼴을 내게 맞춰요.
3. 통독계획표를 고르고 말씀 알림을 켜요.
■ 부담 없이 시작하세요
- 앱 무료 설치
- 개인·모임 통독읽기표에서 개역개정 역본과 음원 무료 이용
- 모든 역본·음원 30일 무료 체험 (자동결제 없음)
※ 체험이 끝난 뒤 일부 역본·음원·자료는 별도 구매가 필요해요.
※ 2012년 출시 후 10년간 도서 유료 1위였던 갓피플성경이 2022년부터 무료 설치 후 구매 방식으로 더 많은 분들과 함께하고 있어요.
말씀을 가까이하는 시간이 매일의 기쁨이 되도록, 갓피플성경이 함께할게요.
[고객센터]
문의: 갓피플성경 > 더보기 > 고객센터
리뷰보다 고객센터로 남겨 주시면 더 자세하고 빠르게 답변드릴 수 있어요.
[성경 역본 저작권 안내]
- 개역개정, 새번역의 저작권은 대한성서공회에 있음.
- 쉬운성경의 저작권은 (주)아가페출판사에 있음.
- 우리말성경의 저작권은 (사)두란노서원에 있음.

- The Holy Bible, English Standard Version © 2001 Crossway Bibles, a publishing ministry of Good News Publishers. All rights reserved.
- New American Standard Bible®, Copyright © 1960, 1971, 1977, 1995, 2020 by The Lockman Foundation. All rights reserved.
[접근 권한 안내]
- 필수적 접근 권한: 기기·앱 기록(앱 상태 확인 및 사용성 개선), 저장 공간(읽기 기록·형광펜·노트·음원 저장), 전화(음원 재생 중 전화 수신 시 볼륨 조절)
- 선택적 접근 권한: 카메라(프로필 사진 등록), 사진(말씀카드 이미지·영상 저장, 프로필 사진 등록, 콘텐츠 이미지 저장)

■ 4. 말씀의 은혜를 기록하는 마이노트

- 마음에 남은 구절과 묵상을 기록하고, #태그와 형광펜으로 정리해 보세요.
- @를 쓰면 성경 구절을 바로 넣을 수 있고, 쓴 노트는 성경 본문 아래에서 함께 볼 수 있어요.
- 굵게·제목·목록 같은 마크다운 서식으로 노트를 꾸밀 수 있어요. 노트마다 켜고 끌 수 있어요.
- 로그인하면 기록과 구매한 역본이 iPhone과 iPad에서 동기화되고, 마이노트는 TXT 파일로 백업할 수 있어요.


■ 5. 감사와 말씀으로 채우는 하루

- 한줄감사에 오늘의 감사를 메시지처럼 짧게 남기고, 감사챌린지로 꾸준히 이어 가 보세요. 공개한 감사는 모임원들과 나눌 수 있어요.
- 말씀 알림을 누르면 사진 위에 말씀이 카드로 펼쳐져요.


■ 6. 좋아하는 말씀을 이미지와 영상으로 나누기

- 기억하고 싶은 구절을 말씀카드로 만들어 보세요.
- 배경 사진과 글꼴을 골라 이미지로 저장하거나, 글자가 떠오르는 영상으로 만들어 가족·친구·소그룹과 나눌 수 있어요. 내 사진을 배경으로 쓸 수도 있어요.


■ 7. 다양한 역본과 깊이 있는 성경 공부

- 개역한글과 KJV는 기본으로 들어 있고, 개역개정·쉬운성경·새번역·우리말성경·NIV·ESV·NLT·NASB는 앱 안에서 구매해 쓸 수 있어요.
- 역본비교, 한영대조, 성경관주, 히브리어·헬라어 원어사전으로 말씀을 더 깊이 살펴보세요.
- 역본·음원·자료는 소중한 분께 선물할 수도 있어요.


■ 이런 분께 추천해요

- 성경을 처음부터 끝까지 읽어 보고 싶은 분
- 큐티(매일 말씀 묵상)와 설교 노트를 한곳에 쓰고 싶은 분
- 밤이나 새벽에 눈이 편한 화면으로 읽고 싶은 분
- 교회·소그룹과 함께 성경을 읽고 싶은 분

■ 처음이라면 이렇게 시작해 보세요

1. 설치하고 로그인해요. 기록과 구매한 역본이 동기화·백업돼요.
2. 전체설정에서 글자 크기와 글꼴을 내게 맞춰요.
3. 통독계획표를 고르고 말씀 알림을 켜요.

■ 부담 없이 시작하세요

- 앱 무료 설치
- 개인·모임 통독읽기표에서 개역개정 역본과 음원 무료 이용

bluejetty:00068847:ios.name: ASVAB Test Prep 2026
bluejetty:00068847:ios.summary: The ASVAB (Armed Services Vocational Aptitude Battery) is a multiple-aptitude battery that measures developed abilities and helps predict future academic and occupational success in the military. It is administered annually to more than one
bluejetty:00068847:ios.description:
The ASVAB (Armed Services Vocational Aptitude Battery) is a multiple-aptitude battery that measures developed abilities and helps predict future academic and occupational success in the military. It is administered annually to more than one million military applicants, high school, and post-secondary students.
The ASVAB tests are designed to measure aptitudes in four domains: Verbal, Math, Science and Technical, and Spatial. The table below describes the content of the ASVAB tests. There are 10 sections in the ASVAB: General Science, Arithmetic Reasoning, Word Knowledge, Paragraph Comprehension, Mathematics Knowledge, Electronics Information, Automotive Information, Shop Information, Mechanical Comprehension, Assembling Objects. The Armed Forces Qualification Test (AFQT) is a component of the ASVAB that assesses candidates for placement into the Armed Services, and considers the Arithmetic Reasoning, Word Knowledge, Paragraph Comprehension and Mathematics Knowledge sections of the ASVAB. Our app covers all 10 sections of the ASVAB.
Most ASVAB testing is conducted at a Military Entrance Processing Station (MEPS). If you do not live near a MEPS, you may take the ASVAB at a satellite location called a Military Entrance Test (MET) site. The ASVAB is administered by computer at all MEPS, and by paper and pencil at most MET sites. Regardless of whether you take the ASVAB by computer or paper and pencil, your scores should be very similar.
The computerized ASVAB (called the CAT-ASVAB) is an adaptive test, which means that the test adapts to your ability level. The computer software selects items that are suitable for you, based on your responses to earlier items in the test. Because the CAT-ASVAB is targeted toward your ability level, it is possible to administer a shorter test than is used in the paper and pencil administration.
You are allowed to complete the CAT-ASVAB at your own pace. That is, when you complete a test in the battery, you can immediately move on to the next section without waiting for everyone else to move on. The average examinee takes about 1 1/2 hours to complete the CAT-ASVAB.
- 1,500 Real Exam Questions
- Practice all 10 sections of the ASVAB 
- 75 Practice Tests, including section-specific practice tests
- 3 Full-Length Tests
- Get immediate feedback for correct or incorrect answers
- Full and Detailed Explanations - learn as you practice
- Dark Mode - allows you to study anywhere, anytime
- Progress Metrics - you can keep track of your results and score trends
- Track Past Test Results - Individual tests will be listed with pass or fail and your mark
- Review Errors - Review all your mistakes so you don't repeat them in the real test
- You can track how many questions you have done correctly, incorrectly, and get a final passing or failing score based on official passing grades
- Take a practice test and see if you can score well enough to pass the actual test
- Helpful hints and tips let you know how you can improve your score
- Send questions feedback directly from the app
-----------------------------------
If you choose to purchase the Full Access subscription, payment will be charged to your iTunes account, and your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period. Auto-renewal may be turned off at any time by going to your settings in the iTunes Store after purchase. Current Full Access subscription price starts at $1.29 USD/week. Prices are in USD, may vary in countries other than the U.S. and are subject to change without notice. No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during the active subscription period. If you don’t choose to purchase the subscription, you can simply continue accessing the sample content.

bluejetty:00172002:ios.description:
Introducing 'Healthy Recipes - FitFoodie' - your ultimate companion for achieving a healthier lifestyle through delicious and nourishing meals. Packed with a vast collection of wholesome recipes spanning salad, smoothies, soups, whole grain dishes, vegetarian delights, low-calorie desserts, high-protein meals, rejuvenating juices, informative cooking videos, and a range of useful features, this app is designed to support your journey towards eating well and feeling great.
Discover an extensive variety of nutritious options that will satisfy your taste buds and promote a balanced diet. Whether you're looking for low-calorie recipes, weight loss-friendly meals, or simply want to enjoy wholesome cooking, Our app has you covered. With an array of delectable dishes at your fingertips, you can explore a world of culinary possibilities that align with your health goals. If you're craving a refreshing salad, a nourishing smoothie, a comforting bowl of soup, or a protein-packed feast, our app offers recipes to suit every occasion and dietary need.
Key Features:
1. Full Offline Access: Access all the recipes, cooking videos, and features of the app even without an internet connection. Never let connectivity hinder your culinary exploration.
2. Save Favorites: Create a personalized collection of your most-loved recipes by saving them as favorites. Easily revisit and prepare your go-to dishes whenever you desire.
3. Comprehensive Recipe Search: Find the perfect recipe for any occasion or dietary preference with our robust search functionality. Explore categories, ingredients, or specific keywords to discover your next culinary adventure.
4. Calorie Details: Make informed decisions about your meals by accessing detailed calorie information for each recipe. Achieve a better understanding of your nutritional intake and support your weight management goals.
5. Tips and Cooking Instructions: Enhance your cooking skills and culinary knowledge with handy tips and step-by-step cooking instructions. Unlock the secrets of healthy cooking and create masterful dishes in your own kitchen.
6. Complete Ingredient Lists: Plan your grocery shopping efficiently with comprehensive ingredient lists for each recipe. Ensure you have everything you need to prepare a delightful and healthy meal.
7. Servings and Cooking Time: Adjust recipes based on the number of servings required, and easily estimate cooking times to fit your schedule. Flexibility and convenience are at your fingertips.
8. Cooking Videos: Watch engaging and informative cooking videos that guide you through the preparation process. Visualize techniques, gain confidence, and learn new skills from experienced chefs, right in the palm of your hand.

bluejetty:00080363:ios.name: Plant Identifier - Care Guide
bluejetty:00080363:ios.summary:
Your phone is a plant identifier, care guide, watering reminder, and disease scanner — all in one powerful app.
Snap a photo to identify any houseplant, flower, or tree in seconds. Get a personalized care plan, smart watering reminders, AI
bluejetty:00080363:ios.description:
Your phone is a plant identifier, care guide, watering reminder, and disease scanner — all in one powerful app.
Snap a photo to identify any houseplant, flower, or tree in seconds. Get a personalized care plan, smart watering reminders, AI disease diagnosis with leaf spot and root rot detection, and weather-based watering schedule advice.
WHY PLANT PARENTS CHOOSE THIS APP
• Identify any plant instantly — AI scanner recognizes thousands of species from a single photo
• Never forget to water — smart watering schedule and tracker for each plant and season
• Diagnose leaf problems early — AI detects yellow spots, leaf spots, root rot, and pests before damage spreads
• Track growth — photo journal captures your indoor plant's journey from seedling to thriving
• Weather-smart care — real-time data adjusts your watering schedule automatically
CORE FEATURES
AI Plant Identification
Point your camera at any leaf, flower, stem, or tree. Get matches with confidence scores, scientific and common names, and similar species. Works for houseplants, succulents, cacti, herbs, and wildflowers.
AI Disease & Health Diagnosis
Yellowing leaves? Brown spots? Wilting? Root rot? Photograph the issue and get a complete diagnosis: pathogen type, severity, urgency, and step-by-step treatment. Catches pests early, saving your plant before damage becomes irreversible.
Smart Watering Reminders
Per-plant reminders for watering, fertilizing, misting, pruning, and repotting. Your watering schedule adapts to species needs and seasons so nothing gets overwatered or neglected.
Weather-Integrated Care
Live weather data adjusts watering recommendations in real time. Heatwave alerts, rainy-week pauses, and frost warnings keep your routine optimized year-round.
Care Schedule & Calendar
See the week's tasks at a glance. Overdue items show delay badges. Filter by type: water, fertilize, prune, mist, or repot. Plant care becomes a simple daily habit.
Growth Tracker & Plant Journal
Record height, leaf count, and progress photos. Before-and-after comparisons show real results over time.
Pest & Bug Tracking
Log pest sightings and bug activity, track treatments, monitor recovery — integrated with the AI disease scanner.
Plant Tips Library
50+ articles covering watering, light, soil, seasonal care, propagation, pest control, and succulent care.
MORE TO LOVE
• Room Organization — group and filter houseplants by room
• Timeline — chronological care history for every plant
• Streaks — build daily care streaks and stay motivated
• Toxicity & Pet Safety — alerts for toxic houseplants near children or pets
• Notes — track soil mixes, purchase dates, personal observations
• 14+ Languages — use the app in your native language
WHO IT'S FOR
• Beginners with their first houseplant or indoor plant
• Busy people who need reliable watering reminders and a schedule tracker
• Collectors managing large indoor plant and flower collections
• Gardeners wanting AI plant identification, leaf scanner, and disease diagnosis
• Pet owners looking for toxicity alerts
• Anyone dealing with yellow leaves, spots, root rot, or pests
REAL RESULTS
• Right light = sturdier stems, richer color, fuller bloom on every flower
• Right watering schedule = no root rot, no wilting, no emergencies
• Early detection = leaf spots and yellow leaves solved before they spread
• Consistent habits = thriving indoor garden, even with a busy schedule
• Bug and pest control = healthy houseplants free from infestations
Free plan: 3 AI scans/day, unlimited plants, full care and watering schedule features.
Pro plan: 50 scans/day, advanced disease diagnosis, priority support.
Start caring smarter — PlantCare remembers your watering schedule so you can enjoy the growing.

bluejetty:00114846:ios.description:
Become the best version of yourself with MyFutureSelf, an AI powered companion that helps you think and act like the person you want to become. Instead of random tips, MyFutureSelf gives you a clear roadmap, daily guidance and progress tracking so your actions finally match your goals.
MyFutureSelf is a subscription-based app. A paid subscription is required to access all features after the free onboarding.
What MyFutureSelf does
- Helps you design a clear picture of your future self and what success looks like in your own life
- Turns that vision into simple daily actions across mindset, health, career and relationships
- Keeps you accountable with streaks, progress insights and gentle reminders
- Gives you an AI mentor you can talk to whenever you feel stuck or unmotivated
Design your future self
- Start with a guided onboarding that uncovers your goals, values and obstacles
- See a clear profile of your future self so you know who you are working toward
- Use this vision as a filter for decisions and daily choices
Follow your personal roadmap
- Receive structured 30 day roadmaps with daily tasks and reflections
- Tasks cover focus, habits, health, relationships and mindset so you grow in a balanced way
- Roadmaps adapt as you complete tasks and your situation changes
Talk to your future self
- Chat or talk with an AI mentor trained on your goals and context
- Ask for advice when you feel stuck, overwhelmed or unmotivated
- Get encouragement and perspective from the version of you that has already done the work
Build habits and stay consistent
- Track streaks so you see how often you are showing up for yourself
- Follow clear progress indicators instead of guessing if you are improving
- Celebrate milestones so you actually notice how far you have come
Mindset and wellbeing support
- Tools that help with focus, motivation and better daily decisions
- Space to reflect, journal and reset when you slip
- Content grounded in psychology and behavior change to support long term growth
Who MyFutureSelf is for
- Professionals who want to advance their career with more clarity and focus
- Entrepreneurs and builders who need structure and accountability
- Students shaping their future path
- Anyone serious about personal growth and becoming their best self
MyFutureSelf combines AI coaching, planning and habit building into one place. If you are ready to move from inspiration to consistent action, this is built to support you every day.

bluejetty:00174048:ios.name: Military Academy 3D
bluejetty:00174048:ios.summary: Military Academy 3D is an immersive and gripping narrative-based game that combines elements of strategy, action, and invention. Set in the rigorous and challenging environment of a military academy, the game follows the remarkable journey
bluejetty:00174048:ios.description:
Military Academy 3D is an immersive and gripping narrative-based game that combines elements of strategy, action, and invention. Set in the rigorous and challenging environment of a military academy, the game follows the remarkable journey of a soldier as they ascend through the ranks, ultimately striving to become "The General" – the highest rank in the army.
Players assume the role of a humble recruit, starting at the lowest rank within the military hierarchy. The game introduces them to the intense and demanding life of a soldier, testing their strategic thinking, tactical decision-making, and leadership skills. The storyline unfolds through a series of captivating scenarios, each presenting the player with numerous choices that directly impact their character's progression and the overall narrative.
As the protagonist navigates through a richly detailed world, they must tackle an array of challenges, both on and off the battlefield. These challenges encompass various military operations, ranging from covert missions behind enemy lines to large-scale battles against formidable adversaries. Players must carefully consider their options, as their decisions carry weighty consequences that can influence their reputation, relationships with comrades, and the overall outcome of the game.
With stunning graphics, immersive sound design, and a compelling narrative, "Military Academy 3D" presents players with an unparalleled gaming experience. Whether it's forming alliances, training troops, engaging in diplomatic negotiations, or leading troops into the heat of battle, every decision made by the player shapes their character's destiny and impacts the world around them.
Embark on an epic journey of dedication, perseverance, and ambition as you guide your character from a low rank soldier to the esteemed rank of "The General." Will you prove yourself worthy of command and leave an indelible mark on military history? The fate of the nation rests in your hands in "Military Academy 3D"

bluejetty:00026893:ios.description:
WHY MUSIC MATTERS: Music isn’t just background noise — it’s a performance enhancer.
The right playlist can motivate your members, boost your energy, and transform any workout from routine to powerful. It sets the tone, drives intensity, and helps you push through when it counts.
FITRADIO delivers nonstop, DJ-curated mixes designed to make you move — whether you're training solo, leading a fitness class, or creating an energetic vibe for your gym.
Trusted by fitness professionals, coaches, and top studios across the country, FITRADIO helps everyone — from beginners to pros — stay focused, fired up, and coming back for more.
HOW OUR DJS MAKE THE MUSIC
FITRADIO mixes aren’t random playlists — they’re professionally crafted by real DJs using the music you already know and love.
• Popular music, remixed with purpose — top hits, underground gems, and timeless favorites
• No skips, no lulls — just seamless, high-energy flow
• Real DJs who understand momentum, energy, and workout pacing
• Mixes built with purpose — from warm-up to cooldown
WHY GYMS & TRAINERS CHOOSE FITRADIO
We don’t just make workout music — we build it with the best in fitness.
• Built with industry leaders like Orangetheory, Burn Boot Camp, F45, and more
• Music for every class format: HIIT, crosstraining, Spin, boxing, yoga, Pilates, barre, and beyond
• Stations for every gym zone: warm-up, fitness class, gym floor, locker room
• Browse by class type, genre, BPM, or mood
• Hit play and go — every mix is ready to energize the room
• Multi-genre blends to keep every member engaged
• Consistent, high-quality member experience across all locations
• FITRADIO PRO can be used for group fitness — unlike most music apps. Just make sure you're using the PRO tier.
• We handle the music — you lead the class
WHY INDIVIDUALS CHOOSE FITRADIO
Music is your most powerful workout tool — and FITRADIO is built to maximize it.
• The right beat wakes you up, excites you, and drives your performance
• Stations for every workout, mood, and genre — from HIIT to yoga
• Audio-guided workouts with expert coaching and music
• Progressive workout programs for every fitness level
• Tempo-matched mixes for runners to keep rhythm and pace
• Used by elite trainers and studios across the country
• Give it one workout and you'll never go back to the same old playlist
READY TO TRANSFORM YOUR WORKOUT? DOWNLOAD FITRADIO AND PRESS PLAY.
AVAILABLE ON APPLE WATCH
Take your music with you and leave your phone behind.
• Run free with FITRADIO on Apple Watch
• Listen to your favorite mixes on the go
• FITRADIO integrates with HealthKit and helps close your activity rings
SUBSCRIPTION INFORMATION
• Title of Service: Fit Radio Premium
• Length of Subscription: 1 Month
• Subscription Options: Monthly, Quarterly, or Yearly
• Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase
• Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period
• Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period
• Subscriptions may be managed by the user, and auto-renewal can be turned off in Account Settings after purchase
• No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during the active period
• Any unused portion of a free trial, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription

Listen to all your favorite mixes on the Apple Watch App.

Hello pretty lady!
Welcome to Oh So Modest, your ultimate destination for stylish and chic modest fashion. We know finding modest clothing that aligns with your style can be tough, so we’ve handpicked a collection that’s both fashion-forward and affordable. Our selection includes a wide variety of tops, skirts, and dresses, available in sizes ranging from S to 3XL to celebrate every body type. Whether you’re shopping for your everyday wardrobe or that special occasion, we’ve got you covered with beautiful, modern designs that don’t compromise on modesty.
What makes Us?
We take pride in our signature pleated fashion and our exclusive one-size-fits-most dresses that our customers love. Every style in the DaniCar Collection is thoughtfully designed by us, ensuring uniqueness and elegance!
Features You’ll Love:
Wish List: Save your favorite pieces for later when you don’t have time to shop.
Exclusive Offers: Be the first to know about exclusive promotions and discounts as an app member.
Fast & Secure Checkout: Shop confidently with our easy-to-use, secure payment options, including Apple Pay.
Order Tracking: Track your delivery every step of the way, from checkout to your doorstep.
Buy Now, Pay Later: Flexible payment options to shop on your own terms.
Weekly New Arrivals: Explore fresh styles added each week to keep your wardrobe updated.
Stay in the Know: Get early notifications on new collections and product drops before anyone else.
Start curating your wardrobe today! Oh So Modest makes it simple to find the perfect look, anytime and anywhere.
Find us online: www.ohsomodest.com
Customer Support: info@ohsomodest.com
Follow us on Socials: @ohsomodest (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook)
Download Oh So Modest today for the best in affordable, chic, and modest fashion.

bluejetty:00161367:ios.summary:
Tired of missing out on crypto price movements? Download the Bitcoin & Crypto Price Widget to follow the prices of your favorite coins from your home screen, lock screen (iOS 16+ required) or Apple Watch!
The Bitcoin & Crypto Price Widget
bluejetty:00161367:ios.description:
Tired of missing out on crypto price movements? Download the Bitcoin & Crypto Price Widget to follow the prices of your favorite coins from your home screen, lock screen (iOS 16+ required) or Apple Watch!
The Bitcoin & Crypto Price Widget enables you to keep up with over 400 of the world’s most popular coins, including Ethereum (ETH), Ripple (XRP) and Dogecoin (DOGE), 24 hours a day, seven days a week.
Its powerful, dynamic interface displays market data in a clear, easy-to-read way. Want to see even more? Simply widen your widget to get a complete overview of what’s happening in the markets.
What's more, you can now track the price of your chosen crypto and coins online on your locked iPhone screen (iOS 16+ required).
You can customize your widget to suit your needs and track crypto prices on your Apple Watch. Select your local currency, choose your favorite coins, and set a background and font that’s as simple or fancy as you like.
Never miss big market moves again. Download the Bitcoin & Crypto Price Widget today.
How to use the widget on your iOS device:
1) Download the app
2) Open the app, select a widget, and customize it to your preferences
3) Go back to your home screen and tap and hold an empty area until all your apps shake
4) Tap the ‘+’ button in the upper right corner
5) Scroll down to find your Bitcoin & Crypto Price widget, select a size, and tap ‘Add widget’
6) You’re all set. You’ll now see the prices of your favorite coins every time you open your phone!

bluejetty:00159192:ios.description:
Buy & Sell Authentic Luxury Brand Online
The Luxury Closet is a leading resale platform established in 2012 in Dubai. With a firm focus on sustainability, authenticity, and unparalleled customer service, we offer an opportunity to consciously engage in luxury goods while making a positive impact on the environment. As a trusted platform for buyers and sellers, The Luxury Closet is the ultimate destination for fashion lovers. We also offer a unique opportunity for shoppers to purchase from the stunning wardrobes of famed personalities through our exclusive Celebrity Closets series.
ACCESS LUXURY ANYWHERE, ANYTIME WITH OUR APP
1. Get real-time alerts about offers & deals via push notifications
2. Effortless browsing with our user-friendly app interface
3. Discover new items added every day from 300+ designer labels
4. Selling is quicker with the app; click, upload, and sit back while we list your item
5. Curate your wishlist with our easy-to-use filters
OUR CATALOGUE:
The Luxury Closet offers a diverse collection of over 300 high-end brands, from historic to contemporary labels. Our inventory includes a vast selection of handbags, shoes, clothing, accessories, and other luxury items.
1. Heritage brands like Cartier, Tiffany & Co., Louis Vuitton, Hermès, Chanel, Burberry, Loro Piana, and Goyard.
2. Iconic names like Yves Saint Laurent, Gucci, Dolce & Gabbana, Valentino, Dior, Givenchy, Versace, and Prada.
3. Find on-trend designers such as The Row, The Attico, Jacquemus, Amina Mudaddi, Vetements, and Ganni.
Explore the most coveted fashion styles and categories:
- Hermès Birkin, Lady Dior, Fendi bags, Louis Vuitton Neverfull, Chanel handbags,
- Rolex Datejust, Cartier Tank, Jaeger-LeCoultre watches, and Audemars Piguet Royal Oak
- Chanel CC slingbacks, Prada logo loafers, Gucci Princetown, Hermès Oran, and Manolo Blahnik Hangisi
- Cartier bracelets, Return to Tiffany, Bvlgari B.Zero1, Alhambra from Van Cleef & Arpels, and Messika jewelry
SHOP WITH US:
From new & pre-loved designer handbags and footwear to fine jewelry and homeware, you will find everything in one place at never-seen-before prices. The app gives you a chance to score authentic vintage luxury items, update your wardrobe often, and find great deals on your favorite items. Here are some more reasons why you should shop with us:
1. AUTHENTICITY GUARANTEED! Our authenticators examine every item to make sure you get the real deal.
2. Our seamless checkout process with COD, Credit Card, and PayPal and fast, reliable shipping ensure that your luxury purchase reaches you in no time.
3. Find vintage pieces, coveted but discontinued styles, and limited editions that are unavailable in retail stores.
4. Get access to designer pieces owned by notable celebrities and influencers.
SELL AND EARN WITH US:
Looking to clear out your closet and create space for new items? Or is it time for spring cleaning? No matter the reason, we are here to help because selling with us is fast, easy, and hassle-free — a process trusted by thousands of sellers worldwide.
We accept a variety of luxury items, including clothing, fine jewelry, homeware, shoes, handbags, watches, and accessories. Whether your items are in pristine or well-used condition, we authenticate and list each of your items for our global buyer audience. The Luxury Closet values your experience, and that's why we offer several benefits to enhance your selling journey:
1. Get access to our special VIP Concierge service and become a VIP seller when you sell 5+ or high-value items
2. Enjoy free scheduled pick-ups of your items
3. Our experts handle the authentication, professional photo shoot, and management of the sale status of your items
4. Earn high commissions and up to 90% payouts
5. Easy & safe payment options
By giving new life to pre-loved luxury, we're taking a step together toward promoting a more circular fashion culture. Join us! Install THE LUXURY CLOSET app today!

bluejetty:00070820:ios.summary:
Make a list once and use it again. Organize packing, shopping and daily to-dos with nested items, your own templates and quick check resets. Core features are free; ad removal is a one-time purchase.
■ Organize items into lists and sublist
bluejetty:00070820:ios.description:
Make a list once and use it again. Organize packing, shopping and daily to-dos with nested items, your own templates and quick check resets. Core features are free; ad removal is a one-time purchase.
■ Organize items into lists and sublists
Group items by category: Trip → Clothes → Shirts and socks. Parent and child items keep longer lists organized, and you can reorder items to suit your plans.
■ Reuse your lists
Save a frequently used list as a template for your next shopping trip or vacation. Copy items or entire lists instead of entering everything again.
■ See what is left to do
Checking a parent item also checks its children. Switch between To-Do and All to see the remaining items. Use Uncheck All to reset your list for next time.
■ Everyday conveniences
Add items continuously, search your lists, and move or copy items. Use Dark Mode and a badge showing the number of unchecked items. Export lists to Notes, email or other apps to share them.
■ Remove ads with a one-time purchase
Core features are free. Premium removes ads with a one-time purchase, not a subscription. After changing devices, use Restore Purchases with the Apple Account used for your purchase.
Make everyday preparation a little easier.

bluejetty:00146733:ios.description:
Drag countries around to see their true size. You may be surprised!
Is Greenland really as big as South America?
Because the Earth is a sphere, it's impossible to show it perfectly on a flat map. This means all maps are distorted.
With this simple app, you can compare countries and see their actual sizes.
Just search or tap and hold on the country you'd like to explore. You can then move it around the map and watch it change size as it moves closer to or farther from the equator.
You'll also learn interesting facts about each place.
This is a great tool for teachers, kids, and anyone interested in geography.

bluejetty:00164689:ios.name: Swing Tune-Up Golf AI Analyzer
bluejetty:00164689:ios.summary:
Swing Tune-Up: Golf Swing AI & Analysis 
Objective Data for Technical Improvement.
Swing Tune-Up is a measurement-based analysis system designed for golfers who prioritize mechanical accuracy over subjective feel. Using computer vision and
bluejetty:00164689:ios.description:
Swing Tune-Up: Golf Swing AI & Analysis 
Objective Data for Technical Improvement.
Swing Tune-Up is a measurement-based analysis system designed for golfers who prioritize mechanical accuracy over subjective feel. Using computer vision and automated motion capture, the app provides the data necessary to identify technical discrepancies and track long-term progress.
AI SWING AUDIT & DIAGNOSTICS
The core engine analyzes swing biometrics against a proprietary dataset of elite professional mechanics to identify specific technical flaws.
- Pro-Baseline Benchmarking: Compare skeletal metrics—including spine angle, hip rotation, and swing plane—against PGA/LPGA standards.
- Root Cause Identification: Isolate the mechanical breakdown behind common ball-flight issues. Identify the specific joint or postural movement triggering the miss.
- Biometric Overlays: Review movement with skeletal tracking and precise angle metrics. Utilize head and spine stability bounds, wrist and club path tracing, and automated impact zooms to visualize technical faults during every phase of the motion.
AUTOMATED MOTION CAPTURE
The app uses automated shot detection to manage recording and clipping, allowing for an uninterrupted practice session.
- Trigger-Based Recording: AI identifies the start of the swing to capture video at up to 240fps without manual input.
- Instant Playback: Immediate high-definition slow-motion replay allows for correction between shots.
- Automatic Clipping: The system trims every video to the relevant motion, optimizing device storage and library management.
REMOTE MONITOR INTERFACE
Synchronize two devices to create a dedicated hitting-bay workstation. Use an iPhone as the primary sensor and an iPad as the session interface.
- Integrated Session Interface: Manage your practice and review high-definition replays directly on the iPad, while the iPhone serves as the high-speed camera and capture control.
- Postural Alignment: Utilize the larger screen for precise framing and posture checks before initiating the swing.
- Data Handover: Raw video and AI metrics sync to the iPad instantly upon completion of the follow-through, storing the session data directly on the iPad for immediate review.
PERFORMANCE INSIGHTS & TRENDS
The system aggregates data across multiple sessions to provide a statistical view of your technical evolution.
- Metric Variance: Track fluctuations in key biometrics like hip sway and spine angle over days, weeks, or months.
- Trend Analysis: Identify patterns in your mechanics to ensure practice time is translating into measurable improvement.
Turn your practice into a data-driven process. Start your technical audit today.
Terms of Use:
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

【京东读书】百万好书聚集地，畅享品质阅读，致力于打造纸、电、声一站式全阅读生态平台。

那些沉甸甸的书，我们都压缩成巴掌大呈现给你;那些被时间封存了的文字，我们都吹散上面的灰尘呈献给你;
那些被人们称赞的绝妙灵魂，我们都一一排好队分享给你。
在这里你可以暂时忘却生活的鸡毛，用碎片的时间领略不一样的人生。
总之，有一个世界想给你看~

【读书，不只有精神食粮】
在这里，除了能享受到知识上的福利，我们还有新人礼包，每天签到打卡也有超值礼包相送哦!

【读书，不只有一种人生】
我们有60万册电子书供你阅读，也有60万种人生供你体验。

【读书，不再是无人相伴】
当你走在路上，当你不方便阅读的时候，别担心我们有有声。
10万小时的有声内容，给你10万小时的暖心陪伴。

【读书，不再言知己好难】
读书是否有时候觉得曲高和寡，孤掌难鸣?想要寻到知己，不如从分享开始吧。赠一得一，把你喜欢的书籍送给你的朋友，把你的品味分享出去，我相信总有一个人会懂你。

【近日好书】
影视原著:《欢乐颂》《足利女童连续失踪事件》《生吞》《长安十二时辰》《全职高手》《雪鹰领主》《斗破苍穹》《冰与火之歌》
文学小说:《在岁月中远行》《白夜行》《白鹿原》《活着》
经济管理:《小米创业思考》《贫穷的本质》《原则》《富爸爸穷爸爸》
生活休闲:《断舍离》《人生效率手册:如何卓有成效的过好每一天》《有些事现在不做，一辈子也不会做了》
历史考古:《文明的故事》《半小时漫画中国史+世界史》《万历十五年》《历史的温度》

bluejetty:00150441:ios.description: Don't miss your garbage or recycling day ever again. Residential curbside collection customers in Washington County, Oregon can get garbage and recycling schedules and reminders within this app. Sign up for email, text or phone reminders and service interruption alerts. Plus, get fast and helpful information about what to recycle and where including curbside recycling and garbage, drop-off recycling centers, and other disposal facilities. This app is for collection customers in the communities of Banks, Cornelius, Durham, Forest Grove, Hillsboro, King City, North Plains, Sherwood, Tigard, Tualatin and unincorporated Washington County, Oregon. Service providers served include Aloha Garbage Company, Cornelius Disposal Service, Garbarino Disposal & Recycling Service, Hillsboro Garbage Disposal, Pride Disposal Company, Republic Services, Swatco Sanitary Service, Valley West Refuse Disposal, Walker Garbage and Recycling Service, Waste Management of Oregon and West Slope Garbage Service.

Learn how to bake tons of desserts from so many delicious recipes, with a professional cake maker and cooking master girl chef! Welcome to Toca Princess Carnival Baking Games for girls!
Get ready to bake the tastiest dessert ever, from unicorn birthday cake to sweet panda doughnuts and delicious papa pizza! Sprinkle on some fun little decorations, light up the candles, and add playful panda or unicorn toys to make your cake even more charming. Indulge your sweet tooth and spread joy with every bite of your beautifully crafted cake and papa pizza. Download Toca Princess Carnival Baking Games now and let your creativity shine through in every sweet creation.

- A super fun food bakery game with TONS of TRENDY CAKES!
- Keep updated with new foods EVERY WEEK!
- Tons of realistic cooking tools to play: little bowls, spatulas, oven, food blender, piping bags, plates, cream mixer, food processor, induction cooker, knife, cutting board, straws, cake molds and so much more
- Tons of food bakery materials and decorations to try
How to play:
- Use interactive controls to play the game
- Try different bakery tools to make your cakes and papa pizza
- Mix various ingredients to cooking the unique flavor and color of your foods
- Decorate your foods with beautiful little sprinkles, candies, fruits, straws, and glitters
- Eat cakes to trigger the shining unicorn rainbow magic

Looking for powerful editing apps to write your story, files and make corrections whenever needed? Install Text Editor - Document Editor Pro on your iOS device and edit your texts anytime, anywhere easily.
We have brought you a fantastic and easy text editor app that will allow you to write and record your story, draft writings, search words or letters and replace multiple words at once. You don’t need several file editors to get different jobs done; this texting editor will provide you with everything. Whether you are looking for a free document editor or a font editing app, our words editor or text document editing app will delight you big time.
What can you do with Text Editor- Document Editor app?
This powerful editing app allows you to edit word files anywhere, anytime. While using this file editor to rewrite your texts, you can find a new word and replace your text with it. Our app works as a text changer, so you can change any word instantly right in the app. You can replace multiple words and search for new words in this word editor app. You can also customize editor themes such as a dark mode for the night or light mode for the day. Also, back up your files and documents on the cloud with one click.
So, if you are searching for a word editor to edit google documents or a text edit app for customizing your notebook word writings, this editing app is always here to help.
Take a look at the key features of the Text Editor- Document Editor Pro app:
• Whether you are looking for editing apps to make corrections to your word docs or to write a story on your iOS device, this text edit app works effectively and efficiently. The simple and easy user interface of this app editor allows you to edit texts quickly and flawlessly. bluejetty:00032206:ios.description:
Elevate Your Sports Streaming with sidelineHD!
Stream your games like a pro by broadcasting directly to your team’s Facebook and YouTube pages, making it easy for friends and family (even grandparents!!) to watch without needing extra apps. SidelineHD’s easy-to-use scoring system automatically generates player highlights throughout the game, so you never miss a moment. You can also add sponsor logos to help raise funds and give your stream a polished, professional look.
With sidelineHD, flexibility is key. Whether you use our all-in-one app or integrate with Mevo, GoPro, or other RTMP-compatible devices, you have full control over your setup. Parents can manage their child’s player profile by pinning, downloading, and sharing game clips, or linking recruiting platforms to showcase their athlete’s talent.
Key Features:
- Seamless Live Streaming: Free to stream and free to watch directly on Facebook and YouTube—no extra apps required, making it easy for family and friends to watch.
- Crisp Video Quality: Enjoy high-quality video with HEVC low bandwidth options for smooth streams, even with limited internet.
- Easy-to-Use Scoreboard Controller: With sidelineSCORE, update the score on Facebook and YouTube while generating real-time highlights. Anyone on the team can keep score via a sharable link. For baseball and softball, sidelineHD integrates with iScore for complete stat tracking and streaming.
- In-Game Highlight Texts: Get real-time player highlights and game start alerts sent to you and up to 5 additional phone numbers.*
- Scoreboards and Highlight Clips For: Baseball, Softball, Volleyball, Basketball, Soccer, Hockey, Lacrosse, and Water Polo.
- Player Profile Management: Pin, download, and share game clips, or link recruiting platforms to showcase your athlete*
- SportsRecruits Integration: Seamlessly send game highlights to SportsRecruits to showcase your player’s talent to college coaches.
- Sponsor Integration: Add sponsor logos to your streams to raise funds while maintaining a professional look.
- Flexible Camera Support: Stream using sidelineHD’s app or connect with Mevo, GoPro, and other RTMP-compatible devices for a custom setup.
- Share with Ease: Share live streams and highlights via social media or direct links.
* feature available with Pro Access for baseball and softball

Drag the cards to create a sequence among the piles in descending order (K-A) and alternating colors.
If you find an A, tap to place it in the foundation above the game board.

- Keep putting the cards into the piles or foundations until all the cards are moved into ace foundations.
- If there is no card can be put, you can submit your score directly and get an early completion reward.
- The faster you complete the game, the higher the score you will get. Battle with your opponents!
HELP
- If you have any questions, please feel free to contact us: SolitaireClub007@outlook.com

Note that cash tournaments are not available in the following states: AZ, AR, IN, IA, LA, ME, MD, SC, MT & SD.

bluejetty:00019517:ios.description:
Meditation Moments: Calm, Focus & Deep Sleep
Want to sleep better, reduce stress, and boost your energy? Discover Meditation Moments! Our app helps you bring more calm, focus, and balance into your life. With over 200 meditations, unique music tracks, breathing exercises (breathwork), and soothing sounds, you can make time for mindfulness and self-care every day. Find your moment of peace exactly when you need it.
Why Meditation Moments?
Meditation Moments is your complete guide to inner peace and well-being. Meditation and mindfulness experts guide you step by step, offering various meditations, exercises, and programs to support your journey:
- Imagine this: your alarm goes off, and instead of rushing, you start your day with a morning meditation. You feel calm, and after a busy day, you effortlessly find rest with our special sleep meditations. Whether you need deep relaxation or a quick break, there’s always time for you.
- Tools for every goal. Explore over 200 guided meditations to enrich your life. Use breathing exercises (breathwork) for a quick moment of calm, steer your thoughts with powerful affirmations and visualizations, and feel more gratitude and positivity. Boost your confidence, take a walk with walking meditations, improve focus, or work on your mindset and letting go.
- Music for every mood. Let music guide you through your day with our extensive collection. Start your day with energetic music to wake up, find focus with study beats or focus music, and release stress with relaxing piano and sound healing. At the end of the day, sleep music and soothing white noise guide you into a deep sleep. Discover unique binaural and bilateral beats, serene handpan sounds, and pure nature sounds for an extra moment of relaxation.
- Meditations for Kids. Support your kids in their emotional development and help them find peace with our special kids meditations and lullabies.
What’s Included in the App?
Meditation Moments is there for every moment of your day, anytime and anywhere:
- Offline Listening: enjoy your favorite content even without internet.
- Apple Health Integration: track your well-being and mindful minutes.
- Curated Collections: quickly find meditations and music that suit your goal.
- Daily Reminders: stay consistent and make self-care a habit.
- Journal: do a daily mood check-in and write down how you feel.
What Will You Gain?
With Meditation Moments, you’ll experience instant benefits:
- Sleep better, deeper, and wake up feeling refreshed.
- Let go of stress, anxiety, and restlessness; find inner peace and live mindfully.
- Improve concentration and focus.
- Increase self-love and overall well-being.
- Support your kids in their emotional development and help them relax.
Premium
Curious? Try Meditation Moments Premium 7 days for free! Discover all meditations, music, exercises, and features. After the trial period, get full access to all content for €56.99 per year.
Questions or feedback?
We value your feedback. Feel free to email us at service@meditationmoments.com.
Learn more about our privacy policy here: meditationmoments.com/privacy-policy
Read our terms and conditions here: meditationmoments.com/terms

bluejetty:00041180:ios.description:
The planner for days that don't go to plan.
On iPhone, iPad, the web and your computer. With Pro it all syncs, and Yoodoo works with Claude and ChatGPT: plan your day in a chat and it lands on your timeline.
Most planners work until about 10am. Then a call runs long, you lose an hour to your phone, or you just don't start, and the whole day gets written off. Yoodoo expects that. It fits the rest of your day around what actually happened, so you keep going.
Built ADHD first, for every brain that's wired a little differently. Diagnosed, on a waiting list, just pretty sure, or simply juggling too much. If your days keep breaking, it's for you.
GET IT OUT OF YOUR HEAD
- Say or type everything that's on. Ask Yoodoo turns it into tasks, files them into lists and plans the day, times and all.
- Lists for everything else, with one star for what matters.
A DAY YOU CAN ACTUALLY DO
- A real timeline where an hour looks like an hour, with your calendar in it.
- Plan today: tick what's happening, pick the one that matters, and Yoodoo builds your day around what can't move. Breaks included.
- See how long you've got before the next thing, not just the time it starts. Handy if time blindness is your thing.
HELP TO START
- Just start: five minutes and a timer. The hardest bit of a big task, done.
- Focus shows one step at a time, so a mountain becomes the next small thing.
- Subtasks: Yoodoo cuts a big task into tiny ones, and the first is so small you just start.
- Block the apps that pull you away, on a schedule or right now.
FIX MY DAY, WHEN IT SLIPS
- Something ran over? Yoodoo asks one simple question and moves the rest.
- Behind on a few things? See what still fits, and let the rest roll to later. Your day's priority stays protected.
- Things you didn't get to roll on. They never pile up and never turn red.
- Nothing changes until you say Looks right.
FEEL GOOD AT THE END OF THE DAY
- Wrap up in three taps: what's done, what moves, and tomorrow's ready.
- Habits and routines that run on a timer, with no streak shaming.

bluejetty:00073180:ios.name: Shattered Pixel Dungeon
bluejetty:00073180:ios.summary: Shattered Pixel Dungeon is a traditional roguelike dungeon crawler RPG that's simple to get into but hard to master! Every game is a unique challenge, with six different heroes, randomized levels and enemies, and hundreds of items to collec
bluejetty:00073180:ios.description:
Shattered Pixel Dungeon is a traditional roguelike dungeon crawler RPG that's simple to get into but hard to master! Every game is a unique challenge, with six different heroes, randomized levels and enemies, and hundreds of items to collect and use. ShatteredPD is also updated with new content roughly every three months, so there's always something new.
◀ Choose Your Hero ▶
Each of ShatteredPD's six playable heroes has their own unique mechanics and gameplay style. Cut down foes as the durable Warrior or deadly Duelist, fry your enemies as the arcane Mage or divine Cleric, or use terrain to your advantage as the stealthy Rogue or the markswoman Huntress!
As you progress through the dungeon you'll earn points to spend on talents, choose a subclass, and gain powerful lategame abilities. You can turn the Duelist into a dual-wielding Champion, the Cleric into a righteous Paladin, the Huntress into a precise Sniper, or explore loads of other possibilities!
◀ Explore the Dungeon ▶
ShatteredPD's dungeon is procedurally generated with random layouts, room types, items, traps, and enemies. In each game you'll find equipment and collect or craft consumable items to power you up or help you out in a pinch. There is a huge variety to what you might see from run to run and region to region.
As you progress through the dungeon you'll find equipment that can be enchanted, upgraded, and augmented as you outfit your hero. Set foes ablaze with an enchanted weapon, wade through enemies with upgraded armor, or gain powerful damage, defensive, or utility benefits from one of the many magical wands, rings, artifacts, or trinkets.
◀ Succeed or Die Trying ▶
The Dungeon is filled with enemies, traps, hazards, and bosses intent on ending your run! Battle hostile wildlife in the sewers and caves, mad thieves and guards in the prison, occult servants in the fallen dwarven city, and maybe something even worse further down...
All these hazards can make the game quite tough, but don't be discouraged! You probably won't win on your first try, but there are many tricks and strategies to discover and learn on the path to getting your first win. Afterward, there are optional challenges and achivements if you want to put your skills to the test!
◀ Over A Decade in the Making ▶
Shattered Pixel Dungeon is an open source game based on the source code of Pixel Dungeon by Watabou (first released in late 2012). It started in 2014 as a project to rebalance Pixel Dungeon but has steadily grown into its own game over the last 10 years!
Features Include:
• 6 Heroes, each with 2 subclasses, 3 endgame abilities, and over 25 talents.
• Over 300 items including equipment, consumables, and items crafted via alchemy.
• 5 dungeon regions, 26 floors, over 100 room types, and trillions of possible floor layouts.
• Over 60 regular enemy types, 30 traps, and 10 bosses to test your skills.
• An in-game catalog to fill in, with just over 500 entries.
• 9 stackable challenges and over 100 achievements for completionists.
• Interface modes for large and small screens, and support for multiple input types.
• Updates roughly every 3 months with new content, fixes, and improvements.
• Support for many languages thanks to the game's dedicated communities.

bluejetty:00116855:ios.description:
** AWARDED BEST NEW APPS CATEGORY — APP STORE EDITORS ** 
hi, i'm Cal.
i built timespent to be the simplest, most flexible way to track your goals, habits, skills, and activities.
for those who used my old activity timer app, you'll find everything you loved and a whole lot more. timespent takes tracking to a new level, letting you measure activities by weight, distance, or volume—or just keep a simple tally too.
here are just a few ways you can use timespent:
– focus & activity timer
log focused work sessions with the built-in focus timer, perfect for pomodoro-style sprints or deep work. track your hours spent studying, meditating, or mastering a skill on your way to 10,000 hours.
– habit & routine tracker
build powerful routines and track your progress. minimize screentime, create a reading log, maintain a gratitude journal, or track any habit you want to build or break. see your consistency grow day by day.
– workout & fitness log
create a complete workout history. log strength training with sets, reps, and weight. track your cardio sessions by distance and time, whether you're running, cycling, or swimming. count your yoga poses or push-ups. every bit of progress, logged.
– daily checklist & task tracker
stay on top of your recurring tasks. did you water the plants? take your medications or supplements? complete your daily chores? use quick tallies to check things off and free up your mind.
– skill & practice journal
use the focus timer to record practice sessions that level-up your skills. they say it takes 10,000 hours to become an expert—now you can track your journey there. watch your dedication pay off, whether you're practicing an instrument, coding a new project, or learning a new language.
plus, timespent is more than just a list of numbers. it helps you visualize your journey with powerful, but simple, tools:
– home screen widgets: keep your progress front and center so you never lose sight of your goals.
– heatmap calendars: get a beautiful at-a-glance view of your consistency.
– personal goals: set daily or weekly targets to stay motivated and celebrate every milestone you reach.
– clean charts & stats: understand your trends without overwhelming or cluttered graphs.
– reminders: send yourself notifications and words of encouragement.
– arcs: track and organize your routines with a gentler approach to streaks & goals.
– apple watch & fitness integration: import workouts automatically. 
start tracking what matters most. a better you is just one tap away.
— Cal.

bluejetty:00164685:ios.description:
Create, find, and join pick-up sports games anytime, anywhere. Create player groups with your friends to organize pick-up sports games or join a public game and go play!
PLAYER GROUPS
Swish enables you to create & join public or private player groups with your friends to organize all your pick-up sporting games. Have a set group of friends you like to play basketball, pickleball, soccer, or any other sport with? Private groups allow you to create and post games to the app that only your group will see and be invited to. If you like playing with whomever and connecting with new people, public groups are visible to all users. Anyone can post and join public sporting games for a public group.
FIND / CREATE GAMES
All swish users can create a pick-up game or join a game and go play! The Create a game process prompts Swish users to choose the location, time, sport, and number of open spots. You can create a private game for a group of friends, or a public game for anyone to join. 
ORGANIZATION
Swish organizes all of your upcoming games and game invites for you – both games you’ve joined and games you’ve created. No more annoying confusing group chats when organizing sport events. Swish lets you see when & where you’re playing, and who has joined. Get the App and Share with your friends!
Terms of Use: https://swishsportsapp.com/terms-of-use/

bluejetty:00023389:ios.name: Dominoes BIG
bluejetty:00023389:ios.summary: Welcome to the ultimate tabletop challenge where timeless strategy meets polished mobile gameplay. Rediscover the authentic thrill of the traditional double-six set, beautifully designed for fans of classic board, puzzle, and abstract logic
bluejetty:00023389:ios.description:
Welcome to the ultimate tabletop challenge where timeless strategy meets polished mobile gameplay. Rediscover the authentic thrill of the traditional double-six set, beautifully designed for fans of classic board, puzzle, and abstract logic games. Whether you are relaxing after a busy day or seeking an engaging mental workout, every session delivers deeply satisfying tactical decisions.
Put your skills to the test against cunning AI opponents in both classic Draw and Block modes. Carefully plan your placement, anticipate each countermove, and clear your hand before your rivals can react. If the boneyard runs dry and the layout becomes completely locked, victory belongs to the player who smartly manages their hand to hold the lowest pip count.
With crisp, readable visuals, seamless offline support, and customizable match setups for up to four players, this authentic tabletop adaptation offers endless brain-training fun. Master your tactical thinking, read the table, and enjoy a beloved global pastime wherever life takes you!
FEATURES:
• Authentic double-six tile rules with classic Draw and Block modes.
• Compete against 1 to 3 smart computer opponents at your own pace.
• Fully playable offline with no internet connection required.
• Clean, high-contrast visuals designed for effortless readability.
• Smooth, intuitive drag-and-drop or tap-to-place board controls.
• Track your progress and sharpen strategic thinking over time.
HOW TO PLAY:
• 1. Draw your starting hand of tiles from the boneyard before the match begins.
• 2. The player with the highest double tile places the opening piece on the board.
• 3. Take turns matching an open pip number on either end of the playing layout.
• 4. Draw extra tiles if you cannot play, or pass your turn when the boneyard is dry.
• 5. Be the first to empty your hand, or hold the lowest score if the board is blocked.

bluejetty:00141559:ios.description:
Welcome to the ultimate collection of 2 player games and no wifi mini games! Whether you are looking for something fun, or challenging, our wide collection of two player games has something for everyone who want games without internet connection. Perfect for friends or family, these offline 2 player games let you enjoy hours of fun together, without needing any WiFi! If you are into competitive play, we have got awesome 1v1 or pvp games where you and your friend can face off to see who is the best.
You can enjoy intense 2 player tapping games that will test your speed and reflexes. Or, if you like variety, we have tons of offline mini games to keep you entertained for hours. These mini games are perfect for quick, fun sessions that you can jump into whenever you want. If you are a fan of one on one competition, the 1v1 games are the perfect choice for challenging your friend to a duel!
For those who enjoy a more cooperative experience, check out the minigames for two. These offline games let you and your partner team up to solve puzzles, complete challenges. But if you are feeling competitive, try the exciting two players race where you and your friend can race on same screen to see who finishes first!
The fun never ends with our endless games that you can play over and over again. These endless games are perfect for a long gaming session that will keep you entertained all day. Even better, these are no wifi 2 player games, meaning you can enjoy them without an internet connection with your friends. They are the best offline games for playing wherever you go. Get ready to compete in duel players battles, where you will face off against your friend in intense challenges!
Jousting games are one of the most exciting 2 player mini games in our collection. You and your friend will hop on horses and try to knock each other off using your trusty lances. The fun gets even more intense as you both race to land the perfect strike, and only one can emerge as the winner. You will experience real jousting battle in this jousting games!
For fans of western action, our cowboy shoot mini game will take you straight to the wild west. You and your partner will have to draw your guns and shoot fast to outlast each other in epic cowboy games. Test your aiming skills in our cowboy games shootouts and see who can be the fastest gun in the wild west!
Ready for even more action so we have two players race games for you? Dive into the two players race, where you and your partner can go head to head in exciting races on same screen. Whether you are racing against the clock or each other, this game is all about speed and precision, with lots of thrilling twists along the way.
Looking for 2 player games to play with pair players? Our selection of 2 player games and mini games will keep you and your friend entertained for hours. Whether you love racing, jousting, fighting, solving puzzles, or teaming up for a challenge, theres a game for everyone in this amazing collection. Grab a friend, choose your favorite game, and get ready for endless fun with 2 player games and mini games!

bluejetty:00121425:ios.description:
Connect Through Meaningful Words and Accountable Identity.
Heymandi is a text-first social community for people who value intentional connections over superficial browsing. Every interaction begins with shared interests and a persistent account identity.
Why Heymandi?
Topic-Based Discovery
Skip randomness. Discover people through tags and shared topics. Every connection is intentional and user-initiated.
Words Come First
Express personality and perspective through text. Build trust through conversation before choosing to share more.
Progressive Trust Building
Our FairSwap mechanism enables step-by-step trust through thoughtful interaction before photo sharing is available.
Accountable Digital Identity
Each user is assigned a persistent HeyID linked to their account. Interactions are not anonymous—every connection is supported by traceable account identity to promote safety and accountability.
Nearby Perspectives
Explore voices and ideas around you, grounded in shared interests and intent.
Intentional. Accountable. Real.
Move beyond rigid profiles and appearance-driven browsing. On Heymandi, words define presence, and every connection is backed by a real account.
Post ideas. Send invitations. Build connections.
Looking for more features?
Upgrade to Hey Silver or Gold to unlock additional options.
Hey Gold
5 Super Invites daily to increase your chances of being accepted.
Unlimited active connections allow you to engage with more people at the same time.
Instantly accept missed invitations and enjoy an ad-free experience for uninterrupted interaction.
Enhance your profile appearance and unlock Hey Gold Special, which lets you send two invitations at once and gain additional exposure.
Hey Silver
3 Super Invites daily to increase your chances of being accepted.
Up to 5 active connections allow you to engage with multiple people simultaneously.
Instantly accept missed invitations and enjoy an ad-free experience.
Enhance your profile appearance to stand out.
Ad-Free
Remove ads for a clean and uninterrupted experience while engaging on Heymandi.
Subscription Information
If you choose to purchase Hey Gold, Hey Silver, or Ad-Free, payment will be charged to your iTunes account, and your subscription will automatically renew within 24 hours before the end of the current period unless auto-renew is turned off in your account settings after purchase.
Hey Gold is available from USD $27.99/month with one-month, six-month, and twelve-month plans.
Hey Silver is available from USD $14.99/month with one-month, six-month, and twelve-month plans.
Ad-Free is available from USD $3.09/month with one-month, six-month, and twelve-month plans.
Prices may vary by region and are subject to change without notice.
No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during the active subscription period.
If you choose not to purchase a subscription, you may continue using Heymandi for free.
Privacy Policy
https://www.heymandi.com/terms/privacy
Terms of Service
https://www.heymandi.com/terms

bluejetty:00037906:ios.description:
Homer: Your All-in-One Home Management App
Homer is the award-winning home management app that makes you a better, smarter homeowner. Easily manage, maintain and organize everything related to your home. This includes home maintenance tasks, home inventory, home timeline, home expenses, and important home documents - all safely stored in one place. This includes receipts, floor plans and owner’s manuals for your home.
KEY FEATURES:
HOME MANAGEMENT MADE EASY: Organize your home with tailored task lists, automated maintenance reminders, and a complete home inventory. Manage every aspect of your house effortlessly.
COMPLETE HOME INVENTORY TRACKING: Track and manage your home inventory with ease. Home inventory management has never been easier! Save receipts, warranties, and manuals securely, ensuring you’re always prepared. Keep track of your appliances, home installations, home electronics, tools and garden tools - all in one place. 
HOME INSURANCE COVERAGE: With all your home inventory tracked and saved in Homer, you can rest easy knowing that your things are properly documented and will be covered in the event of a claim. 
FINDS THE OWNER’S MANUAL AUTOMATICALLY: Homer automatically finds and organizes user manuals, instruction booklets and Quick Start Guides for all your home appliances and devices, saving you time and hassle. With AI, you can chat with the owner’s manual and get help with appliance maintenance and troubleshooting. 
HOME MAINTENANCE AND TO-DO LISTS: Keep your home in top condition with our powerful AI powered maintenance and to-do lists. Homer ensures you never miss an important task or event. Create recurring home maintenance tasks, or get help with cleaning schedules, seasonal home improvement tasks or smart homeowner tips for moving house. 
ORGANIZE IMPORTANT HOME DOCUMENTS: Store and access essential user manuals, floor plans, and receipts anytime, anywhere. Share documents easily with your family or property managers. Scan pdf documents like contracts, agreements and more.
AI-POWERED HOME CO-PILOT: Get instant help with our AI-powered Homer Helper bot. Whether you need home maintenance advice or have a question about your home inventory, the Homer Helper is a powerful home co-pilot here to assist you.
HOME EXPENSES: scan and upload receipts for your home purchases, utilities, or services. Keep track of your home expenses, warranties, and proof-of-purchase. Homer has a built in receipt scanner and expense tracker that will help you manage your home expense budget. 
FLOOR PLAN SCANNER: Create accurate floor plans with your phone, scan and save receipts, and track all home expenses in one app. Homer has a built in floor plan creator that helps you make a new and accurate floor plan of your home in minutes!
AR (AUGMENTED REALITY) NOTES: Use AR markers to place digital notes within your home’s 3D space, keeping everything well-organized.
PERFECT FOR EVERY HOME
Whether you own a house, apartment, condo or manage multiple properties as a landlord, Homer is your go-to app for home management, home inventory management, property management and home maintenance. 
Homer is widely awarded and featured by Apple:
App of the Day (2023)
Apps We Love (2022, 2023, 2024) 
Essential Utility Apps (2024)
Get Started Today!
Join thousands of users who trust Homer for their home management. Download now and start organizing your home inventory, managing maintenance tasks, and more with the best app for homeowners.
We always offer 100% human chat support in the app. Email is on info@homer.co if you have any other question
www.homer.co/en/terms

【すべての記事が読み放題】　速報ニュースから、深掘り取材した記事まで。全世界の出来事を幅広く知ることができます。
【ニュースの要点】　きょう1日の注目のニュースを3本ピックアップ。重要なニュースがすぐにわかります。
【ニュースQ】最近話題のニュースからクイズを出題。1日1問チャレンジできニュースの理解に役立ちます。
【トピックス】解説付きや時系列でまとめてニュースを読めるトピックス。いろいろな視点でニュースを整理できるから、物事の理解に役立ちます。
【みつかるタブ】その日によく読まれている記事のランキングや、取材の裏側を聞ける「ポッドキャスト」など、さまざまな手段でよりニュース体験を楽しむことができます。朝日新聞の紙面でもおなじみの定番連載「天声人語」「患者を生きる」や、デジタル独自の「今さら聞けない世界」「きょうも傍聴席にいます。」など、人気連載も充実。
【連載フォロー】気になる特集の最新回を追いかけたり、心に残った連載をまとめ読みしたり。便利なリストをつくれます。
【コメントプラス】さまざまな専門家が寄せたコメントを読めば、1つのニュースに対して多様な視点から深く社会の課題を理解するのに役立ちます。
【朝刊・夕刊】朝日新聞の紙面と同じ情報が、毎日手元に届きます。
【記者フォロー】気になる記者の新着記事やつぶやきなどをタイムラインでチェックでき、ニュースを身近に感じられます。
【メニュータブ】保存した記事や、マイキーワードで自動収集した記事など、必要な情報にすぐアクセス。会員限定のニュースレターや、毎日挑戦できる数独なども網羅しています。
【ウィジェット】端末のホーム画面にウィジェットを追加すれば、最新ニュースをより手軽にチェックできるようになります。

listings.description:
◇経済だけじゃない、身近な話題や災害情報、深掘り記事まで
◇国内外のニュースをいつでもどこでも　知りたい情報がここにある
◇スマートに幅広く情報収集できるからわかりやすい

徹底した取材に基づいて、社会問題から身近な話題まで確かな情報をお届けする朝日新聞の公式アプリです。
プッシュ通知で大事な情報も見逃さない。アプリだからこそ実現できる体験で、あなたのニュースライフをさらに豊かに。
一部の機能・コンテンツは無料で利用できます。


■朝日新聞アプリの特徴

【すべての記事が読み放題】　速報ニュースから、深掘り取材した記事まで。全世界の出来事を幅広く知ることができます。

【ニュースの要点】　きょう1日の注目のニュースを3本ピックアップ。重要なニュースがすぐにわかります。

【ニュースQ】最近話題のニュースからクイズを出題。1日1問チャレンジできニュースの理解に役立ちます。

【トピックス】解説付きや時系列でまとめてニュースを読めるトピックス。いろいろな視点でニュースを整理できるから、物事の理解に役立ちます。

【みつかるタブ】その日によく読まれている記事のランキングや、取材の裏側を聞ける「ポッドキャスト」など、さまざまな手段でよりニュース体験を楽しむことができます。朝日新聞の紙面でもおなじみの定番連載「天声人語」「患者を生きる」や、デジタル独自の「今さら聞けない世界」「きょうも傍聴席にいます。」など、人気連載も充実。

【連載フォロー】気になる特集の最新回を追いかけたり、心に残った連載をまとめ読みしたり。便利なリストをつくれます。

【コメントプラス】さまざまな専門家が寄せたコメントを読めば、1つのニュースに対して多様な視点から深く社会の課題を理解するのに役立ちます。

【朝刊・夕刊】朝日新聞の紙面と同じ情報が、毎日手元に届きます。

【記者フォロー】気になる記者の新着記事やつぶやきなどをタイムラインでチェックでき、ニュースを身近に感じられます。

【メニュータブ】保存した記事や、マイキーワードで自動収集した記事など、必要な情報にすぐアクセス。会員限定のニュースレターや、毎日挑戦できる数独なども網羅しています。

bluejetty:00145330:ios.summary: CitizCheck is designed to help you track the progress of your Portuguese citizenship application efficiently and smartly. You can monitor up to 5 citizenship applications simultaneously, making it easy to manage the complex process and stay
bluejetty:00145330:ios.description:
CitizCheck is designed to help you track the progress of your Portuguese citizenship application efficiently and smartly. You can monitor up to 5 citizenship applications simultaneously, making it easy to manage the complex process and stay updated on the status of your applications.
Key Features
Regular Updates: Receive updates approximately every 3 weeks on any changes or progress in your application status, ensuring you are always informed.
Multi-Application Management: Track up to 5 citizenship applications at the same time, simplifying the tracking process.
Comparative Chart: View a chart that displays your progress relative to others, helping you understand your position in the queue and estimate the time for approval.
News and Updates: The app's news screen provides updates on progress and changes in other citizenship applications.
Installing the app allows you to manage all the necessary information regarding your citizenship applications in an organized and convenient manner while maintaining your data's privacy and security. It's time to take control of the process and make your path to citizenship easier, with all the information you need at your fingertips. No need to log in to the app; just enter the tracking code of your citizenship application.
The information displayed in the application is not officially endorsed by any government entity. The source of the information is https://meu.registo.justica.gov.pt/Pedidos/Consultar-estado-do-processo-de-nacionalidade

bluejetty:00172140:ios.description:
Clearful is your journaling companion for personal growth and mental health. Discover a smarter, less anxious, and happier you by exploring your experiences, thoughts, emotions, and ideas in a secure and private journal and diary.
FEATURED 
App of the Day
5 Resolutions You'll Actually Keep
New Year, New Beginnings
Start Your Mindful Journey
Your Personal Growth Toolkit
Lower Your Stress Levels
+20 more
EXPRESS YOURSELF
Capture your life with text, photos*, and audio (soon) in your journal and diary. Write what's on your mind in a peaceful yet powerful journaling canvas. Highlight life's moments in your journal entries with images*. Transform spoken words into text with audio journaling and transcription (soon).
ADD STYLE & STRUCTURE
Organize and stylize your journal and diary entries with our simple, powerful, and beautiful text editor with 13+ formatting options, including headings, bullets, numbers, checklists, quotes, dividers, links, and text styles.
REDISCOVER MOMENTS
With Rediscover, look back at your journal and diary entries from various time periods. Relive memories and milestones, see how far you've come, and uncover patterns and blind spots.
PRIVACY & SECURITY
Your journal and diary are encrypted, secure, and private. Privacy protections like Encryption, Face ID & Touch ID, Entry Lock*, No Ads, No Data Sharing, Device Manager, and Sign In With Apple give you more control over the data in your journal and diary.
ACCESS ON ALL DEVICES
Take your journal and diary wherever you go with iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Web apps. Everything stays in perfect sync across all your devices.
GUIDED JOURNALS LIBRARY
Discover journal prompts and journal templates for all of life's topics: work, career, creativity, emotions, goals, planning, habits, gratitude, happiness, self-care, health, wellness, memories, personal growth, self-development, self-reflection, relationships, self-love, sleep, stress, anxiety, and travel.

Small steps every day add up to big achievements over time. Stay accountable with daily or weekly streaks, and remember to journal with custom reminders.

Visualize your journaling progress and gain insights with charts and analytics that reinforce your journaling habit.
WORLD-CLASS CUSTOMER SUPPORT
Get in touch with us for our quick, personal, and friendly customer support.
