bluejetty:00131718:ios.summary:
LEGO® DUPLO® Disney combines the magic of Disney with the learning benefits of LEGO DUPLO. Kids aged 2-5 will enjoy endless play opportunities with Mickey Mouse and more Disney favorites!
• Fun and educational games with beloved Disney fri
bluejetty:00131718:ios.description:
LEGO® DUPLO® Disney combines the magic of Disney with the learning benefits of LEGO DUPLO. Kids aged 2-5 will enjoy endless play opportunities with Mickey Mouse and more Disney favorites!
• Fun and educational games with beloved Disney friends 
• Open-ended pretend play that’s perfect for young kids.
• Lots of fun and varied play.
• Build and create with colorful 3D LEGO DUPLO bricks. 
• Plenty of delightful surprises along the way. 
• Relive treasured Disney memories together! 
When young children have fun and play, it creates the perfect conditions to learn and grow. We have designed this app to help young kids develop a balance of the IQ skills (cognitive and creative) and EQ skills (social and emotional) they need for the best start in life. 
CHARACTERS 
Mickey Mouse, Minnie Mouse, Belle, Daisy Duck, Donald Duck, Goofy, Pluto, Huey, Dewey, Louie, Figaro, and Cuckoo-Loca. 
Enjoy a magical world of fun, building, and learning with Mickey Mouse & Friends! 
AWARDS AND ACCOLADES
• Kidscreen Awards 2024 - Nominated for Best Game App  
FEATURES 
• Safe and age-appropriate 
• Designed responsibly to let your child enjoy screen time while developing healthy digital habits at a young age 
• FTC Approved COPPA Safe Harbor Certification by Privo
• Play pre-downloaded content offline without wifi or internet 
• Regular updates with new content 
• Apple Family Sharing for easy subscription sharing with other family members 
• No third-party advertising 
• No in-app purchases for subscribers
SUPPORT 
For any questions or assistance, please reach out to us at support@storytoys.com
ABOUT STORYTOYS 
Our mission is to bring the world's most popular characters, worlds, and stories to life for children. We make apps for kids that engage them in well-rounded activities designed to help them learn, play, and grow. Parents can enjoy peace of mind knowing their kids are learning and having fun at the same time.
PRIVACY & TERMS 
StoryToys takes children's privacy seriously and ensures that its apps comply with privacy laws, including the Child Online Privacy Protection Act (COPPA). If you would like to learn more about the information we collect and how we use it, please visit our privacy policy at https://storytoys.com/privacy. 
Read our terms of use here: https://storytoys.com/terms.
SUBSCRIPTION & IN-APP PURCHASE 
This app contains sample content that is free to play. However, LOTS MORE fun and entertaining games and activities are available. You can buy individual units of content via in-app purchases. Alternatively, if you subscribe to the app you can play with EVERYTHING. We regularly add new stuff, so subscribed users will enjoy ever-expanding play opportunities. 
• Subscriptions are billed monthly or annually according to the rate of the selected subscription plan. 
• You can change your mind at any point. Cancelling can be done through your iTunes settings. 
• Your subscription will auto-renew at the cost of the chosen package unless you cancel it 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period. Subscription fees are charged to your iTunes account. 
• After purchase, you can manage your subscription and turn off auto-renewal by going to your Account Settings. 
• When you purchase a subscription, you forfeit any unused portion of a free trial period. 
• You can use your subscription on any device registered with the same Apple ID that you subscribed from. 
LEGO®, DUPLO®, the LEGO logo, and the DUPLO logo are trademarks and/or copyrights of the LEGO® Group. © 2026 The LEGO Group. All Rights Reserved. 
© 2026 Disney

bluejetty:00087817:ios.description:
MyThings (أشيائي) is Jordan's multi-category delivery and convenience app for food, groceries, pharmacies, snacks, coffee, desserts, electronics, gift cards, gaming cards, and more. Real store prices. Local Jordanian support 24/7. NO hidden fees. Delivered in 30-45 minutes.
Jordanian roots. Global standards.
WHY PEOPLE IN JORDAN CHOOSE MYTHINGS
- REAL PRICE MATCH - not fake discounts.
The price in MyThings is the same as the restaurant or store price. No inflated menu pricing pretending to give discounts. You save real money at checkout.
- LOCAL JORDANIAN CALL CENTER
Real humans in Jordan handle in-app chat and phone support. They help quickly with refunds, missing items, address updates, and delivery issues. Direct human support, not chatbot loops.
- NO HIDDEN FEES
The price you see is what you pay. Transparent delivery fees with reduced or free delivery on most orders. No surprise service or platform fees at checkout.
EVERYTHING YOU NEED IN ONE APP
• Food delivery - shawarma, mansaf, burgers, pizza, sushi, sandwiches, breakfast, and desserts
• Grocery and supermarket delivery - daily essentials and weekly shopping
• Pharmacy delivery - health, wellness, skincare, and beauty products
• Coffee and snacks - cafes, drinks, sweets, and convenience items
• Electronics and home products - fast delivery across Jordan
• Gift cards and gaming cards - PlayStation, Steam, iTunes, and digital products delivered instantly
• Flowers, lifestyle stores, and local shops - all in one app
TRUST AND CONVENIENCE
• Secure online payments
• Verified restaurants and stores
• Real-time GPS driver tracking
• In-app call and chat with drivers
• One-tap reorder
• Delivery and takeaway modes
• Designed for customers in Jordan
PAYMENT METHODS
• Cash on Delivery
• Visa and Mastercard
• Apple Pay
Available across Amman, Zarqa, Irbid, Aqaba, Madaba, Salt, and the Ramtha area.
Founded in 2021.
Jordanian roots. Global standards.

bluejetty:00153704:ios.description:
Find deals before anyone else.
DealScout sends instant alerts when new items matching your search are posted on Facebook Marketplace and Craigslist. Skip the endless scrolling and get alerted when newly listed items are posted. Just create your 'Scout' and let us do the work.
DealScout is perfect for saving time and money whether you're flipping, collecting, or just bargain hunting.
Real-time listing alerts
Custom search terms
Built for deal hunters, flippers, and collectors
Faster, easier, and more efficient than manual searching
DealScout offers a free plan for a single search term that updates hourly — perfect for casual shoppers and people looking for good deals or specific items. No payment required.
Want to guarantee you see the best deals first, get faster results, and more Scouts to search for more items for you? Upgrade to a premium plan and be the first to every deal.
One-week free trial available at DealScout.app.
Currently providing Facebook Marketplace alerts. More platforms coming very soon.
Getting started:
Create your Scout with a search term like "mountain bike."
Keep terms broad — listings must match all Scout terms exactly.
Be vague to see more, specific to see less.
(Example: "Mountain Bike" won’t match listings titled "Bicycle for Sale.")
Newly made Scouts may take up to two hours to complete setup.
After that, DealScout will alert you every time a new listing pops up:
Free plan: within 1 hour
Premium plans: within 5 minutes
Set it and forget about it.
DealScout helps you find better deals, faster. Download today and start scouting smarter — for free.
DealScout has 3 subscription  
- Pro Scout ( Search Terms 10 )
- Deal Master ( Search Terms 5 )
- Fast Finder ( Search Terms 3 )
- Payment will be charged to your selected payment method at confirmation of purchase.
- Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is disabled at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing period.
- Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period, with the renewal cost clearly identified.
- Subscriptions can be managed, and auto-renewal can be turned off, in your account settings via the DealScout app or website after purchase.
- Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited upon purchasing a subscription

bluejetty:00180297:ios.description:
Unlock seamless communication with ClickToChat, the all-in-one app for enhanced messaging, productivity, and creativity. Whether you're managing conversations without cluttering your phonebook, automating responses, or creating AI-generated stickers, ClickToChat simplifies your chat experience with powerful tools designed for efficiency and fun.
App Features
Quick Messages - Instantly send frequently used responses with a single tap, saving you time and effort.
Message Scheduling - Never miss important messages, schedule birthday wishes, follow-ups, and reminders in advance.
AI Chat & Text Generator - Generate contextually relevant, engaging messages with advanced AI.
AI Message Translator - Communicate in multiple languages effortlessly with real-time AI-powered translations.
AI Sticker Generator - Create unique, personalized stickers with AI, making your chats more expressive.
Photo Date & Time Stamper - Add customizable timestamps to your images for easy organization and authenticity.
Split Video for Social Media - Seamlessly split long videos into smaller clips for posting on WhatsApp Status, Instagram Stories, and more.
Stitch Photos & Create PDF - Merge multiple images into a long scrolling image or convert them into a PDF for easy sharing.
Business QR Code Generator - Create a personalized business QR code with your contact details including name, phone number, email, fax, address, notes, and photo. Add the QR code as a widget on your iPhone home screen for quick access. Simply show the QR code to instantly share your contact information without hassle.
Fun Stickers & Social Media Tools - Access a vast collection of stickers, chat stories, creative bios, and unique symbols.
Additional Perks
Fast Mode - Start a chat quickly by copying a number, without saving it to contacts.
Customizable Experience - Adjust app settings to easily manage dual messenger accounts.
Auto Features - Automatically apply your country code and paste numbers directly into the app.
Explore the power of a cleaner, more organized, and enhanced messaging experience with ClickToChat today.

bluejetty:00016982:ios.name: Potion Punch 2
bluejetty:00016982:ios.summary: Cook, bake, serve, and… save your customers from evil monsters and villains?! Potion Punch 2 is the ultimate restaurant time-management game for those looking for a challenge! Embark on a quest in a fantastic world filled with magic and mon
bluejetty:00016982:ios.description:
Cook, bake, serve, and… save your customers from evil monsters and villains?! Potion Punch 2 is the ultimate restaurant time-management game for those looking for a challenge! Embark on a quest in a fantastic world filled with magic and monsters. Set up shop in unique locations to serve enchanted swords, magical scrolls, and powerful potions to help heroes on their adventures!
Take the cooking fever to an all-time high with baby dragons roasting ingredients and magic wisps freezing your favorite treats or grilling your delicious steaks! Cook in ways that you've never seen before in a fast-paced time-management game. Become the star chef through hundreds of levels teeming with amazing heroes and dastardly villains. Unfurl your scrolls, polish your frying pans, and open the restaurant doors, because it's time for cooking madness in Potion Punch 2!
RUN YOUR OWN MAGIC RESTAURANT
● Potion Café: Mix colors and brew powerful potions, and tame baby dragons to cook tasty fish.
● Enchantment Shop: Blend squid inks, stamp scrolls, and train birds to carve runes.
● Shroom Kitchen: Grow mushrooms in the night and catch fireflies to make bright and colorful lanterns.
● Sword Shop: Forge enchanted blades and craft brilliant gemstones through smelting.
● Tropical Treats: Make frozen ice cream popsicles, dip treats in fondue, and bake delectable cupcakes.
● And more with new chapters added regularly! Each chapter brings fun new stories and fun new restaurants, cafes, kitchens, and more!
UPGRADE YOUR CREW AND CAFÉ
● Design and decorate your shop to make delicious meals quickly, serve orders faster, and maximize profits and tips.
● Level up your heroes and magical creatures like cooking dragons, gargoyles, and magical wisps to maximize their awesome abilities and powers.
MEET AND COLLECT LOYAL CUSTOMERS
● Meet every type of fantasy character, from brave knights to powerful gods to snarly goblins and many more!
● Throw fun parties and magical feasts to attract new customers from every corner of the kingdom.
FIGHT MONSTERS AND VILLAINS WITH GODS AND HEROES
● Summon legendary heroes and recruit them to overcome the challenges of running the most popular kitchen in this delicious magical world.
● Manage the madness in the kitchen by harnessing the power of heroes who can tame dragons, wield ice magic, or even control time.
● Defend your restaurants from enemies who attempt to disrupt your fast-paced kitchen.
● Save the kingdom one café at a time!
HUMOROUS FANTASY STORY
● Follow the tale of Lyra and Noam, two alchemist entrepreneurs who have a taste for fun new adventures.
● Experience a story filled with twists and turns as you unlock your magical restaurants and fill your cooking diary with amazing stories.
UNIQUE TWIST ON COOKING GAMES
● Fast-paced combo system that rewards you for maintaining your rhythm.
● Hundreds of levels with unique goals like serving a number of customers, earning a total amount of tips, making every order perfect, avoiding trash bins, and many more!
Be the ultimate shopkeeper in this simulation of various cooking games with a magical twist. Explore a fantasy world filled with delicious food to cook, incredible magic to cast, and colorful characters to meet! Download Potion Punch 2 today!
Terms of Service: https://www.monstronauts.com/games/potion-punch-2/terms-of-service/
Privacy Policy: https://www.monstronauts.com/games/potion-punch-2/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00042279:ios.description:
Web Guard is your all-in-one privacy solution, designed to keep your personal information safe and secure while browsing the web. With advanced ad-blocking technology, it effectively eliminates intrusive advertisements, ensuring a smoother and more private online experience. Web Guard also features a hidden folder for secure storage, allowing you to safely store sensitive media files away from prying eyes. Additionally, the built-in secure browser ensures your browsing activities remain private, safeguarding your data from trackers and cyber threats.

Any unused portion of a free trial will be forfeited once a subscription is purchased.
Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account upon confirmation of purchase.
The renewal fee will be charged within 24 hours before the end of the current period, based on the selected plan.
By using Web Guard, you consent to our Terms of Service and Privacy Policy:

bluejetty:00068975:ios.description:

==权威的西语学习参考== 
『权威词典』，西汉-汉西词典、近义反义派生联想词词典、西西词典、西英词典，历经数年修订，精准详实；
『纯正发音』，内置真人发音，包含全球各地西语发音，帮助了解正确的单词发音；
『动词变位』，提供18种时态的动词变位反查功能，助力掌握复杂变位规则； 
『原声例句』，精选新闻、教材例句，配以原声发音，更好了解词汇实际用法； 
『常用例句库』，内置两百万句西汉对照例句，方便查询参考； 
『西语百科』，涵盖大量时事新词、热词和俚语，拓宽文化视野； 
『考试真题』，收录历年西语考试真题，轻松了解考试高频词汇； 
『西语参考』，语音规则、西语语法一应俱全，全方位掌握西语知识； 
『扩充词库』，可安装扩充商贸法律词库，积累相关就业词汇。 
==强大的AI学习功能== 
『AI解释』，提供多样化助记、词根词缀详解、单词替换表达等，解锁查词新体验；
『AI翻译』，提供多种官方翻译风格，支持自定义翻译引擎，满足不同的翻译需求；
『AI同传』，支持英法德西等多语种同传，即说即译，沟通零障碍；
『AI写作』，主题写作、纠错批改、润色扩写、概括总结，一键搞定； 
『AI对话』，数十种生活和考试对话场景，还有不同国籍和口音的聊天伙伴可选； 
『AI短文』，根据生词自动生成短文，可选择风格和难度，在真实语境中巩固记忆；
『AI问答』，实时解答单词疑问，无需等待；告别传统低效问答，自主高效学习；
『造句练习』，AI辅助实战造句，即时获取反馈与详细解析，有效提升运用能力。
==方便实用的学习工具==
『单词复习』，收录四六级、雅思、考研等必备单词课本，艾宾浩斯记忆法高效记单词；
『拍照查词』，支持摄像头取词、拍照翻译，即拍即查，文献阅读好帮手； 
『跨软件取词』，集成系统Spotlight查词，使用其他软件时长按即可查词；
『文件阅读』，软件中即可阅读文件，支持单词长按查询，即点即译；
『高亮标记』，重点词添加标记，批注内容支持录音和图片，云端同步，随时查阅；
『笔记同步』，生词本、笔记、历史记录云端同步，珍贵学习记录永不丢失；
『文件传输』，WiFi文件传输功能，无需数据线即可传词典或文章；
『分屏功能』，支持iPad分屏功能，一边浏览网页一边查词；
『蓝牙键盘』，完美支持蓝牙键盘，支持全键盘操作（用户可长按Command键查看可用快捷键）；
『语料库』，对学习过程中接触的单词、词组语料进行管理；可以将喜欢的语料加入生词本，也可以通过卡片学习播放。

bluejetty:00060745:ios.name: Shri Guru Granth Sahib Ji Bani
bluejetty:00060745:ios.summary: Guru Granth Sahib (Punjabi (Gurmukhi): (Gurū Gra°th Sāhib Jī), Punjabi pronunciation: [ɡʊɾu ɡɾənt sɑhɪb], /ɡʊəru ɡrʌnt səhɪb/) is the central religious scripture of Sikhism, regarded by Sikhs as the final, sovereign and eternal living Guru
bluejetty:00060745:ios.description:
Guru Granth Sahib (Punjabi (Gurmukhi): (Gurū Gra°th Sāhib Jī), Punjabi pronunciation: [ɡʊɾu ɡɾənt sɑhɪb], /ɡʊəru ɡrʌnt səhɪb/) is the central religious scripture of Sikhism, regarded by Sikhs as the final, sovereign and eternal living Guru following the lineage of the ten human Gurus of the religion, of whom six contributed the bulk. The Adi Granth, the first rendition, was compiled by the fifth Sikh Guru, Guru Arjan (1563–1606). Guru Gobind Singh, the tenth Sikh Guru, did not add any of his own hymns; however, he added all 115 hymns of Guru Tegh Bahadur, the ninth Sikh Guru, to the Adi Granth and affirmed the text as his successor. This second rendition became known as Guru Granth Sahib. After Guru Gobind Singh died, Baba Deep Singh and Bhai Mani Singh prepared many copies of the work for distribution.
The text consists of 1430 angs (pages) and 6,000 śabads (line compositions), which are poetically rendered and set to a rhythmic ancient north Indian classical form of music. The bulk of the scripture is divided into thirty-one rāgas, with each Granth rāga subdivided according to length and author. The hymns in the scripture are arranged primarily by the rāgas in which they are read. The Guru Granth Sahib is written in the Gurmukhī script, in various languages, including Lahnda (Western Punjabi), Braj Bhasha, Khariboli, Sanskrit, Sindhi, and Persian. Copies in these languages often have the generic title of Sant Bhasha.
Guru Granth Sahib was composed predominantly by six Sikh Gurus: Guru Nanak, Guru Angad, Guru Amar Das, Guru Ram Das, Guru Arjan, and Guru Teg Bahadur. It also contains the traditions and teachings of fourteen Hindu Bhakti movement sants (saints), such as Ramananda, Kabir and Namdev among others, and one Muslim Sufi saint: Sheikh Farid.
The vision in the Guru Granth Sahib is of a society based on divine justice without oppression of any kind. While the Granth acknowledges and respects the scriptures of Hinduism and Islam, it does not imply a moral reconciliation with either of these religions. It is installed in a Sikh gurdwara (temple); all Sikhs bow or prostrate before it on entering such a temple. The Granth is revered as eternal gurbānī and the spiritual authority in Sikhism.
Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Guru_Granth_Sahib

bluejetty:00156578:ios.description:
The Lakeland Electric App is a comprehensive tool for managing your electric services on the go. Designed to meet the fast paced demands of modern living, this app streamlines your interactions with your Lakeland Electric account, offering convenience, flexibility, and a host of user-friendly features right at your fingertips.
Key Features:
My Account
• Hassle Free Sign-In: Log in once and then select options to use fingerprint or facial recognition to easily access your account.
• Pay Your Bill Anytime, Anywhere: With just a few taps, pay your bill directly from the app. You can view your current bill, check your payment history, and even compare your energy expenses over time.
• Auto Pay: Enroll in automatic payments to never worry about missing a due date again. You have complete control over managing and adjusting your payment settings according to your preferences.
• Paperless Billing: Join our effort to reduce paper waste by enrolling in paperless billing. It’s a quick, secure, and environment-friendly way to manage your statements.
Outage Information
• Real-Time Outage Reporting and Updates: Experience peace of mind knowing you can report power outages with a simple click and receive timely updates on restoration efforts and status changes.
Stay Informed and In Control
• Bill & Payment Reminders: Set up personalized bill reminders to receive notifications before your bill is due, ensuring timely payments and avoiding late fees.
Get access to all the important features related to your residential or commercial electric service with the Lakeland Electric App and work towards achieving your energy goals.
Download the app today and access smarter energy management for your account.

bluejetty:00143523:ios.description:
Tu cuenta global en dólares — sin fronteras
Meru es la app financiera moderna que te conecta con el mundo. Abre tu cuenta en dólares y euros en minutos con tu documento nacional y empieza a ahorrar, enviar, recibir, invertir y pagar globalmente, desde Bolivia o donde estés.
Tu cuenta internacional en EE. UU. y Europa
Obtén tu cuenta bancaria estadounidense y europea (IBAN) personalizada, con número de cuenta y de ruta exclusivos. Recibe transferencias ACH, Wire y SEPA a tu nombre y olvídate de los límites geográficos.
Recibe pagos fácilmente desde plataformas como PayPal, Upwork, Payoneer, YouTube, Amazon, Stripe, Deel y muchas más. Ideal para freelancers, creadores de contenido y profesionales globales.
Tarjeta Visa Internacional
Paga en todo el mundo con tu tarjeta Visa física o virtual emitida en Estados Unidos y respaldada en dólares. Úsala para compras online, en tiendas o suscripciones como Netflix, Spotify o Airbnb. Controla todo desde la app: congela o reactiva tu tarjeta, establece límites y recibe notificaciones en tiempo real.
Transferencias sin límites
Envía y recibe dinero de forma instantánea, 24/7, a cuentas en Estados Unidos, Europa o entre usuarios Meru sin comisiones ocultas. Además, retira tu dinero en moneda local con MoneyGram, disponible en más de 200 países y territorios.
Ahorra e invierte en dólares
Protege tu dinero de la inflación con tu cuenta en dólares digitales. Invierte fácilmente en DeFi y criptomonedas como Bitcoin o Ethereum, accediendo a más de 2000 tokens con control total sobre tus activos. Sigue tus rendimientos en tiempo real y retira cuando quieras, sin penalizaciones.
Seguridad garantizada
Tu dinero está 100 % protegido. Meru integra tecnología de verificación de identidad (KYC/AML) reconocida globalmente para ofrecerte una experiencia segura y confiable.
Todo desde una sola app
Con Meru, tienes tu cuenta personal y empresarial en un solo lugar. Depósita con transferencias bancarias, PIX instantáneo, efectivo o incluso criptomonedas. Administra tus finanzas globales de forma fácil, moderna y sin fronteras.
Descarga Meru y únete a la nueva generación que maneja su dinero sin límites. Tu cuenta internacional en dólares y euros está a solo unos minutos de ti.

bluejetty:00185792:ios.description:
Starting today, you can earn real money just by walking!
How to get money ?
1. Walk. Every day our system will select 50 random users within yesterday's top 500 and they will get $1 each.
2. Reach achievements. For each achievement you reach with 5 stars you'll get $1. Some achievements you can reach only once, but Survey achievement is unlimited!
3. Withdraw money with PayPal or Amazon gift cards!
Cash for Steps app is using Health app to receive your latest fitness activity (Steps and Walking + Running Distance) and display it in the app. By using Health app we can receive and sync fitness activity from your Apple Watch.
To get steps and distance from Health app - navigate to Home page, press device icon on the top left corner and choose 'Health app' option.
Earn points by walking and completing simple tasks like sharing the app. 
New leaderboard and new winners every day!
You don't need to keep the app running all the time to track your progress, just open it at least once a day to sync your stats.
You are tired to walk but want more points? This is the right time to open offers tab where you will find out how to increase the score!
Base restrictions: 
• You are not allowed to use / have / register multiple accounts
• You are not allowed to cheat a system or abuse steps
• You must be 17+ years old to use the app.
Any questions, comments or concerns, please feel free to contact us at cashforsteps@gmail.com. We don't support jailbroken devices. We reserve the right to close anyone's account we view as fraudulent or which violates our rules or restrictions.
Disclaimer - The money and gift cards paid out in this app are in no way affiliated with Apple. The process of sending the gift cards is not affiliated with Apple either.

Introducing "Voice Changer - Sound Box," the ultimate mobile application desined to revolutionize the way you interact with your voice. Get ready to explore a world of creative possibilities as you transform and modulate your voice in real-time. With an array of cutting-edge features, this app offers an unmatched experience that's both entertaining and functional. 
Features:
1. Real-Time Voice Transformation:
Step into the realm of endless creativity with instant voice transformations. Modify your voice on the fly and experiment with a variety of effects that will leave you and your friends amazed.
2. Extensive Effect Library:
Unleash your inner artist with a wide range of voice effects, from funny and whimsical to futuristic and mysterious. Transform into characters, creatures, or even alter your gender – the possibilities are limitless.
3. Customizable Presets:
Tailor your voice with precision using customizable presets. Fine-tune parameters such as pitch, speed, modulation, and more, allowing you to achieve the exact voice style you desire.
4. Background Noise Suppression:
Ensure crystal-clear recordings with the app's advanced background noise suppression technology. Your transformed voice will shine through without any unwanted distractions.
5. Shareable Creations:
Create memorable moments with friends and family by sharing your voice transformations. Save your creations as audio files and share them across social media platforms or messaging apps.
6. Realistic Effects:
Immerse yourself in a world of authentic voice transformations. Our app's cutting-edge technology ensures that the effects sound realistic and convincing, enhancing the overall experience.
7. Intuitive User Interface:
Navigate the app effortlessly. The user-friendly interface allows you to access effects, adjust settings, and record your voice transformations with ease.
8. Record and Save:
Capture your voice-changing escapades for future enjoyment. Record your sessions and store them in the app's library for quick access and playback.
Benefits:
1. Entertainment Galore:
Elevate your entertainment quotient by transforming your voice into various characters, accents, and styles. Host hilarious karaoke sessions, prank your friends, or simply enjoy experimenting with different voices.
2. Creative Expression:
Unleash your creativity by crafting unique voice personas. Use your transformed voice for storytelling, content creation, or adding a fun twist to your video projects.
3. Memorable Moments:
Create unforgettable memories with friends and family by sharing your amusing voice transformations. Add a touch of laughter and surprise to your social interactions.
4. Personal Growth:
Enhance your vocal versatility and discover new vocal ranges. With practice, you can improve your voice modulation skills and potentially explore new avenues like voice acting or podcasting.
5. Engaging Presentations:
Captivate your audience during presentations by infusing your content with dynamic voice variations. Keep listeners engaged and entertained as you navigate through your material.
6. Interactive Learning:
Educators and trainers can use the app to create engaging and immersive learning experiences. Differentiated voices can make storytelling and lessons more captivating for students of all ages.
Unleash the power of your voice like never before with "Voice Changer - Sound Box." Experience a world of entertainment, creativity, and personal growth as you transform your voice in real-time. Download the app now and embark on a journey of vocal exploration that will leave you amazed and delighted.

bluejetty:00093319:ios.description:
VanAlert is an app specifically made for VW Vanagon & Bus owners. 
Stolen Vanagons
The main purpose of this app is to help recover stolen Vanagons. We have a REPORT STOLEN VAN feature which in case your van is stolen, you fill out the form with your vehicle's information and a photo. Once we receive it we put out a PUSH NOTIFICATION to all VanAlert users/Vanagon owners. This helps get the community involved in helping locate your Van, they'll be notified with all of the information you provided.
Repair Shop Database
We have a database of reputable repair shops that know how to work on these classic vehicles. Say for instance, if you break down, simply open the VanAlert app and click on the Repair Shops icon. A listing of crowdsourced repair shops that other Vanagon/Bus owners have used and recommend that are in the area will show up based on your current GPS location. All of the contact info is there at your fingertips.
Event Calendar
A nationwide VW Event Calendar is available that'll list every VW Event within your area so there is no stressing out over missing one. These are also crowd sourced by attendees and event organizers.

bluejetty:00151892:ios.description:
Welcome to Shuffleboard Club – the ultimate online multiplayer shuffleboard game!
Get ready for fast-paced PvP matches where skill, precision, and a bit of luck decide who rules the board. Slide your pucks with style, knock out rivals, and claim your spot as the shuffleboard champion! Whether you’re a casual player or a pro at strategy games, Shuffleboard Club delivers fun competition every time.
Real-time multiplayer action!
Challenge your friends or face off against online players from around the globe. Play exciting matches in beautifully designed shuffleboard arenas – from classic wooden boards to futuristic neon halls. Every match is a new test of skill.
Slide, score, and outsmart!
Aim carefully, control your strength, and master the art of pushing your puck to the scoring zone. Use trick shots, bump opponents off the board, and secure victory with your tactical moves.
Customize your playstyle!
Choose your favorite puck designs, upgrade your gear, and make your avatar stand out. Shuffleboard isn’t just about winning – it’s about winning with style.
Climb the leaderboards!
Earn rewards, unlock new boards and skins, and rise through competitive rankings. Prove you’ve got the precision and tactics to dominate in Shuffleboard Club!
Key Features:
- Real-time PvP shuffleboard matches
- Stunning arenas and unique board designs
- Tons of customization for pucks and avatars
- Battle pass and seasonal rewards
- Global leaderboards and ranking system
- Perfect for fans of casual sports, multiplayer games, and competitive challenges
Whether you want a quick casual match or a competitive tournament, Shuffleboard Club is your go-to sports game.
Download now and slide your way to victory – the board is waiting for you!
IGRS rating: 13+

bluejetty:00145629:ios.description:
While growing up, suffering under endless «musts» we lose connection with our inner child. Human design - your guide to the real self. Restoring connection with Inner Child can revive your motivation to unlock your true potential. Find your true motivation in life.
The InnerChild application integrates ancient astrology, present day psychology and human design to help you get to know your inner child and restore your connection to it. To create your ballanced and happy life!
Get ready, your journey starts now!
Human Design combines astrology, the I Ching, Kabbalah and Vedic philosophy, centering around the division of personalities into five energy types alleged to indicate how someone is supposed to exchange energy with the world.
Human design is a new astrology because it offers a more detailed and personalized way of understanding yourself and others.
Your zodiac sign might give you some insight into your personality, but it doesn't offer practical tools for making important decisions. That's where human design comes in. No matter what zodiac sign you have: Aries, Taurus, Gemini, Cancer, Leo, Virgo, Libra, Scorpio, Sagittarius, Capricorn, Aquarius or Pisces, human design offers a more comprehensive understanding of your behavior and personality. It can guide you in making choices that align with your unique design and help you restore your vitality. So don't feel limited by your astrological sign – explore the possibilities of human design and discover a new level of self-awareness and empowerment.
Human design is not only a tool for self-discovery but also for self-empowerment. It teaches you how to live according to your type and strategy, which can help you avoid frustration, bitterness, anger, disappointment, or resentment. It also helps you understand how to communicate and collaborate with others who have different types and strategies. Human design can help you improve your relationships, career, health, motivation and happiness by giving you concrete guidance on how to align with your authentic self. 
Discover the Human Design Motivations and how yours will direct your life's journey. What really motivates and inspires you for acts of heroism?
Unlock a world of self-discovery and growth as you embark on a transformative journey towards healing your past wounds. Our app provides a safe and nurturing space for you to explore and connect with your inner child, allowing you to address deep-rooted emotional issues that may be holding you back in life.
The InnerChild offers an auto renewing, weekly subscription for $9.99 with a free 3-day trial, with unlimited access while you maintain an active subscription.
o Free 3-day trial is one time offer for new users. Please note that if you have previously used a free trial period for our app, a payment in the amount of $9.99 will be charged after activating the offer. This charge will be applied to your account and will give you access to all premium features of the app. If you have any questions or concerns, please contact our customer support team for assistance. Thank you for using our app!
o At the end of the trial period payment will be charged to your Apple account 
o Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
o Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours of the end of the current period, and the cost of renewal will be provided to you.
o A current subscription may not be cancelled during an active subscription period.
o Check our Privacy Policy: https://innerchild.app/privacy & Terms of use: https://innerchild.app/terms

bluejetty:00133678:ios.description:

FIND WELLS FAST

• Well name
• API or UWI number
• DLS and LSD
• NTS
• Latitude and longitude

• Operator
• Well status
• Surface location
• Depth
• Spud or drill date
• Licence or permit number
• API or UWI number
• Additional jurisdiction-specific details
MAP AND NAVIGATE
• Get directions to a wellsite, lease, legal land location, or dropped pin
• Display wells, permits, licences, and available land-grid layers
• Switch between satellite, topographic, street, and other map views
• Explore nearby wells directly from the map

bluejetty:00121568:ios.description:
Live Soccer TV - Your Soccer TV Guide.  Stay on top of the game with the broadcast details of every televised and legally streamed Soccer match at your fingertips!
The Live Soccer TV app is your essential and definitive guide for watching soccer matches on TV, streaming and on-demand. This app provides the official broadcast schedules, live scores, and comprehensive soccer coverage from around the globe. With access to verified tv schedules for more than 4,000 channels and streaming services across 200+ countries, you'll always know where to watch your favorite soccer players, teams, leagues and competitions.
Key Features:
- Live Scores & Match Details: Experience matches live with real-time scores, statistics, lineups, events, and commentary.
- Official TV & Streaming Schedules: Find out where to watch games on TV, streaming, on-demand, or in replays, customized to your location.
- Channel & Broadcaster Information: Get detailed broadcaster listings, media rights, and geo-availability.
- Customizable Match Notifications: Set alerts before games start, from 24 hours down to 5 minutes.
- Calendar Integration: Sync favorite team match schedules and broadcasts details directly with your calendar.
- Search & Favorites: Easily search for matches, teams, leagues, and save your preferences for tailored updates.
- Goal & News Alerts: Get instant notifications for goals, news, and key events from your top teams and leagues.
Comprehensive Soccer Coverage:
- Broadcast Listings & Media Rights: Access official listings and localized media rights details for all soccer leagues and tournaments.
- Top Leagues & Competitions: Follow major domestic leagues, international club competitions, and soccer tournaments from around the world.
- International Tournaments: Follow major international tournaments, continental championships, qualifiers, and national team competitions.
- Women’s Soccer: Follow leading women’s domestic leagues, international club competitions, and national team tournaments from around the world.
- In-Depth Match Insights: Get team and league news, match previews and reports, standings, player stats, and the latest soccer news.
Supportive Broadcast Viewing Experience:
- Spoiler-Free Mode: Watch games on your schedule without score and spoiler (goal) alerts on a per game basis. Set time limits for score notifications.
- Team Content: Explore team stats, squads, and performance history.
- Customizable Alerts: Notifications tailored to your preferences.
- Follow Teams & Leagues: Customize your soccer experience by following your favorites.
Why use the Live Soccer TV app?
- Trusted Source: Since 2004, we have been providing accurate soccer schedules, fixtures, and news.
- Official Broadcasts Only: No illegal streams, just legal, verified listings for tv and streaming.
- Global Reach: Coverage for over 4,000 channels and services worldwide.
Note: Live Soccer TV does not offer any streaming. We provide you the broadast details and links to official broadcasters.
Download Live Soccer TV today to stay connected to your favorite teams, leagues and global soccer.

Only Parkour: Heaven or Hell is a heart-pounding and visually striking game that thrusts players into the gravity-defying world of a human expert facing a life-altering decision. Embark on an epic journey as the protagonist, a skilled acrobat navigating vertigo-inducing landscapes filled with perilous obstacles and breathtaking vistas.
From the very beginning, you must decide between ascending to the celestial heights of Heaven or descending into the fiery depths of Hell. The game's narrative unfolds as players traverse through dynamically crafted levels, seamlessly integrating the choices of the character with the ever-evolving challenges.
As the player maneuvers through the heavenly paradises or hellish terrains, they must showcase their parkour prowess to overcome increasingly complex obstacles. The decision to ascend or descend is not only pivotal to the storyline but also influences the level design, introducing diverse challenges that reflect the chosen path.
Only Parkour: Heaven or Hell features intuitive controls, stunning graphics, and an immersive soundtrack, enhancing the emotional weight of every decision made. Will the character embrace the ethereal purity of Heaven or navigate the treacherous depths of Hell? The fate of you making each daring leap and wall run is a crucial element in this gripping adventure.
YOUR LIFE! YOUR CHOICE!
DOWNLOAD NOW!!

bluejetty:00165232:ios.description:
Binaural Beats and brainwaves are the easy and fast way to bring you the focus, relaxation, healing, and sleep support you need. Introducing YouTuneIn, a human technology tool that elevates meditation to a higher level. With over 2000 tracks of Binaural Beats and brainwave frequencies, our app helps you connect with your higher self and unlock your full potential.
Binaural Beats are at the core of our mission to improve human potential through advanced auditory meditation technology. By combining binaural beats, meditation music, 8D sound technology, and the law of attraction, YouTuneIn creates a more effective and enjoyable meditation experience focused on healing, relaxation, self-care, and mental fitness.
Brainwaves are stimulated through meditation music enhanced with Epsilon, Delta, Theta, Alpha, Beta, Gamma, and Lambda frequencies. These brainwaves help deepen meditation, reduce stress, improve focus brain performance, support ADHD meditation, healing, and better sleep.
Key Features:
Binaural Beats Meditation Music - Choose meditation tracks with Binaural Beats frequencies or listen without frequency. Sessions are available in 5, 10, 20, 30, or 60 minutes for meditation, focus, healing, and sleep.
Sleep and 8D Sounds - Immerse yourself in forests, beaches, water, firesides, animals, and Tibetan Crystal Bowls with powerful 8D Sounds designed for sleep, relaxation, stress relief, and healing.
ADHD Focus Brain Guided Meditations - Guided meditations help calm the mind, improve focus brain performance, reduce stress, and support ADHD meditation practices.
Healing Mantras and Affirmations - Use mantras and affirmations combined with binaural beats to support healing, manifestation, and the law of attraction.
Healing Special Guests - Guest coaches and healers provide valuable meditation, manifestation, and mindfulness knowledge.
Brainwaves Podcasts - Learn about meditation, manifestation, brainwaves, healing, sleep, and binaural beats through insightful podcasts.
Sleep Meditation for Kids - Guided meditation sessions specially designed for children.
Additional Features
Focus Brain Progress Tracking: Track your meditation and sleep journey daily.
Healing Journal: Record your meditation experiences and personal growth.
Binaural Beats Offline Listening: Save favorite tracks and listen offline.
Brainwaves Wisdom Section: Explore articles, videos, and tutorials about meditation and self-knowledge.
Binaural Beats Community: Join the WeTuneIn community.
Sleep Language Options: Available in Portuguese and English.
Healing Continuous Updates: Enjoy new meditation and binaural beats content regularly.
Join us on this transformative journey and experience meditation, binaural beats, healing, better sleep, ADHD support, focus brain training, and the magic of the law of attraction with YouTuneIn.
SUBSCRIPTION PRICING AND TERMS:
YoutuneIn offers an auto-renewing monthly subscription at $15.99/month and an auto-renewing yearly subscription at $87.99/year to provide you with unlimited access to the App while you maintain an active subscription.
Try the entire App without blocking for 7 days FREE!
Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current subscription period. 
Your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and the cost of the renewal will be identified. 
You may manage your subscription and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to your Account Settings after the purchase. If you choose the 7 days 
Free trial, you will be charged after the 7-day period for the selected plan, if you do not wish to continue after the FREE period, the cancellation must take place 24 hours before the 7-day period ends.
Read terms and conditions here: https://www.youtunein.com/Home/Terms
Read the privacy policy here: https://www.youtunein.com/Home/Privacy

bluejetty:00136420:ios.description:
No notifications. No ads. No sign-up.
Just you and your time.
TIME LEFT DESCRIPTION
Sometimes life seems really short, and other times impossibly long.
This app will help you to emphasize that it’s most certainly finite.
Time Left shows you, the days, months, and years you have left and that they are all you have got.
Don’t be afraid, that means the only appropriate word to describe your time left is “precious”.
So I hope this app will enable you to create a life in which you will be happy and creative.
WHAT ABOUT YOUR PRIVACY?
I think Privacy is a fundamental human right.
To that end, I have designed Time Left from the ground up without any external framework.
In this way, your data, like your birthdate, stays entirely private.
HOW CAN YOU HELP ME?
As I don’t collect any data on this app, to improve it I need your help!
You can send me an email to julien@lacroix.dev for any feedback, issues, or bugs on this app or just to say “Hello!”.
I answer every email!
**********
A special thank you to Wait But Why for this amazing article (https://waitbutwhy.com/2014/05/life-weeks.html).
Without their work, this app would not have seen the light of day.
**********
 TIME LEFT PRO
- Unlock widgets & skins.
- Unlimited moments.
- Live Photos in Life Calendar.
- Automatically access all future features and widgets.
- Support an indie developer.
**********
Terms of Use: https://gettimeleft.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://gettimeleft.app/privacy

bluejetty:00120376:ios.name: My City : Orphan House
bluejetty:00120376:ios.summary: Create your own stories and play your own adventures, My City : Orphan house is where you can decide what happens. Your new orphan house is an amazing new location which lets you play the day to day life of kids and guardians at the orphan
bluejetty:00120376:ios.description:
Create your own stories and play your own adventures, My City : Orphan house is where you can decide what happens. Your new orphan house is an amazing new location which lets you play the day to day life of kids and guardians at the orphan house. Running the orphan house is not easy, From morning time to bedtime, the orphan house is always full of fun.
Create your own story 
Perhaps one of the orphans will find a family to live with, Perhaps they will invite friends over to the orphan house. Everything is possible, this is your story game. Dressup, cook and play all day long, there are lots of new items you can take to other my city games and lots of new places to roleplay your imagination game. Remember that you can easily move items and your favorite characters between your My City games. 
Game Features
- 7 locations to explore: Kids bedrooms, Orphan house manager, playroom Class, kitchen and More...!
- 9 NEW characters you can dress up and play imagination games with on your orphan house adventure.
- Make sure to take care of the pet dog. 
- All My City games connect to each other, Easily Move characters and items between games. 
- Daily gifts and furniture to upgrade your home and wardrobe.
- Multi-touch so kids can play together with friends and family on the same screen.
- No Ads, Kids Safe.
Age group 4-12:
Easy enough for 4 years olf to play and super exciting for 12 years to enjoy. 
Play Together
We support multi-touch so kids can play together with friends and family on the same screen!
We love making children games, if you like what we do and want to send us ideas and suggestions for our next games of My City you can do so here:
Facebook - https://www.facebook.com/mytowngames
Twitter - https://twitter.com/mytowngames 
Love our games? Leave us a nice review on the app store, we read them all!
Terms of Use: https://www.my-town.com/EULA
Customer Support contact: support@my-town.com
Get Privacy-related information at: https://www.my-town.com/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00029707:ios.description:
Why Our Members Love Cal Coast
Managing money, saving for life’s big moments, and planning for the future can be challenging. At Cal Coast, we simplify financial management for our members, helping them reach their goals and achieve lasting success. We also believe in giving back to our community, creating a positive impact that extends beyond banking.
Why Our Members Love the New Cal Coast Mobile Banking App
• Modern, intuitive design for a seamless experience
• Personalized banking tailored to your needs
• Enhanced security to protect your finances
Key Features of the New Cal Coast Mobile Banking App
• Secure, Personalized Banking: Easily enroll with your own unique username and password. Business and fiduciary accounts have separate logins for added control.
• Member Centric Design: Our app is designed with a member-first approach, offering personalized experiences that meet your financial needs.
• Quick Balance: Instantly check balances and recent transactions with a single tap.
• Mobile Deposits: Deposit checks on-the-go using your phone’s camera.
• Bill Pay: Pay bills from anywhere, anytime, without the hassle.
• Seamless Transfers: Move money between Cal Coast accounts or to external accounts effortlessly.
• PayItNow: Send and receive person-to-person payments.
• Card Controls: Lock, unlock, view your card details, and manage your debit and credit cards directly within the app.
• Coast into Cash Referral Program: Refer friends and family through our Coast into Cash initiative and earn rewards for sharing the benefits of membership with Cal Coast.
Enrollment Required: All members (new and existing) must enroll through the app before signing in. 
Need assistance? Contact our member services team at 877-496-1600 for support with enrollment or troubleshooting. We’re here to help you get the most out of your banking experience.
Federally insured by the NCUA

Photo Scanner is now available for all iOS devices!

bluejetty:00162248:ios.description:
İyi Ki Sen De Bizdensin! Lezzet Dolu Dünyamıza Hoş Geldin!
Tıkla Gelsin® dünyasında her sipariş bir deneyim, her kullanıcı ise ailemizin bir parçası. "İyi ki sen de bizdensin" diyoruz çünkü favori lezzetlerine giden yolda seni en iyi biz anlıyoruz. Canın Burger King®’in efsane ateşini mi çekti, yoksa Popeyes®’ın çıtır tavuklarını mı? Belki de sıra beklemeden hızlıca bir Gel Al siparişi vermek istiyorsun... Tercihin hangisi olursa olsun, senin hızına ve keyfine ayak uydurmak için buradayız. Seninle birlikte büyüyen bu toplulukta, sadece bir uygulama kullanıcısı değil, her zaman önceliğimiz olan özel bir misafirimizsin. Hadi, bu lezzet yolculuğunda sana özel avantajların ve en sevdiğin restoranların tadını çıkarmaya başla!
Neden Tıkla Gelsin®?
Geniş Restoran Ağı: Türkiye'nin dört bir yanından binlerce restoran ve mutfak seçeneği.
Özel İndirimler: Siparişlerinde sana özel kampanya ve kupon fırsatlarını yakala.
Kolay Sipariş: Kullanıcı dostu arayüzle birkaç dokunuşla sepetini tamamla.
Canlı Takip: Siparişinin tüm aşamalarını anlık olarak izle.
Güvenli Ödeme: Tıkla Pay Cüzdan, kredi kartı ve yemek kartları ile hızlıca öde.
Gel Al Seçeneği: Sıra beklemeden yemeğini restoranda ye veya paket olarak al.
Cüzdan Avantajı: Tıkla Pay ile yükledikçe Tıkla Para kazan, siparişlerinde kullan.
Arkadaşını Davet Et: Sevdiklerini Tıkla Gelsin® dünyasına kat, birlikte kazan.
7/24 Destek: Chatbot ve canlı destek ekibimizle her an yanındayız.
Favori Lezzetlerin Tek Uygulamada!
Online yemek siparişinin yıldızı Tıkla Gelsin®; Burger King®, Popeyes®, Arby’s®, Subway®, Sbarro®, Usta Dönerci®, Usta Pideci®, Amasya Et Ürünleri® ve Milgo® lezzetlerini tek çatıda topluyor. Dönerden pizzaya, tavuk menülerinden enfes içeceklere kadar canın ne çekiyorsa; evde, işte ya da restoranda sadece birkaç tık uzağında!
Sana Gelsin veya Gel Al!
Sana Gelsin seçeneğiyle favori restoranını seç, online veya kapıda ödeme yöntemiyle siparişin hızlıca kapına gelsin. Vaktin kısıtlıysa Gel Al özelliğini kullan; siparişini önceden ver, restorana vardığında sıra beklemeden yemeğini teslim al.
Tıkla Pay ile Kazancını Katla
Tıkla Pay Cüzdan’ına hızlıca para yükle, pratik ödemenin tadını çıkar. İlk yüklemeye özel ve sonraki işlemlerinde kazandığın Tıkla Para’larla siparişlerini çok daha hesaplı hale getir.
Oyna Kazan ile Eğlenceyi Yakala
Sadece yemek değil, eğlence de bizde! Oyna Kazan özelliğiyle şansını dene ve siparişlerinde kullanabileceğin sürpriz hediyeler kazan.
Hemen Tıkla Gelsin®’i indir, bu lezzet dolu aileye katıl ve keyifli bir yemek deneyimi yaşamaya başla!
Sepette indirim fırsatlarını kaçırma
Tıkla Gelsin® yemek sitesi ve yemek siparişi uygulaması, kullanıcılarına benzersiz kampanyalar ve indirimler sunuyor. Burger King® siparişi, Popeyes® siparişi, Arby’s® siparişi, Subway® siparişi, Sbarro® siparişi, Usta Dönerci®, Usta Pideci® siparişi, Amasya Et Ürünleri® siparişi, Milgo® siparişi… Tıkla Gelsin® ile hepsi aynı uygulamada! Yapman gereken tek şey sepetini enfes lezzetlerle doldurmak ve indirim fırsatlarını yakalamak!
Fırsatlar ve İndirimler Tıkla Gelsin®’de
Tıklapay Cüzdan özelliği, ilk yüklemeye özel yüklediğin miktara göre değişen oranda Tıkla Para kazandırıyor. Sonraki para yüklemelerinde kazancını çoğaltma şansın var! Üstelik Arkadaşını Davet Et özelliği de Tıkla Para kazanma fırsatı sunuyor.
Lezzetli yemeklerin keyfini çıkarmak hiç bu kadar kolay olmamıştı. Hemen Tıkla Gelsin®’i indir ve keyifli bir yemek deneyimi yaşa!
Daha Fazla Destek ve Bilgi için: bilgi@tiklagelsin.com
Youtube: www.youtube.com/@Tikla.Gelsin
X: x.com/tiklagelsin
Instagram: instagram.com/tikla.gelsin
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/tiklagelsin1

bluejetty:00126400:ios.description:
Style Your iPhone & iPad with Custom Icons, Aesthetic Widgets & Live Wallpapers
With Lock Screen & Widgets 26, transforming the look of your iPhone or iPad has never been easier — or more fun. Choose from beautifully designed icon packs, interactive widgets, animated wallpapers, and trendy themes, all in one simple app.
What You Get
Custom Themes
Curated home screen setups with matching icons, widgets, and wallpapers. One tap and your device looks brand new.
Aesthetic Widgets
Add stylish widgets like Neon clocks, Daily Quotes, Custom Settings panels, and more. Mix, match, and layer your look.
50+ Icon Packs
Change how your apps appear with over 50 stunning icon collections in various styles — minimalist, bold, vintage, glassy, and more.
Live Wallpapers
Bring your screen to life with high-quality animated wallpapers designed to make your lock and home screen stand out.
Glassy UI Elements
Experience the latest iOS design trends with sleek, translucent UI that gives your device a premium, futuristic feel.
Custom Icon Creator
Design your own icons — pick a background, choose from hundreds of icons, and add them directly to your home screen.
How It Works
1. Choose a Theme – Tap to preview and install your favorite setup
2. Customize Icons – Select individual icons or full icon packs
3. Apply Wallpaper – Save and set static or live wallpapers
4. Create Icons – Use the built-in icon maker for a fully custom look
Why Users Love It
Simple & Intuitive – Designed for effortless customization
Regular Updates – New icon packs, widgets, and themes added frequently
All-in-One Solution – Everything you need in one beautifully designed app
Built for iOS – Optimized for iPhone & iPad with smooth performance
Your iPhone. Your Style.
Subscription Details:
Lock screen offers premium features through auto-renewable subscriptions. Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account upon confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage your subscription and turn off auto-renewal in your account settings.
For more details on managing subscriptions, visit: https://support.apple.com/en-us/HT202039
Privacy Policy - https://api.posterapp.org/IconThemer/privacy-policy.html
Terms of Service - https://api.posterapp.org/IconThemer/terms-and-conditions.html
Don’t settle for a boring home screen.
Download Lock Screen & Widgets 26 and turn your device into a design masterpiece — no design skills required.

bluejetty:00170411:android.description:
Welcome to Cash Mafia 🔢👀
Cash Mafia is a fun and challenging visual testing game where players improve focus and attention by reading and identifying numbers in different visual patterns.
Designed for casual play and brain engagement, Cash Mafia combines number-recognition challenges with a clear reward system that allows users to collect reward points through eligible participation.
🔹 How it works
• Read and identify numbers shown in visual patterns
• Complete focus-based and perception challenges
• Improve attention, clarity, and reaction skills
• Collect reward points for eligible completions
Reward points may be redeemed for supported rewards such as gift cards or digital payouts, subject to availability, verification, and applicable limits.
🔹 Why play Cash Mafia?
✔ Improves visual focus and number recognition
✔ Simple and engaging visual challenges
✔ Clear reward point system with defined limits
✔ Daily challenges and bonus opportunities
⚠️ Important Disclaimer
Cash Mafia is not a job or income source. Rewards are promotional, limited, and non-guaranteed, and depend on user activity, eligibility, verification, and offer availability. Redemption options may vary and can change without prior notice.
Download Cash Mafia and enjoy sharpening your visual number-reading skills while collecting rewards!

bluejetty:00073890:ios.description:
HomePass allows you to get rid of that old notebook and store your HomeKit or Matter device's codes right on your iPhone, iPad or Mac.
“HomePass is a must-have utility for HomeKit enthusiasts.” - 9to5Mac
Featured on The Verge, Cortex, 9to5Mac, MacStories, iDownloadBlog, iCulture.nl, appgefahren.de and more.
• HomeKit and Matter codes anywhere, synced to iCloud
With HomePass, you can keep your device codes off paper and synced into iCloud.
• Maintain your Home while keeping your codes safe
HomePass will offer to maintain your home on each launch, pulling in changes from Apple Home including home, room and device changes and offering for you to save changes as you wish.
• Attachments
Attach an image, file or link to a saved accessory. This is great for saving the device's manual alongside it, or a photo of where the device is within your home.
• Import Existing Accessories
HomePass offers the ability to easily import your existing accessories, just input the device's setup code yourself or scan it with either the camera or NFC.
• Custom Accessories
Add any accessories you have that aren't in HomeKit or Matter now, simply fill in the details as needed.
• Apple Watch
View and then scan your HomeKit or Matter device codes back into Home on your wrist.
• Export and Backup
Export to your HomeKit codes to a PDF, Markdown or CSV file. Ready for printing, sharing or storage on iCloud Drive. 
Note: HomePass cannot import a device's setup code as this is not stored by HomeKit or Matter, you will need to manually enter it or scan it's code tag.

Army Commando Assault is a free game to play but you may need to pay for some special features.

bluejetty:00152888:ios.description:
Princess Protect: Dragon Wars - Epic Hero Adventure! 
The kingdom is in urgent need! The army of monsters is approaching, and the princess is in imminent danger! In this casual game that combines strategy and fast-paced action, you will command legendary heroes to build defenses and crush enemy attacks with wisdom and courage. Every decision is about survival - can you be the last hope of the kingdom? 
Core gameplay: Classification+New tower defense experience
Summon heroes and arrange formations reasonably
Deploy corresponding heroes based on monster colors, and different heroes have different skills!
Choose the appropriate hero formation, and the hero will only travel to the combat area according to their own direction!
Dynamic defense strategy
The combat area is limited in location, so you need to prepare a strategic layout in advance!
The shooting frequency of different heroes also varies, so it is necessary to plan reasonably to make appropriate choices!
Racing against time
The monster's movement speed increases as it enters the level, and any hesitation for a second could put the princess in danger!
Game Features
Various hero units and demons!
Strategy Depth
Prop usage: Different props have different skills. Reasonable use can bring great benefits and turn the tide at critical moments!
Terrain trajectory: Different levels have different monster paths. By observing different trajectory paths, choose the appropriate influence to exit the station!
Immersive experience
Exquisite cartoon rendered fantasy kingdom, stunning art scenes, unlocking numerous members of the royal family (including their pets)!
The princess will perform various actions based on the scene, and the scene and animation will make you feel like you are there!
Why did you fall in love with this game? 
Leisure player friendly: automatic combat mechanism+concise tutorial, just a few seconds to get started.
Hardcore player challenge: Perfect formation can achieve "no damage" achievement.
Multiple character skins: Characters, monsters, and even weapons have multiple skins that can be replaced!
Download Princess Protect: Dragon Wars now! 
Gather your hero team, protect the princess, and write your own tower defense legend!

bluejetty:00134955:ios.description:
AR Plan 3D is an innovative measurement app that uses augmented reality (AR) for quick room measurement and room scan. AR technology lets you place a virtual plan measurement ruler on real-world surfaces, making measure plans and creating a 3D room floor plan AR LiDAR measurement much faster and easier.
With the AR Plan 3D ruler app, you can:
1. Instantly scan your surroundings with the Automatic room scan feature. Create a floor plan measurement of a room in just seconds.
2. Measure rooms by perimeter and height in Metric or Imperial units (cm, m, mm, inch, feet, yard).
3. Measure floor plan details, including doors and windows.
4. Automatically calculate perimeter, floor area, wall area, and other values helpful for construction or renovation planning and home measurements.
5. On LiDAR-enabled devices, easily measure room height with one tap using room scan LiDAR.
6. Use the 3D Floorplanner to create a complete room plan measurement with all dimensions.
7. Try the classic Floorplanner to generate a floor plan measurement in 2D.
8. Use the 2D Side View Floorplanner for wall layouts and side perspectives.
9. Estimate materials and costs based on your room measurement — including flooring, wall coverings, renovation work, and more.
10. In Manual Mode, the “Auto Corners” tool helps you detect and fix room corners directly on the planner room.
11. Create entire apartments with automatic room separation, or manually add spaces using Autoscan for precise room measuring.
12. Save your measure plans in the Floorplanner Archive.
13. Share your home measurements by email, messaging, or social networks.
Try AR Plan 3D ruler app today — we’d love to hear your feedback!

Are you nervous? Are you feeling scared? Are you feeling uncertain and happy at the same time?
Yes, that means that your child will be born! 
Do you want to know how your child is developing? Do you want to experience this amazing time with your partner? 
Get ready to install the HiDaddy application to get daily information from your baby! 
Thanks to the HiDaddy application:
- Your child will let you know how it is developing.
- You will know what your partner feels when she is pregnant.
- Your baby will tell you how to take care of its mother to make her happy.
- You will not be afraid of your partner's moods and whims because the child will explain to you what is happening to her and what is caused by it
- You will know how fast your child is growing and how big it is in a given week 
- You will be prepared for your baby’s birth
We made the HiDaddy application in two versions of notifications! 
In the basic version you can get daily messages from your baby, which will be polite and informative
The second version of notifications is the version for dads who don’t treat themselves seriously. 
Do you want to experience this time at ease? That version will be for you! 
An amazing adventure awaits you soget involved and be a pregnant daddy! :)
We’re keeping our fingers crossed!

bluejetty:00119211:ios.description:
Hookle is a simple social media management app for small business owners. Create posts with AI, schedule content, manage multiple social channels, and publish updates to Google Business Profile from one easy mobile app.
SUMMARY OF KEY FEATURES
• Manage Your Socials in One App
• Create posts faster with AI
• Schedule content in advance
• Publish to multiple platforms

• Track performance with simple analytics
• Free plan with affordable upgrades
MANAGE YOUR SOCIALS IN ONE APP
Hookle brings your key social channels together, so you can manage your online presence without switching between apps. Create, schedule, publish, and track your content from one simple mobile app.
CREATE POSTS FASTER WITH AI
Need ideas or captions? Hookle’s AI helps you create social media content faster, while keeping your posts relevant to your business and audience.
SCHEDULE CONTENT IN ADVANCE
Plan your posts ahead of time with Hookle’s easy social media calendar. Schedule content for the right time and stay active online, even when you’re busy running your business.
PUBLISH TO MULTIPLE PLATFORMS
Post to platforms like Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok, Pinterest, X, Threads, and Google Business Profile from one place. Reach more customers without repeating the same work.
MANAGE GOOGLE BUSINESS PROFILE UPDATES
Keep your business visible on Google Search and Maps by publishing updates to your Google Business Profile through Hookle, just like your social channels.
TRACK PERFORMANCE WITH SIMPLE ANALYTICS
See how your posts are performing with easy-to-understand stats. Hookle helps you follow your activity, reach, and engagement without complicated dashboards.
FREE PLAN WITH AFFORDABLE UPGRADES
Start free and upgrade when you’re ready. Hookle keeps pricing simple and affordable for small businesses.
WHY CUSTOMERS LOVE HOOKLE
Thousands of small business owners and entrepreneurs - from restaurants to real estate agencies- use Hookle to enhance their social media marketing and grow their online presence.

• "We save hours each week" - Suave, Musician

bluejetty:00145200:ios.description:

bluejetty:00081630:ios.description:
Hey casual gamers! Dive into an exciting gaming adventure with GameHub: All-in-One Fun Minigames! This incredible all in one mini game collection brings together your favorite digital pastimes in one place. Say goodbye to boredom and welcome a world of joyful entertainment and fun. Whether you crave action or casual fun, our mini game collection has got you covered, offering thrilling experiences anytime and anywhere. Looking for a variety of free games? This is your all in one solution for endless entertainment. Enjoy anti-stress & free games anytime and anywhere.
How to Play All Free MiniGames 
GameHub: All-in-One Minigames is a treasure trove of engaging all in one games designed to stimulate your mind and enhance your cognitive abilities. This captivating free all in one collection features a variety of mini games like 2048, Sudoku, chess, hexa color sort, bus jam, screw jam, match three sort, sort match, block merge, word finder, uno, board games, and IQ test, perfect for giving your brain a fun workout. Dive into block-based challenges with free games like 1010 Blocks and Balanced Fall, or enjoy light-hearted fun with popular free mini-games like Bubble Dragons and Tiered Triple Elimination. No matter your gaming preference, our all in one mini-games is fun for all ages & provides anti-stress experience.
Key Features of GameHub: All-in-One Minigames:
Diverse Free Selection: Over twelve engaging free mini-games in one free package.
Challenge the AI: Compete against our AI and aim for victory in all anti stress games.
Continuous Updates: Look forward to new free and exciting games regularly added to the collection.
Multiple Genres: From puzzles to action, our free anti stress games collection offers every fun games for games lovers. 
All Trending Games in One App
Block Hexa Puzzle: Dive into a vibrant puzzle world filled with color sorting challenges. Explore each puzzle, stack and merge blocks to form beautiful patterns and combinations. Players can rotate the board to different angles for a more immersive and strategic experience.
Bus Sort Jam: Maneuver through a packed parking lot as you match passengers with their cars, solving intricate puzzles. It’s the ideal game to sharpen your mental agility and strategic planning skills.
Unscrew Color Pin: Enter a realm of screw puzzles where every tap and movement requires careful thought and planning. Unscrew pins, sort colorful bolts, and navigate through tricky screw challenges. It’s not just about solving puzzles but mastering the skill of unscrewing and conquering complex pin scenarios.
Goods Match: Simply find and collect three matching items from a wide range, including fresh crops and household essentials. Organize shelves efficiently, clear them, and complete your tasks within the time limit for a satisfying gameplay experience.
Say no to dull moments and bring excitement & fun to your life with our all in one minigames collection. Join the exciting world of free mini-games now and unlock unmatched fun and cognitive development on your device. 
If you need any technical support or would like to send us some suggestions to improve the game, shoot us an email at gamewayfu@wayfustudio.com.

bluejetty:00018037:ios.description:
Use our Island Savings Mobile App for all your banking needs, anytime, anywhere. Check your account information, transfer money, deposit cheques, pay bills, make calculations, open additional accounts, set up alerts, and more—all from your iPhone®, iPod Touch®, or iPad®! Plus, you'll have quick access to our rates and branch contact information. 
FEATURES
• Use Apple Pay® to pay for purchases with your iOS device
• Biometric login options - Face/Touch ID
• Check account balances
• View transaction history
• Pay bills
• Transfer funds between Island Savings accounts
• Send and receive Interac e-Transfers® – import your contacts to make sending money easier
• Deposit cheques
• Open additional accounts
• Add and manage your account Alerts
• Set up recurring bill payments
• Set up recurring transfers
• Add/delete bill payees
• Calculators
• Schedule transactions
• Check rates
• Contact us securely
• Locate nearby branches and ding-free ATMs
• Access details about our Referral Perks® loyalty program 
• View help, privacy, and security information
BENEFITS
• It's simple to use
• You can download it for free*
• It's fully compatible with iPhone®, iPod Touch®, and iPad®
• You can access our App using your existing online banking login credentials
• You can use QuickView to see your main account balances, without having to log in
• Biometric login options - Face/Touch ID
• Use Apple Pay® to pay for purchases with your iOS device
*You may incur service charges for various online services depending on the type of account you have. In addition, your mobile carrier may charge you for using your mobile device to access the services provided by our Mobile App.
ACCESS
Island Savings is a division of First West Credit Union. Access is available to all members who currently use our online banking service. Use of the Mobile App is subject to the terms and conditions found in our First West Credit Union Account Access Agreement for both personal and business accounts.

Your story lives in the Billings Gazette. From reporting on all of your favorite teams to the news that matters most in your community, we cover it all. Get in-depth stories from across Montana – including news, sports, opinion, obituaries, entertainment, and politics.
Easily access the very latest news in an app built for you. Read, see, and hear exclusive commentary, stunning photography, video updates, and binge-worthy podcasts.
Plus, subscribers have the ability to upgrade to News+, our premium ad-free experience! That means faster-loading pages and an uninterrupted reading experience. 
Our app features:
* Your Stories – personalize your experience by selecting the local news topics that matter most to you
* Get notified – stay in the loop by selecting alerts for news, sports, weather, and more
* Easy navigation – see all the latest local stories by simply swiping up/down, and left/right.
* Read stories your way – either in the News Feed or via the E-edition
* Breaking news updates – top banners let you know what’s happening right now
* Follow author – get notifications whenever your favorite writers post a story
* Bookmark for later – save stories to enjoy at your leisure
* Listen to articles – press the play button to listen instead
* Customize your text size – make the content bigger or smaller in your profile settings
* Weather where you are – hourly, 10-day forecasts, and frequent video updates
Free to download. Subscribers enjoy unlimited access.

bluejetty:00022548:ios.description:
ICONIT is a Japanese QR code and barcode reader app with world-class scanning speed and accuracy.
Just scan, and you'll instantly get the information you want.
・Even QR codes that couldn't be read by other QR or barcode scanners can be scanned effortlessly with ICONIT!
・Highly rated for its scanning speed and accuracy, ICONIT has surpassed 36 million downloads.
・All features are available for free!
※ An ad-free premium plan is also available.
■ Recommended for:
・People who want to work more efficiently
・People who want to check their scan history frequently
・People who want to quickly check reviews and ratings
・People who want to use QR codes for fan activities or events
■ ICONIT Features and Main Functions
・Instant scanning
Just opening the app launches the camera instantly, allowing you to scan QR codes and barcodes smoothly.
・Scan history saving function
Scanned data is saved automatically and can be reviewed anytime from the history.
Scan history can also be exported as a CSV file.
・Scannable from saved images
You can scan codes from images saved in your album or clipboard.
・QR code creation
You can easily create QR codes for contact info, text, and URLs.
・Product info / review search
Simply scan a barcode to jump to Amazon or Google with one tap!
Check product details and user reviews easily.
※ “Amazon” is a trademark or registered trademark of Amazon.com, Inc.
※ “Google” is a trademark or registered trademark of Google LLC.
・Great for fan activities and events!
You can smoothly scan QR codes from posters or PC screens—very useful for live shows and events.
・Fortune-telling
Check your fortune for today! Enjoy it as a daily boost or light entertainment.
■ How to use
・To scan a printed label: just open the app or tap "Scan". Just hold over a QR code/barcode.
・To scan a stored image: on the "Scan" screen, tap "Photos" on the upper-right corner and choose from the album or clipboard.
・To search a product from GTIN-13: scan and choose Google or Amazon.
・To add to history: just scan. The scanning record will automatically be added to the history.
・To revisit history: tap "History" and choose a record.
・To delete history: tap "Edit" on the upper-right corner, choose a record and "Delete" on the upper-left corner (otherwise, you can delete all history by not choosing a record before "Delete").
・To generate a QR code: tap "Home" and choose "QR Generator". You can choose "Phone Book" to use contact information or "Enter Text" to input free text.
■ Supported QR and Barcode Types
・QR Code
・JAN Code
・EAN-128
・NW-7
・CODE39
・Data Matrix
・ITF Code
・GS1 DataBar Limited
・GS1 DataBar Limited Composite Symbol - CCA
・GS1 DataBar Stacked Composite Symbol - CC-A
Uses the Camreader barcode reader engine, which can be embedded in “Raspberry Pi”.
■ ICONIT's Reliability & Frequently Asked Questions
・About ICONIT's safety
“Is ICONIT safe? Will it access my data without permission?”
No need to worry. ICONIT is a safe QR and barcode reader app made in Japan.
It respects user privacy and will never collect personal information without permission.
・All features are free to use
You can use all of ICONIT's functions for free.
An optional paid plan is available that removes ads.
・Benefits of creating an account
By creating an account, you can carry over your scan history and points when switching devices, making it even more convenient.
ICONIT, the high-performance QR and barcode reader that lets you scan instantly, is available for iPhone and iPad.
Download the all-free QR code scanner app "ICONIT" now and give it a try!
※ ICONIT is updated regularly to improve quality. Please always use the latest version.

・To search a product from GTIN-13: scan and choose Google or Amazon.
・To add to history: just scan. The scanning record will automatically be added to the history.
・To revisit history: tap "History" and choose a record.
・To delete history: tap "Edit" on the upper-right corner, choose a record and "Delete" on the upper-left corner (otherwise, you can delete all history by not choosing a record before "Delete").
・To generate a QR code: tap "Home" and choose "QR Generator". You can choose "Phone Book" to use contact information or "Enter Text" to input free text.

■ Supported QR and Barcode Types

・QR Code
・JAN Code
・EAN-128
・NW-7
・CODE39
・Data Matrix
・ITF Code
・GS1 DataBar Limited
・GS1 DataBar Limited Composite Symbol - CCA
・GS1 DataBar Stacked Composite Symbol - CC-A

Uses the Camreader barcode reader engine, which can be embedded in “Raspberry Pi”.

■ ICONIT's Reliability & Frequently Asked Questions

・About ICONIT's safety
“Is ICONIT safe? Will it access my data without permission?”
No need to worry. ICONIT is a safe QR and barcode reader app made in Japan.
It respects user privacy and will never collect personal information without permission.

・All features are free to use
You can use all of ICONIT's functions for free.
An optional paid plan is available that removes ads.

・Benefits of creating an account
By creating an account, you can carry over your scan history and points when switching devices, making it even more convenient.

ICONIT, the high-performance QR and barcode reader that lets you scan instantly, is available for iPhone and iPad.
Download the all-free QR code scanner app "ICONIT" now and give it a try!
