bluejetty:00014508:ios.description:
Welcome to Nordea!
The app puts the entire bank in the palm of your hand, enabling you to do most of your banking swiftly, smoothly and securely.
You can test the demo version of the app without logging in. You can access it through Menu before logging in. All information in the demo version is fictitious.
Examples of what you can do in the app:
YOUR OVERVIEW
In the Overview tab, you can view and manage all your finances in one place. You can add, hide or rearrange the order of your content to personalise your experience. In the overview, you'll also find your Profile, where you can find your documents, manage BankID, notification settings and your consents, as well as log out. Quick actions take you straight to several functions, such as Search, helping you find what you need. If you have other banks, you can also add them to get a better overview of your finances.
PAYMENTS AND TRANSFERS
Pay your bills and transfer money, both between your own accounts or to a friend. Here, you can also add and manage both e-invoices and direct debits, simplifying your everyday life.
MANAGE YOUR CARDS
Connect cards and wearables to Apple Pay for contactless payments. If you forgot your PIN-code, you can view it here. You can also block your card if needed, and we ll send you a new one automatically. Choose the geographic areas where your credit card can be used and restrict the use for online shopping so you can feel safer and get more control of your payments.
SAVE AND INVEST
In the Invest tab it s easy to keep track of your savings and see how they are performing. Start saving monthly, trade in funds and stocks, or set a goal for your savings. Get suggestions and ideas for new investments through Find Investments.
DISCOVER NEW PRODUCTS AND SERVICES
In the Services tab, you can open different accounts, apply for credit cards or loans, get digital advice for long-term savings, and much more.
GET BETTER CONTROL OF YOUR FINANCES
The Insights tab gives you a clear overview of your income and expenditure. Your spending is divided into categories to give you a deeper understanding where your money is going. Here, you can make your own budgets to make it easier to plan and keep track of your expenditure.
WE'RE HERE FOR YOU
The Help tab contains all the information you need to get help with your banking. Use the Search function, see frequently asked questions and answers, or chat with us directly. If you call us through the app, you ve already identified yourself, so we can help you faster.
We want to know what you think, so feel free to leave a review or send your feedback directly in the app. For more information, you re welcome to contact us on 0771-22 44 88 or visit nordea.se/appen.
Download the app today and get access to all the functions that simplify your banking!

bluejetty:00119161:ios.name: GlobalProtect™
bluejetty:00119161:ios.summary: GlobalProtect for iOS connects to a GlobalProtect gateway on a Palo Alto Networks next-generation firewall to allow mobile users to benefit from enterprise security protection. Enterprise administrator can configure the same app to connect
bluejetty:00119161:ios.description:
GlobalProtect for iOS connects to a GlobalProtect gateway on a Palo Alto Networks next-generation firewall to allow mobile users to benefit from enterprise security protection. Enterprise administrator can configure the same app to connect in either Always-On VPN, Remote Access VPN or Per App VPN mode. The app automatically adapts to the end user’s location and connects the user to the best available gateway in order to deliver optimal performance for all users and their traffic, without requiring any effort from the user. This allows users to work safely and effectively at locations outside of the traditional office. 
Before installing this app, please check with your IT department to ensure that your organization has enabled a GlobalProtect gateway subscription on the firewall.
Features: 
Automatic VPN connection using iOS VPN On-Demand
Support for BYOD with Remote Access VPN and App Level VPN
Automatic discovery of best available gateway
Manual gateway selection capability
Connection over IPSec or SSL
Integration with MDM for easy provisioning
Support for changing an expired AD/RADIUS password when the user connects remotely
Support for 2 Factor One Time Password based Authentication using RADIUS, SAML
Support for other PAN-OS authentication methods, including LDAP, Client Certificates, and Local User Databases
Full benefits of the native iOS experience with integrated notifications
Capability for enterprises to enable users to use any app securely
Requirements: 
 Supported on Palo Alto Networks next-generation firewalls running PAN-OS 7.1, 8.0, 8.1 and above 
 Requires a GlobalProtect gateway subscription installed on the Palo Alto Networks firewall in order to enable support for GlobalProtect app for iOS.
 Supported on iOS 10 and later releases

bluejetty:00165195:ios.description:
QR Code Creation and Scanning
The application has a built-in powerful QR code engine that can quickly and accurately scan and analyze various QR code contents, and can also create various QR codes with one click.
AI Object Recognition
Don't know the object in front of you? AI Object Recognition is here to help you. Just take a photo and you can automatically identify the animals, plants or food categories in the photo, and become a know-it-all from now on.
WiFi Fast Sharing and Connection
The built-in universal WiFi protocol can not only quickly scan the QR code to connect, but also quickly generate your own WiFi QR code and share it with friends with one click.
Search for Products
Product barcode scanning: universal barcode recognition, automatic analysis of product barcodes, online search for corresponding products, convenient, fast and accurate.
QR Code Scanner also has a user-friendly interface design, which is simple and clear, and the operation is smooth. Even first-time users can quickly get started. In addition, the application pays attention to user privacy protection. All processed data is stored locally. Unless the user actively shares it, it will not be uploaded to the server to ensure information security.
In short, QR Code Scanner is a powerful assistant in your daily life and work. Whether you are dealing with daily affairs or exploring the unknown world, it can provide you with convenient, efficient and safe solutions.

bluejetty:00040463:ios.description:
Put your color-matching skills to the test with the Blingiest, most rewarding match-3 game on the market! Bitcoin Blast combines your love of crypto with your need for brain-stimulating puzzles. 
Blast your way through hundreds of strategic levels with progressive difficulty. Focus on creating colorful combos--the longer the Bitcoin chain the bigger the explosions! Collect diamonds/rubies, shatter stones, and crack the safes by matching the “Bitcoin” with like-colored coins. 
Each level creates a unique opportunity for you test your puzzle-solving skills. Make sure to think ahead as moves you make now can affect the outcome of level; keep your eye on the timer as some levels give you less time to think. Make longer chains to score higher star values. 
Use long chains in combination with epic powerups to get the most bang out of your BTC. Crack the Bitcoin and earn Bling Points in-app if you log into your Bling account. 
Features: 
Hundreds of Levels 
Solve Strategic Puzzles 
Test Your Skills With Progressive Difficulty 
Create Colorful Combos 
Bitcoin Themed

bluejetty:00070328:ios.description:
Turkey's First and Largest Location-Based Job and Employee Finding Application!
We present 'İşin Olsun,' the new job advertisement application for blue-collar 'job and personnel needs' from Kariyer.net! There are thousands of job advertisements published every day! Download İşin Olsun now, and find your dream job or the perfect employee within 24 hours, absolutely free!
How about quickly finding a job near your home with İşin Olsun?
THE BEST JOB NEAR YOUR HOME!
Find your dream job from among the closest and most up-to-date job advertisements, apply, and make that job yours!
NO NEED TO CREATE A CV, JUST REGISTER IN 1 MINUTE!
With a short profile you can create in just 1 minute, get instantly hired for the full-time job, part-time job, freelance job, extra job, temporary job, daily job, or service job you are looking for. Start earning money right away!
INSTANT MESSAGING WITH COMPANIES!
Don't waste time going to interviews; communicate with companies instantly through remote messaging.
SEE DETAILS OF PART-TIME JOBS, DAILY JOBS, OR HOURLY JOBS!
In part-time job advertisements, you can see the day and hour details of the job. You can choose daily or hourly jobs for extra job opportunities. This way, you can also provide short-term services by doing short-term work.
How about quickly finding that employee you're looking for with İşin Olsun?
FIND THE BEST EMPLOYEE QUICKLY!
Make your job advertisement visible to everyone, especially those close to your workplace, and choose the most suitable candidate from the applicants.
IMMEDIATELY POST A FREE JOB AD!
Post a completely free job advertisement in just 1 MINUTE by entering the company's address and job information.
WHETHER CANDIDATES CALL YOU INSTANTLY OR YOU COLLECT APPLICATIONS!
Post a free job advertisement, and let your phone start ringing immediately or collect applications, then get back to the suitable candidates. Use filtering features like location, experience, and education to bring applicants with desired qualifications and get in touch with them quickly.
MEET CANDIDATES AND MAKE INSTANT HIRINGS!
You can communicate with suitable candidates remotely using the instant messaging feature.
CHOOSE DAY AND HOUR IN PART-TIME JOB ADS FOR SHORT-TERM JOBS!
In the details of the part-time job advertisements, you can find daily job and hourly job options.
Are you looking for full-time, part-time, home office, remote, freelance, or seasonal work? Or are you searching for daily or hourly jobs for short-term work? Do you want to see all job advertisements in one place without searching for more jobs? Do you urgently need a job?
If you own a business, starting a new business, looking for an employee, or in urgent need of personnel, have an employee left the job, or do you need new staff? Post a free job ad and collect applications! İşin Olsun is here for you!
İşin Olsun instantly offers the newest job advertisements for various positions like waiter, secretary, cleaning staff, chef, security guard, courier, motorcycle courier, store staff, cargo personnel, driver, cashier, salesperson, technician, in restaurants, offices, business centers, restaurants, shopping malls, stores, markets, industrial centers, factories, and many other places.
Please note that you won't be able to see public job announcements among the thousands of daily job advertisements; we recommend checking the İşkur job advertisements for public jobs.
You can post free job advertisements and search for employees in all cities and districts of Turkey, including Istanbul, Ankara, Izmir, Kocaeli, Antalya, Bursa, Adana, Samsun, Mersin, Aydın, Kayseri, and more. If you're looking for a job, you can easily apply to thousands of job advertisements from all over Turkey through İşin Olsun!
İşin Olsun application is a Kariyer.net brand. Kariyer.net Elektronik Yayıncılık ve İletişim Hizmetleri A.Ş. operates as a Private Employment Agency authorized by İşkur.

انطلق سكوبي من مدينة الرياض، وهو في طريقه للتوسع ليشمل كافة أنحاء المملكة. بفضل تصميمه البسيط والمبتكر، يمكنك من خلال التطبيق حجز مواعيد مباشرة لخدمات العناية بحيوانك الأليف، مثل الاستحمام، التنظيف، القص. 
سكوبي يسهل على أصحاب الحيوانات الأليفة الوصول إلى أفضل الخدمات بكل راحة وأمان، دون الحاجة إلى البحث الطويل. ما يميز التطبيق هو التنوع الكبير في الخدمات المقدمة، حيث يتيح لك استكشاف العروض الخاصة من مقدمي الخدمات الأقرب إليك. يمكنك ببساطة تصفح الخدمات المتاحة، اختيار الخدمة التي تناسبك، وحجز الموعد بكل سهولة.
اذا كنت تبحث عن خدمات للعناية اليومية، سكوبي يجمع كل هذه الخيارات في تطبيق واحد. مع واجهة مستخدم سهلة الاستخدام وتجربة سلسة، ستتمكن من تلبية احتياجات حيواناتك الأليفة بنقرة زر واحدة.
استعد لتجربة رعاية الحيوانات الأليفة بشكل مبتكر وسهل. سكوبي هنا لتسهيل حياتك وحياة حيواناتك الأليفة!

bluejetty:00024860:ios.description:
Have fun with the fantastic mini games pastimes of Tellmewow! A collection of entertainment offline mini games so you can have fun playing with words and numbers. Escape from boredom and exercise your brain while you enjoy and learn! This puzzle books includes Sudoku, Tic Tac Toe, Solitaire and many more!
In this compilation of classic games and mini games you will find various fun games to spend your free time: 
・ Tic-Tac-Toe
・ Sudoku
・ Solitaire
・ Dots and Boxes
・ SOS
・ 2048
・ Minesweeper
・ Snake
・ Onet
・ and more fun games!
Your favorite classic games to play whenever and wherever you want without internet connection! Fun games for you!
Train your mind with these educational classic games and fun games where you can demonstrate your language skills and learn vocabulary in different languages. In addition, you will also find logic games and numbers to exercise your brain.
DAILY CHALLENGE
We dare you to complete the daily challenge of this classic games! Accept the challenge and win the different fun games that we select for you every day. Pass the daily challenge and win crowns to enjoy the different rewards. 
CHARACTERISTICS
・ Fun games with simple design and intuitive interface
・ Classic games: puzzle book and logic games
・ Mini games suitable for all ages
・ Thousands of words to enjoy playing
・ Available in 8 languages
・ Different levels and hints
・ Exercise your brain daily with this mini games
・ Constant updates with new games
・ No internet connection required
・ Different fun mini games included: Sudoku, Tic Tac Toe and many more!
Do not think twice and discover all the fun classic games we have prepared in this special collection of our games. Mini games for hours and hours of fun!
ABOUT SENIOR GAMES - TELLMEWOW
Senior Games is a project of Tellmewow, a mobile game development company specialized in easy adaptation and basic usability, which make our games ideal for older people or young people who simply want to play an occasional game without major complications.
If you have any suggestions for improvement or want to stay informed about upcoming games that we are going to publish, follow us on our social networks: seniorgames_tmw

bluejetty:00183342:ios.summary: Ordering your favorite food just got even easier. Download our app to effortlessly begin customizing and placing orders in seconds! Create an account to earn exclusive in-app mobile rewards or even choose to use our app as a guest. Now you
bluejetty:00183342:ios.description:
Ordering your favorite food just got even easier. Download our app to effortlessly begin customizing and placing orders in seconds! Create an account to earn exclusive in-app mobile rewards or even choose to use our app as a guest. Now you can be just a few taps away from your favorite pizza at all times!
Serving authentic Italian dishes in Monmouth County, NJ since 1992.
APP FEAUTURES:
MOBILE ORDERING - Conveniently place pick up and delivery orders from your iPhone, iPad or iPod.
GUEST CHECKOUT - No need to create an account until you want to begin earning rewards or saving preferences.
MOBILE PAY - Visa, MasterCard, Discover, Amex or Apple Pay. 
CREATE ACCOUNT - Securely save delivery addresses, payment info and preferences for quicker check outs.
EARN RIBBONS - Automatically earn one ribbon on a mobile order receipt of more than $18. Collect ribbons to choose a free reward: 
6 = Garlic Knots. 12 = LG Plain Pizza. 18 = Angry Grandma Pizza.
REFER FRIENDS - Ask a friend sign up with your invite link you will both earn 4 ribbons when they buy a pizza (or equal value)
SAVE FAVORITES - Easily favorite menu items to quickly access your favorites.
QUICK ORDER - Choose a past order to set as a quick order for the fastest way to order your favorite meal.
ORDER AHEAD - Plan ahead and place orders in advance.
ORDER STATUS UPDATES - Track the progress of your order with notifications as it moves through the stages.
LEAVE REVIEWS - Your feedback is appreciated and helps us to continue to improve our services.
3-D TOUCH APP ICON - Hold down the app icon on your home screen for the quickest way to place an order.
MERCH STORE - purchase all you favorite Gianni's gear (NJ Only)
EMERGENCY BROADCAST - Join our sms and email list to be the first to know about what's happening at Gianni's and receive exclusive offers.
TOAST POS INTEGRATION - App orders are now sent straight to our kitchen allowing us to more efficiently and properly serve you. 
We appreciate you choosing Gianni's and look forward to providing our community with exciting new ways to interact and connect with us! If you have any questions, comments or concerns regarding our mobile app please email support@giannispizzeria.com

Earn money and help others live full and independent lives by giving rides to older adults and people with disabilities. You’ll do rewarding work and create positive change in your community with every ride.

WHY UZURV?
DRIVE, EARN, & MAKE A DIFFERENCE
Be a positive force in your community and earn good money helping others.

Schedule rides in advance and always see the estimate of what you’ll make before booking a ride.

Drive as much or as little as you want, when you want… and do good along the way.
BE CONFIDENT ON EVERY RIDE
Find peace of mind with real-time ride monitoring designed to get you safely from pickup to destination.

Reach a UZURV team member immediately when you need help during a ride.

Get to know riders who appreciate your service and drive knowing UZURV is committed to your success.
CREATE POSITIVE IMPACT
Become a vital part of giving accessible and reliable rides to those who need it most.
Want to know more about driving with UZURV? Download the app now and visit uzurv.com/drive.

bluejetty:00086086:ios.description:
SkyPhone - Voice & Video Calls
Over 12 Million Downloads!
SkyPhone is a simple and free calling app.
Just listen and you'll soon notice the high quality sound.
You can start using the app without having to register your personal information.
Enter your profile and share your SkyPhone number with friends and family.
SkyPhone users can enjoy the clear, high-quality voice calls on SkyPhone for FREE.
Simple UI !
The Allow Contacts Only feature blocks calls from unregistered contacts. 
You can connect only to those who you want to. Use SkyPhone as a dedicated phone app to make calls to your loved ones.
The Noise Cancel Feature allows you to hear the other person more clearly and talk without any problems even if you're in a large crowd of people.
If you set the Call Sound Quality setting to Low, you can enjoy talking for a long time even if you are in an area with a weak signal or your data speed is reduced.
[What's outstanding?]
- Clear voice call with a high quality sound
- No registration is required
[Main Features]
- Free voice calls
- Free video calls
- Point-Paid calls function
- Messaging function
- Allow Contacts Only function
- Do Not Disturb function
- What's New function
- SkyPhone Number Transfer function
- Incoming and Outgoing Call History
- Contact List
- Mute, speaker and noise canceling function
- Set your favorite ringtone
Click the URL below for the FAQ of SkyPhone.
https://www.skyphone.jp/en/support

- Voice calls with SkyPhone are only available between SkyPhone users.
- Data communication takes place in the use of the service. You are responsible for the data charges.

- We don't guarantee that the app works correctly in older verisons than the latest one. Therefore, you might find a problem in older versions depending on your device.

- Practice with 700+ questions

apple-itunes:1513851259.name: The Daily Office
apple-itunes:1513851259.description:
Pray Morning, Midday, Evening, and Compline (bedtime) prayer from the Book of Common Prayer (2019), every day, wherever you are. The Daily Office sets out each office on one page, in order: no flipping between sections, no looking up readings in the lectionary, no rubrics to decode.
Join Christians around the world in the pattern of daily prayer the Church has kept since its earliest days.
WHAT'S INSIDE
• Morning Prayer, Midday Prayer, Evening Prayer, and Compline for every day of the year
• Family Prayer: shorter devotions in the same pattern, for households with children
• The day's readings on their own, for Morning and Evening Prayer and the Holy Eucharist
• The whole Psalter, searchable and arranged by topic, in contemporary or traditional language
• Collects for the Christian year, the offices, and many occasions
• The Great Litany
• A calendar of the Christian year, with every feast, fast, and commemoration in its liturgical color
• Lives of the saints, with traditions and further reading for each commemoration
PRAY ANYWHERE, EVEN OFFLINE
The days ahead download on their own, up to two months of the offices, Family Prayer, and the readings for your settings, so you can pray on a plane, on retreat, or anywhere without a signal. Keep the spoken office for today and tomorrow too, and the app refreshes your downloads in the background.
PRAY ALONG WITH AUDIO
Every office can be read aloud, with each word highlighted as it is spoken. Audio keeps playing with your screen locked, and you can pause, skip, and scrub from the lock screen or your headphones.
BOOK VIEW
Pray an office one page at a time, turning the pages like a printed prayer book, with nothing else on the screen. On iPhone Duo, open it like a book and the office opens to two pages, one on each side of the fold.
PODCASTS
Prefer your podcast app? Subscribe to Morning and Evening Prayer and the daily readings, or make a podcast with your own settings.
MAKE IT YOURS
• Light, sepia, and dark themes, or follow your device
• Six typefaces, including the Caslon of the 2019 prayer book, Garamond, Baskerville, and a hyperlegible face for low vision
• Any text size, with rubrics in italic or red
• Every choice the rubrics allow: a 30- or 60-day psalter, a one- or two-year lectionary, canticles, the Traditional Language edition, and more
• Bible translations including the ESV, KJV, RSV, NASB, NIV, and NABRE
PRAY TOGETHER
Share your settings with a link or QR code, so a household, small group, or congregation can pray the same office together, in the same room or online.
FAITHFUL TO THE BOOK
The Daily Office carefully follows the text, calendar, and rubrics of the Book of Common Prayer (2019) of the Anglican Church in North America. It is an independent project, generously supported by Anglican House Publishers, publisher of the 2019 prayer book. It is not a substitute for the printed book, but a faithful companion to it: at home, at work, or on the road.
Free, with no ads and no account required. Your settings and downloads are kept on your device.
Questions, corrections, or ideas? Write to feedback@dailyoffice2019.com. We read every message.
